Translation: 其次，既有理论之所以成为既有理论，通常是因为它们能够很好地解释某些现象。如果这些现象本身具有重要意义，那么任何拟议的替代理论若无法同样解释这些现象，就会面临严重的劣势。

Query_Text_en: Finally , theories in economics frequently serve as building blocks from which to construct theories of larger scope , and any proposed replacement for an existing theory also suffers a handicap if it does not mesh well with the body of theory of which the existing theory is a part .
Translation: 经济学中的理论常常作为构建更大范围理论的基础，如果某一拟议的新理论无法与现有理论体系很好地衔接，那么它在取代现有理论时也会处于不利地位。

Query_Text_en: Conversely , neither the most pressing empirical phenomena in the economy at large nor the most powerful constructs in contemporary theory will necessarily be closely connected at any time with the most productive lines of experimental research [ any more than they need to be closely connected to one another ] .
Translation: 相反，整体经济中最紧迫的现实现象与当代理论中最有影响力的理论构建，在任何时候都未必与最具成效的实验研究方向密切相关——它们彼此之间也未必需要有紧密联系。

Query_Text_en: Different kinds of research seem to set their own agendas , just as they establish different standards by which competing claims can be evaluated .
Translation: 不同类型的研究似乎会自行设定议程，同时也会确立评判相互竞争观点的不同标准。

Query_Text_en: Much of the work of experimental economics therefore concerns aspects of economic phenomena that are not addressed by other kinds of economic research .
Translation: 因此，实验经济学的大量工作涉及其他类型经济研究未能触及的经济现象方面。

Query_Text_en: Among the pleasures of the academic life must be counted the opportunity not only to pursue one s own work , but also to have a good vantage point from which to appreciate the work of one s colleagues and the evolution of one s field .
Translation: 学术生活的乐趣之一，不仅在于能够专注于自己的研究，还在于拥有一个良好的视角，欣赏同事们的成果以及所在领域的发展。

Query_Text_en: I hope that this volume will make clear why the past few years , which I think have been formative for experimental economics , have been particularly exciting .
Translation: 我希望本书能够阐明，为什么我认为过去几年对实验经济学具有奠基意义，并且格外令人振奋。

Query_Text_en: I think that each of the directions explored in this volume has the potential to lead to significant changes in the way we understand economic phenomena .
Translation: 我认为，本书所探讨的每一个方向都有可能引发我们对经济现象理解方式的重大变革。

Query_Text_en: CHAPTER 2 Bargaining phenomena and bargaining theory ALVIN E. ROTH 2 .
Translation:
第二章 谈判现象与谈判理论  
阿尔文·E·罗斯

Query_Text_en: 1 Introduction I first began to plan an experimental study of bargaining while I was preparing a monograph [ Roth , 1979 ] concerned with what was then [ and is probably still ] the most comprehensively articulated body of formal theory about bargaining in the economics literature . I am referring to the game-theoretic work that followed in the tradition begun by John Nash [ 1950 ] . A number of experiments had already investigated bargaining situations of the kind addressed by this set of theories , and some were even explicitly concerned with testing the predictions of the theory that Nash had proposed .
Translation:
1 引言

我最初开始筹划关于谈判的实验研究，是在撰写一部专著[Roth, 1979]期间。当时，这部专著关注的是经济学文献中关于谈判最为系统、全面的形式化理论体系（这一体系至今可能仍是如此）。我指的是约翰·纳什（1950）开创的传统下，后续的博弈论研究。已有不少实验探讨了该理论体系所涉及的谈判情境，其中一些实验甚至明确旨在检验纳什提出的理论预测。

Query_Text_en: 2 However , none of these experiments corresponded closely to the conditions assumed by Nash s theory or measured those attributes of the bargainers that the theory predicted would influence the outcome of bargaining .
Translation: 然而，这些实验都未能与纳什理论所假设的条件紧密对应，也未能测量理论所预测会影响谈判结果的谈判者属性。

Query_Text_en: This was largely because , taken literally , Nash s theory applies to bargaining under conditions unlikely to obtain in natural bargaining situations and depends on attributes of the bargainers that are difficult to measure .
Translation: 这主要是因为，若按字面理解，纳什理论适用于一些在实际谈判中难以出现的条件，并且依赖于谈判者一些难以衡量的特质。

Query_Text_en: In particular, Nash theory assumes that bargainers can obtain information contained in the utility function of others' expectations (i.e., each bargainer's preference and risk attitude) and that the bargaining results obtained by Nash theory depend on this information.
Translation: 特别是，纳什理论假设谈判者能够获取包含在其他人效用函数中的信息（即每个谈判者的偏好和风险态度），而纳什理论得出的谈判结果也取决于这些信息。

Query_Text_en: Some of the earlier experimenters had elected to examine bargaining under conditions they believed more closely approximated natural situations , and all had assumed , for the purpose of obtaining predictions from Nash s theory , that the preferences of all bargainers were identical and risk neutral .
Translation: 一些早期的实验者选择在他们认为更接近自然情境的条件下研究谈判，并且所有人都假定，为了从纳什理论中获得预测，所有谈判者的偏好都是相同且风险中性的。

Query_Text_en: Important aspects of the predictions of the theory obtained in this way were disconfirmed by the experimental evidence .
Translation: 通过这种方式得出的理论预测的重要方面被实验证据所否定。

Query_Text_en: 3 This evidence , however , was almost uniformly discounted by game theorists , who felt that the results simply reflected a failure to measure the relevant parameters .
Translation: 然而，博弈论学者几乎一致地否定了这些证据，认为这些结果仅仅反映了相关参数测量的不准确。

Query_Text_en: Nash s theory , after all , is a theory that predicts that the preferences and risk aversion of the bargainers exercise a decisive influence on the outcome of bargaining [ and , furthermore , that these are the only personal attributes that can influence the outcome when bargainers are adequately informed ] .
Translation: 纳什的理论毕竟是一种预测谈判者的偏好和风险规避对谈判结果具有决定性影响的理论，并且进一步指出，在谈判者信息充分的情况下，这两者是唯一能够影响谈判结果的个人属性。

Query_Text_en: If the predictions made by Nash s theory under the assumption that bargainers had identical and risk - neutral preferences were disconfirmed , this merely disconfirmed the assumption .
Translation: 如果在纳什理论中，假设谈判者具有相同且风险中性的偏好，而由此得出的预测未被证实，这仅仅是对该假设本身的否定。

Query_Text_en: The theory itself had yet to be tested .
Translation: 该理论本身尚未经过检验。

Query_Text_en: It was therefore clear that , in order to provide a test of the theory that would withstand the scrutiny of theorists ,4 an experiment would have to either measure or control for the differences among individuals in their willingness to bear risks .
Translation: 因此，为了提供一个能够经受理论家审查的理论检验，实验必须要能够测量或控制个体在承担风险意愿上的差异。

Query_Text_en: Such experiments would make it possible to test for the first time whether these differences influenced the outcome of bargaining in the manner predicted and whether they were the attributes of the bargainers that were the most important explanatory variables .
Translation: 这样的实验将首次使人们能够检验这些差异是否如预测那样影响了谈判结果，以及这些差异是否是谈判者最重要的解释变量。

Query_Text_en: In the intervening years , my colleagues and I have conducted a series of experiments concerned with these issues .
Translation: 在此期间，我和我的同事们围绕这些问题开展了一系列实验。

Query_Text_en: The first of these [ Roth and Malouf , 1979 ] employed a design in which individual differences in risk aversion were controlled for , and the most recently completed [ Murnighan , Roth , and Schoumaker , 1986 ] employed a design in which these differences were measured .
Translation: 第一项研究（Roth 和 Malouf，1979）采用了控制个体风险厌恶差异的设计，而最新完成的研究（Murnighan、Roth 和 Schoumaker，1986）则采用了测量这些差异的设计。

Query_Text_en: It would not have been possible to plan from the outset or even to anticipate the need for each experiment in this series . But the results of each raised questions and suggested new hypotheses that guided the design of subsequent experiments .
Translation: 在这一系列实验中，无法从一开始就进行全面规划，甚至无法预见每项实验的必要性。然而，每一次实验的结果都引发了新的问题，并提出了新的假设，从而指导了后续实验的设计。

Query_Text_en: It was sometimes necessary to develop the implications 3 Although the qualitative predictions about which bargainer would do better were sometimes supported . 4 Among whom I am happily prepared to be counted , at least part time . of the theory further before a particular experiment could be designed and to reassess , in the light of subsequent experiments , what had been learned from earlier ones .
Translation: 有时有必要进一步发展理论的含义，以便在设计具体实验之前进行深入探讨，并在后续实验的基础上重新评估从早期实验中获得的经验。尽管关于哪一方谈判者表现更好的定性预测有时得到了支持，我本人也乐于被归入这一行列，至少是兼职。

Query_Text_en: Sometimes unanticipated regularities were serendipitously observed .
Translation: 有时会偶然发现一些意想不到的规律。

Query_Text_en: One purpose of this chapter is to shed some light on this process .
Translation: 本章的一个目的就是对这一过程进行阐释。

Query_Text_en: Only in the most recently completed experiment have we finally been able to test directly whether differences in individuals risk aversion influence the outcome of bargaining in the manner predicted by Nash s theory .
Translation: 直到最近完成的实验中，我们才终于能够直接检验个人风险厌恶程度的差异是否会像纳什理论所预测的那样影响谈判结果。

Query_Text_en: It turns out that these predictions are quite robust , in the sense that virtually all of the standard economic theories of bargaining make the same qualitative predictions about differences in risk aversion .
Translation: 事实证明，这些预测相当可靠，因为几乎所有标准的经济谈判理论对风险厌恶差异都得出了相同的定性预测。

Query_Text_en: The experimental results support these predictions .
Translation: 实验结果证实了这些预测。

Query_Text_en: However , the overwhelming evidence of all the experiments taken together points to the conclusion that some of the most important bargaining phenomena are neither predicted nor easily accommodated by such theories .
Translation: 然而，所有实验的综合性压倒性证据表明，一些最重要的谈判现象既未被此类理论预测，也难以被其解释。

Query_Text_en: As a theorist , I am inclined to believe that entirely new classes of theories will have to be explored .
Translation: 作为一名理论家，我倾向于认为必须探索全新的理论范畴。

Query_Text_en: A second purpose of this chapter is to try to present in a coherent fashion the phenomena that have led me to this conclusion .
Translation: 本章的另一个目的是试图以连贯的方式呈现促使我得出这一结论的相关现象。

Query_Text_en: The various experiments described in this chapter that are closely related to theory are essentially a # point of continuous dialogue. With the accumulation of experimental evidence on systematic bargaining, the direction of theoretical development has become clearer, and theoretical development has raised questions for experimental research.
Translation: 本章所述与理论密切相关的各项实验，实质上构成了持续对话的一个关键环节。随着关于系统性议价的实验证据不断积累，理论发展的方向变得更加明晰，而理论的发展也为实验研究提出了新的问题。

Query_Text_en: No long-term experimental agenda [ at least none that I can formulate ] would be likely to survive intact the unanticipated developments that are characteristic of this kind of work .
Translation: 任何长期的实验计划（至少我无法制定出这样的计划）都难以在这类工作的不可预见发展面前保持原样。

Query_Text_en: At the same time , new directions in the evolving theory of bargaining raise new questions and may cause us to interpret some of the empirical evidence in a new way .
Translation: 与此同时，博弈理论的发展带来了新的研究方向，也提出了新的问题，这可能促使我们以新的视角解读部分实证证据。

Query_Text_en: Undoubtedly , new directions for experimental investigation will arise from the modern body of theory that has focused on the problem of bargaining when time is of the essence .
Translation: 毫无疑问，随着现代理论体系将研究重点放在时间至关重要的谈判问题上，实验研究的新方向也将由此产生。

Query_Text_en: This work , which traces its recent inspiration to the influential 1982 paper of Rubinstein , models bargaining in environments in which bargaining is costly in the sense that negotiation takes time [ but may continue indefinitely ] , consumption does not occur until agreement takes place , and future payoffs are discounted relative to present payoffs .
Translation: 这项工作以鲁宾斯坦1982年具有影响力的论文为近期灵感，建立了一个模型，描述在谈判具有成本的环境下的谈判过程：谈判需要时间（但可能无限持续），只有达成协议后才能进行消费，且未来收益相较于当前收益会被折现。

Query_Text_en: Some preliminary experiments have been carried out by these models, which are not the same bargaining environment as the models discussed in this chapter, which are constructed without considering the cost of delays and are generally considered to be negotiated over a fixed period of time, and bargaining benefits can be obtained over a fixed period of time (e.g., labor negotiations that occur before the expiration of an existing contract fall into this category). A better understanding of bargaining in one type of environment will help to clarify the problems in another.
Translation: 这些模型已经进行了初步实验，但其所处的谈判环境与本章讨论的模型并不相同。这些模型在构建时未考虑延迟成本，通常假定谈判在固定期限内进行，且谈判收益也只能在固定期限内获得（例如，现有合同到期前进行的劳资谈判就属于此类）。深入理解某一类型环境下的谈判，有助于厘清另一类型环境中的问题。

Query_Text_en: For example, when the time cost per second is high and the negotiation time is indefinite, an understanding of the time effect of the deadline will help to understand the time effect of the deadline, as discussed in section 2.3.3.
Translation: 例如，当每秒的时间成本较高且谈判时间不确定时，理解最后期限的时间效应将有助于把握最后期限的时间影响，正如第2.3.3节所讨论的那样。

Query_Text_en: It is also not hard to anticipate additional experiments designed to elucidate some of the experimental observations discussed in this chapter .
Translation: 我们也不难预见，将会有更多实验被设计出来，以阐明本章讨论的一些实验现象。

Query_Text_en: For example , the bimodal distribution of agreements dis Some earlier results for a related finite horizon model are those of Stahl [ 1972 ] . For a collection of papers on modern directions in the theory of bargaining , see Roth [ 1985b ] . See Binmore , Shaked , and Sutton [ 1985 ] and Neelin , Sonnenschein , and Spiegel [ 1986 ] , who oifer contradictory conclusions based on preliminary evidence . Discussed in Section 2 . 3 . 3 and the fact that this seems related to players expectations about what constitutes a credible agreement [ recall Section 2 . 3 . 4 ] suggest that credible bargaining positions play a substantial role in the negotiations we have observed .
Translation: 例如，协议的双峰分布——部分早期关于相关有限期模型的研究成果见Stahl [1972]。关于现代谈判理论方向的论文集，可参见Roth [1985b]。Binmore、Shaked和Sutton [1985]以及Neelin、Sonnenschein和Spiegel [1986]基于初步证据提出了相互矛盾的结论。相关内容在第2.3.3节中进行了讨论，而这一现象似乎与参与者对何为可信协议的预期有关[参见第2.3.4节]，这表明在我们观察到的谈判过程中，可信的谈判立场发挥了重要作用。

Query_Text_en: However , little is known either about how credible positions are established or about how , once established , they influence the outcome of negotiations .
Translation: 然而，关于可信立场是如何确立的，以及一旦确立后这些立场如何影响谈判结果，目前知之甚少。

Query_Text_en: [ For example , does the distance between the two bargainers negotiating positions influence the frequency of disagreement ?
Translation: 例如，两位谈判者的立场之间的距离是否会影响分歧发生的频率？

Query_Text_en: Preliminary evidence indicates that it does ; see Roth , 1985c . Similarly , I have already commented on the need for more experiments concerned with the effects of risk aversion and with the deadline effect .
Translation: 初步证据表明确实如此，参见Roth，1985c。同样，我此前也已指出，需要开展更多关于风险厌恶效应和截止期限效应的实验。

Query_Text_en: The most exciting source of new experiments may well arise from new theory that is able to explain how some of these experimentally observed phenomena are related to one another .
Translation: 最令人振奋的新实验来源，很可能是能够解释这些实验现象之间相互关联的新理论。

Query_Text_en: We are not so far from having theoretical models that will display many of the phenomena discussed here .
Translation: 我们距离拥有能够展示本文所讨论诸多现象的理论模型，已经不再遥远。

Query_Text_en: Such a model [ or , better yet , several such models ] would give us a source of testable hypotheses about how , say , the risk aversion of bargainers is related to the frequency with which they disagree or to the manner in which they react to an approaching deadline .
Translation: 这样的模型（或者更好的是，多个这样的模型）能够为我们提供可检验的假设，例如，谈判者的风险厌恶程度如何与他们发生分歧的频率，或他们对临近截止日期时的反应方式相关联。

Query_Text_en: The results of these experiments would in turn help us select among existing theories and suggest further observable regularities on which new theory might be built .
Translation: 这些实验结果将有助于我们在现有理论中进行选择，并提出更多可观察的规律，为新理论的建立提供基础。

Query_Text_en: This kind of interaction between theory and experimentation has the potential to change the way theory is developed in economics , and this largely untapped potential represents one of the most exciting prospects for the long-term role of laboratory experimentation in the discipline .
Translation: 理论与实验之间的这种互动有可能改变经济学理论的发展方式，而这种尚未被充分挖掘的潜力，正是实验室实验在该学科中长期作用最令人振奋的前景之一。

Query_Text_en: Equity and coalition bargaining in experimental three-person games REINHARDSELTEN 3 . 1 Introduction Games in characteristic function form were introduced by von Neumann and Morgenstern [ 1944 ] . Laboratory experiments on such games have led to descriptive theories of coalition bargaining . No theory proposed up to now is completely satisfactory in light of the data . However , the evidence clearly suggests that equity considerations have a strong influence on observed payoff divisions .
Translation:
实验性三人博弈中的公平与联盟谈判  
REINHARD SELTEN

3.1 引言  
特征函数形式的博弈由冯·诺伊曼和摩根斯坦于1944年提出。针对此类博弈的实验室研究推动了联盟谈判的描述性理论发展。迄今为止，尚无任何理论能够完全令人满意地解释实验数据。然而，证据表明，公平因素对实际收益分配具有显著影响。

Query_Text_en: The purpose of this chapter is to elucidate this phenomenon .
Translation: 本章旨在阐明这一现象。

Query_Text_en: The formal structure of equity considerations can be expressed by an equity principle , which is explained in Section 3 . 2 . This principle is well known in the social psychology literature [ Homans , 1961 ;
Translation: 公平性考量的正式结构可以通过一个公平性原则来表达，这将在第3.2节中进行解释。该原则在社会心理学文献中广为人知 [Homans, 1961；

Query_Text_en: Harris , 1976 ; Mikula , 1980 ] . The terminology used here is based on a paper published elsewhere [ Selten , 1978 ] . To some extent the influence of equity considerations on the behavior of subjects in coalition experiments may be due to the subjects desire to conform to social norms .
Translation: Harris（1976）；Mikula（1980）。此处所用术语参考了另一篇已发表的论文 [Selten，1978]。在一定程度上，联盟实验中受试者行为受到公平性考量的影响，可能源于他们希望遵循社会规范的愿望。

Query_Text_en: However , a different explanation of the phenomenon seems to be more adequate for most of the experimental results .
Translation: 然而，对于大多数实验结果来说，另一种对该现象的解释似乎更为恰当。

Query_Text_en: In a unanimity game where the players can either all agree on the division of a fixed sum of money or else end up with zero payoffs for everyone , the inherent symmetry of the situation points to equal shares for all players .
Translation: 在一个一致性博弈中，玩家要么全部同意对固定金额的分配，否则所有人都将一无所获，这种情境的内在对称性意味着所有玩家应获得均等份额。

Query_Text_en: Clearly , in this case an equal payoff division does not in any way contradict the assumption that the players are exclusively motivated by their own payoffs .
Translation: 显然，在这种情况下，均分收益并不违背参与者只关心自身收益的假设。

Query_Text_en: In many experimental coalition games , obvious differences in the profitability of coalition opportunities immediately establish a ranking of the players with respect to their strength .
Translation: 在许多实验性联盟博弈中，联盟机会的盈利能力存在明显差异，这些差异会立即确立玩家在实力上的排名。

Query_Text_en: Clearly , the strongest player can expect at least his equitable share .
Translation: 显然，最强的参与者至少可以获得其应得的公平份额。

Query_Text_en: In this way equitable shares can serve as upper or lower bounds of payoff expectations .
Translation: 通过这种方式，公平份额可以作为收益预期的上限或下限。

Query_Text_en: It is unreasonable to suppose that experimental subjects perform complicated mathematical operations in an attempt to understand the strategic structure of the situation .
Translation: 认为实验对象会通过复杂的数学运算来理解情境的战略结构，这是不合理的。

Query_Text_en: Chapter 1 Utility Theory It is not the purpose here to develop the concept of utility completely or with the most generality . Nor are the results derived from the most primitive set of assumptions . All of this can be found in standard textbooks on microeconomics or game theory . Here rigor is tempered with an eye for simplicity of presentation .
Translation:
第一章 效用理论

本章并不旨在对效用概念进行全面或最一般性的阐述，也不是基于最原始的假设集合推导相关结论。这些内容在标准的微观经济学或博弈论教材中均有详细论述。本文在保证严谨性的同时，更注重表述的简明易懂。

Query_Text_en: A utility function is not presumed as a primitive in economic theory . What is assumed is that each consumer can value various possible bundles of consumption goods in terms of his own subjective preferences .
Translation: 效用函数并非经济理论中的原始假设。真正被假定的是，每个消费者都能够根据自身的主观偏好，对各种可能的消费商品组合进行价值判断。

Query_Text_en: For concreteness it is assumed that there are n goods . Exactly what the goods are or what distinguishes separate goods is irrelevant for the development . The reader should have some general idea that will suffice to convey the intuition of the development . Typ ? ically , goods are different consumption items such as wheat or corn . Formally , we often label as distinct goods the consumption of the same physical good at different times or in different states of nature . Usually , in finance we lump all physical goods together into a single consumption commodity distinguished only by the time and state of nature when it is consumed . Quite often this latter distinction is also ignored . This assumption does little damage to the effects of concern in finance namely , the tradeoffs over time and risk . The n vector x denotes a particular bundle or complex of Xi units of good i. Each consumer selects his consumption x from a particular set . We shall always take this set to be convex and closed .
Translation: 为了具体说明，假设有 n 种商品。商品具体是什么，或者区分不同商品的标准，对于理论的发展来说并不重要。读者只需有一个大致的概念，这就足以把理论发展的直觉传达出来。通常，商品是不同的消费品，比如小麦或玉米。在形式上，我们经常把在不同时间或不同自然状态下对同一种实物商品的消费标记为不同的商品。通常，在金融学中，我们把所有实物商品合并为一种单一的消费品，只根据消费发生的时间和自然状态来区分。实际上，这后一种区分也常常被忽略。这一假设对金融学中关注的效果——即时间和风险上的权衡——几乎没有影响。n 维向量 x 表示一个特定的商品组合，即第 i 种商品的 Xi 单位。每个消费者从某个特定集合中选择自己的消费 x。我们总是假定这个集合是凸的且闭合的。

Query_Text_en: Preferences are described by the preordering relation 3 . The statement is read x is weakly preferred to z or x is as good as z. This preordering also induces the related concepts of strict preference and indifference which are defined as and read as x is [ strictly ] preferred to z and x is equivalent to z. The following properties of the preordering are assumed .
Translation: 偏好由预序关系3来描述。该陈述的含义是x弱优于z，或者说x与z一样好。这个预序关系还引出了相关的严格偏好和无差异的概念，分别定义为x[严格]优于z和x等同于z。假定该预序关系具有以下性质。

Query_Text_en: Axioms are supposed to be self-evident truths . The reflexivity axiom certainly is . The completeness axiom would also appear to be ; however , when choices are made under un ? certainty , many commonly used preference functions do not provide complete orderings over all possible choices . [ See , for example , the discussion of the St. Petersburg paradox later in this chapter . The transitivity axiom also seems intuitive , although among certain choices , each with many distinct attributes , we could imagine comparisons that were not transitive , as illustrated by Arrow s famous voter paradox . This issue does not loom large in finance where comparisons are most often one dimensional .

The reason for this assumption is that in its absence it is possible to construct lotteries which can not be ordered by their expected utility even in cases when one of the lotteries strictly dominates another . Query_Text_en: In finance we are often concerned with a consumer s intertemporal allocation of his wealth to consumption . All of the mechanics required to handle this problem have already been developed . Good i at each point of time is considered as distinct for the purpose of mea ? suring utility . So with n goods and T time periods , the ordinal or cardinal utility functions have n times T arguments . All of the previous analysis remains valid .
Translation: 在金融学中，我们经常关注消费者如何在不同时期分配其财富用于消费。处理这个问题所需的所有机制已经被开发出来。在衡量效用时，每一时点的商品i都被视为不同的商品。因此，若有n种商品和T个时间段，则序数或基数效用函数将有n乘以T个变量。之前的所有分析依然适用。

Query_Text_en: Finance is the study of how to make trade-offs between the present and the future.
Translation: 金融研究的是如何在当前与未来之间做出权衡。

Query_Text_en: For an individual investor , an investment in the debt or equity markets means giving up something today to gain something in the future .
Translation: 对于个人投资者而言，投资于债券或股票市场意味着放弃当下的某些东西，以期在未来获得回报。

Query_Text_en: For a corporate investment in a factory , machinery , or an advertising campaign , there is a similar sense of giving up something today to gain something in the future .
Translation: 对于企业在工厂、机械或广告活动上的投资，同样存在着为了未来的收益而在今天做出某种牺牲的观念。

Query_Text_en: The decisions of individual investors and corporations are intimately linked .
Translation: 个人投资者与企业的决策密切相关。

Query_Text_en: To grow and prosper by virtue of wise investments in factories , machinery , advertising campaigns , and so forth , most firms require access to capital markets .
Translation: 为了通过对工厂、机械、广告活动等进行明智投资实现增长和繁荣，大多数企业都需要进入资本市场。

Query_Text_en: Capital markets are an arena in which firms and other institutions that require funds to finance their operations come together with individuals and institutions that have money to invest .
Translation: 资本市场是企业及其他需要资金以支持运营的机构，与拥有资金并希望进行投资的个人和机构汇聚的场所。

Query_Text_en: To invest wisely , both individuals and firms must have a thorough understanding of these capital markets .
Translation: 无论是个人还是企业，要进行明智的投资，都必须对这些资本市场有深入的了解。

Query_Text_en: Capital markets have grown in complexity and importance over the past 25 years .
Translation: 在过去25年里，资本市场的复杂性和重要性不断提升。

Query_Text_en: As a result , the level of sophistication required by corporate financial managers has also grown .
Translation: 因此，对企业财务管理者所需的专业水平也提出了更高的要求。

Query_Text_en: The amount of capital raised in external markets has increased dramatically , with an ever-increasing variety of available financial instruments .
Translation: 在外部市场筹集的资金规模大幅增长，可用的金融工具种类也日益丰富。

Query_Text_en: Moreover , the financial markets have become truly global with thousands of securities trading around the clock throughout the world .
Translation: 此外，金融市场已经实现了真正的全球化，全球范围内有成千上万种证券全天候交易。

Query_Text_en: To be a player in modem business requires a sophisticated understanding of the new , yet ever-changing institutional framework in which financing takes place .
Translation: 要在现代商业中占有一席之地，必须对融资所处的新型且不断变化的制度框架有深入的理解。

Query_Text_en: As a beginning , this chapter describes the workings of the capital markets and the general decisions that firms face when they raise funds .
Translation: 作为开篇，本章介绍了资本市场的运作机制，以及企业在筹集资金时所面临的一般决策。

Query_Text_en: Specifically , this chapter focuses on the classes of securities that firms issue , the role played by investment banks in raising capital , the environment in which capital is raised , and the differences between the U. S. financial systems and the financial systems in other countries .
Translation: 本章重点讨论企业发行的各类证券、投资银行在筹集资金过程中所扮演的角色、资本募集所处的环境，以及美国金融体系与其他国家金融体系之间的差异。

Query_Text_en: It concludes with a discussion of current trends in the raising of capital .
Translation: 最后，文章对当前资本筹集的趋势进行了讨论。

Query_Text_en: Financing the Firm Households , firms , financial intermediaries , and government all play a role in the financial system of every developed economy .
Translation:
为企业融资

在所有发达经济体的金融体系中，家庭、企业、金融中介机构和政府都发挥着重要作用。

Query_Text_en: Financial intermediaries are institutions such as banks that collect the savings of individuals and corporations and funnel them to firms that use the money to finance their investments in plant , equipment , research and development , and so forth .
Translation: 金融中介机构是指银行等机构，它们收集个人和企业的储蓄，并将这些资金输送给需要用于厂房、设备、研发等投资的企业。

Query_Text_en: Some of the most important financial intermediaries are described in Exhibit 1 . 1 . In addition to financing firms indirectly through financial intermediaries , households finance firms directly by individually buying and holding stocks and bonds .
Translation: 部分最重要的金融中介机构如图表1.1所示。除了通过金融中介机构间接为企业融资外，家庭还通过个人购买和持有股票及债券的方式，直接为企业融资。

Query_Text_en: The government also plays a key role in this process by regulating the capital markets and taxing various financing alternatives .
Translation: 政府在这一过程中同样发挥着关键作用，通过监管资本市场并对各种融资方式征税。

Query_Text_en: Decisions Facing the Firm Firms can raise investment capital from many sources with a variety of financial instruments .
Translation:
企业面临的决策

企业可以通过多种金融工具，从多种渠道筹集投资资金。

Query_Text_en: The firm s financial policy describes the mix of financial instruments used to finance the firm .
Translation: 公司的财务政策描述了用于为公司融资的各类金融工具的组合。

Query_Text_en: Internal Capital . Firms raise capital internally by retaining the earnings they generate and by obtaining external funds from the capital markets .
Translation: 内部资本。企业通过保留自身产生的利润以及从资本市场获取外部资金来筹集资本。

Query_Text_en: Exhibit 1 . 2 shows that , in the aggregate , the percentage of total investment funds that U. S. firms generate internallyһessentially retained earnings plus depreciationһis generally in the 40-80 percent range .
Translation: 图表1.2显示，总体而言，美国公司通过内部产生的投资资金（主要是留存收益加上折旧）所占的比例通常在40%到80%之间。

Query_Text_en: Thus , internal cash flows are typically insufficient to meet the total capital needs of most firms .
Translation: 因此，大多数公司的内部现金流通常不足以满足其全部资本需求。

Query_Text_en: Debt vs. Equity . When a firm determines that it needs external funds , as Amazon did [ as described in the opening vignette ] , it must gain access to capital markets and make a decision about the type of funds to raise .
Translation: 债务与股权。当一家企业确定需要外部资金时，如亚马逊在开篇案例中所述，它必须进入资本市场，并就筹集何种类型的资金作出决策。

Query_Text_en: debt and equity , as well as the major forms .
Translation: 债务和股权，以及主要形式。

Query_Text_en: In the 1980s , the aggregate amount of debt financing relative to equity financing , with debt and equity measured in book value terms , increased substantially .
Translation: 20世纪80年代，以账面价值计量的债务融资与股权融资的总量之比大幅上升。

Query_Text_en: Countless writers in the business press , as well as countless politicians , have interpreted this to mean that firms were replacing equity financing with debt financing in the 1980s .
Translation: 无数商业媒体的撰稿人以及众多政界人士都将此解读为，20世纪80年代企业正在用债务融资取代股权融资。

Query_Text_en: This interpretation is somewhat misleading .
Translation: 这种解读有些误导性。

Query_Text_en: Firms retired a substantial number of shares in the 1980s , through either repurchases of their own shares or the purchases of other firms shares in takeovers . Far more shares were retired than were issued .
Translation: 20世纪80年代，企业通过回购自身股票或在并购中购买其他公司的股票，注销了大量股份。注销的股份数量远远超过了新发行的股份数量。

Query_Text_en: However , offsetting these share repurchases was an unprecedented boom in the stock market that substantially increased the market value of existing shares .
Translation: 然而，与这些股票回购相抵的是，股市出现了前所未有的繁荣，显著提升了现有股票的市值。

Query_Text_en: As a result , firms were able to retire shares and issue debt without increasing their debt\/equity ratios , expressed in market value , above their pre-1980 levels .
Translation: 因此，各公司能够回购股票并发行债券，而不会使以市值计算的债务/股本比率高于1980年前的水平。

Query_Text_en: As Exhibit 1 . 4 illustrates , using market values , the ratio of debt to equity remained relatively constant in the 1980s .
Translation: 如图1.4所示，以市场价值计算，20世纪80年代的债务与股本比率基本保持稳定。

Query_Text_en: Public and Private Sources of Capital Firms raise debt and equity capital from both public and private sources . Capital raised from public sources must be in the form of registered securities . Securities are publicly traded financial instruments .
Translation:
资本的公共与私人来源  
企业通过公共和私人渠道筹集债务和股权资本。通过公共渠道筹集的资本必须以注册证券的形式进行。证券是公开交易的金融工具。

Query_Text_en: In the United States , most securities must be registered with the Securities and Exchange Commission [ SEC ] , the government agency established in 1934 to regulate the securities markets .
Translation: 在美国，大多数证券必须在证券交易委员会（SEC）注册。该委员会是于1934年设立的政府机构，负责监管证券市场。

Query_Text_en: Public securities differ from private financial instruments because they can be traded on public secondary markets like the New York Stock Exchange or the American Stock Exchange , which are two institutions that facilitate the trading of public securities .
Translation: 公共证券与私人金融工具不同，因为它们可以在纽约证券交易所或美国证券交易所等公共二级市场进行交易，这两家机构为公共证券的交易提供了便利。

Query_Text_en: which are two institutions that facilitate the trading of public securities .
Translation: 两家促进公开证券交易的机构是证券交易所和证券经纪公司。

Query_Text_en: Publicly traded securities include common stock, preferred stock, and corporate bonds. Funds raised from the private market are mainly in the form of bank loans or so-called private placements.
Translation: 公开交易的证券包括普通股、优先股和公司债券。从私募市场筹集的资金主要以银行贷款或所谓的私募方式进行。

Query_Text_en: Private capital are financial claims exempted from the registration requirements that apply to securities .
Translation: 私募资本是指免于适用证券登记要求的金融权益。

Query_Text_en: To qualify for this private placement exemption , the issue must be restricted to a small group of sophisticated investorsһfewer than 35 in numberһwith minimum income or wealth requirements .
Translation: 要符合本次私募豁免的条件，发行对象必须限定在一小部分具备专业知识的投资者（人数不得超过35人），并且需满足最低收入或财富要求。

Query_Text_en: They also include venture capital firms , as noted in Exhibit 1 . 1 . Financial instruments that have been privately placed can not be sold on public markets unless they are registered with the SEC , in which case they become securities .
Translation: 如图表1.1所示，其中还包括风险投资公司。私下发行的金融工具，除非在美国证券交易委员会（SEC）注册，否则不得在公开市场上出售；一旦注册，这些工具就成为证券。

Query_Text_en: However , Rule 144A , adopted in 1990 , allows institutions with assets exceeding $ 100 million to trade privately placed financial claims among themselves without first registering them as securities .
Translation: 然而，1990年出台的144A规则允许资产超过1亿美元的机构在彼此之间交易私募金融权益，而无需事先将其注册为证券。

Query_Text_en: Public markets tend to be anonymous ; that is , buyers and sellers can complete their transactions without knowing each others identities . Because of the anonymous nature of trades on this market , uninformed investors run the risk of trading with other investors who are vastly more informed because they have inside information about a particular company and can make a profit from it .
Translation: 公开市场通常具有匿名性，也就是说，买卖双方可以在不知晓彼此身份的情况下完成交易。由于该市场交易的匿名特征，信息不充分的投资者有可能与掌握大量内幕信息的投资者进行交易，后者能够利用这些信息获利，从而使前者面临风险。

Query_Text_en: However , insider trading is illegal and uninformed investors are at least partially protected by laws that prevent investors from buying or selling public securities based on inside information , which is internal company information that has not been made public .
Translation: 然而，内幕交易是非法的，且不知情投资者至少在一定程度上受到相关法律的保护，这些法律禁止投资者基于尚未公开的公司内部信息买卖公开证券。

Query_Text_en: The interests of investors who do not have access to such information are thus protected to some extent.
Translation: 因此，在一定程度上保护了无法获得此类信息的投资者利益。

Query_Text_en: In contrast , investors of privately placed debt and equity are allowed to base their decisions on information that is not publicly known .
Translation: 相比之下，私募债券和股权的投资者可以依据非公开信息作出投资决策。

Query_Text_en: Since traders in private markets are assumed to be sophisticated investors who are aware of each others identities , inside information about privately placed securities is not as problematic .
Translation: 由于私人市场的交易者被认为是了解彼此身份的成熟投资者，因此关于私募证券的内部信息问题并不严重。

Query_Text_en: For example , if a potential buyer of a debt instrument has reason to believe that the seller possesses material information that he or she is not disclosing , the buyer can choose not to buy .
Translation: 例如，如果一位潜在的债务工具买方有理由认为卖方掌握了其未披露的重要信息，买方可以选择不购买。

Query_Text_en: If the seller misrepresents this information , the buyer can later sue .
Translation: 如果卖方对该信息作出虚假陈述，买方日后可以提起诉讼。

Query_Text_en: Because private markets are not anonymous , they generally are less liquid ;that is , the transaction costs associated with buying and selling private debt and equity are generally much higher than the costs of buying and selling public securities .
Translation: 由于私人市场并非匿名，因此通常流动性较低；也就是说，买卖私人债务和股权的交易成本通常远高于买卖公开证券的成本。

Query_Text_en: Result 1 . 2 summarizes the advantages and disadvantages of private placements .
Translation: 结果1.2总结了私募发行的优缺点。

Query_Text_en: Corporations raise capital from both private and public sources . Some advantages associated with private sources are as follows : Terms of private bonds and stock can be customized for individual investors .
Translation: 企业可以通过私人和公共渠道筹集资金。私人渠道的优势包括：私募债券和股票的条款可以根据个别投资者的需求进行定制。

Query_Text_en: No costly registration with the SEC .
Translation: 无需昂贵的美国证监会注册手续。

Query_Text_en: No need to reveal confidential information .
Translation: 无需透露任何机密信息。

Query_Text_en: Easier to renegotiate .
Translation: 更易于重新谈判。

Query_Text_en: Limited investor base .
Translation: 投资者基础有限。

Query_Text_en: Less liquid .
Translation: 流动性较低。

Query_Text_en: Depending on the state of the market , about 70 percent of debt offerings are made to the public , and about 30 percent are private placements .
Translation: 根据市场状况，大约70%的债券发行面向公众，约30%为私募发行。

Query_Text_en: In some years , private debt offerings can top 40 percent of the market .
Translation: 在某些年份，私人债务发行在市场中的占比甚至超过40%。

Query_Text_en: In contrast , private equity placements have averaged about 20 percent of the new capital raised in the equity market .
Translation: 相比之下，私募股权融资在股权市场新募集资金中平均占比约为20%。

Query_Text_en: Corporations can raise funds directly from banks , insurance companies , and other sources of private capital without going through investment banks .
Translation: 企业可以直接从银行、保险公司及其他私人资本来源筹集资金，无需通过投资银行。

Query_Text_en: However , corporations generally need the services of investment banks when they issue public securities .
Translation: 然而，企业在发行公开证券时通常需要投资银行提供服务。

Query_Text_en: This will be discussed in the next section .
Translation: 这一问题将在下一部分进行讨论。

Query_Text_en: 1 . 3 The Environment for Raising Capital in the United States The Legal Environment A myriad of regulations govern public debt and equity issues .
Translation:
1.3 美国资本募集环境  
法律环境  
众多法规对公开债务和股权发行进行监管。

Query_Text_en: These regulations certainly increase the costs of issuing public securities , but they also provide protection for investors which enhances the value of the securities .
Translation: 这些法规确实增加了公开发行证券的成本，但它们也为投资者提供了保护，从而提升了证券的价值。

Query_Text_en: The value of these regulations can be illustrated by contrasting the situation in Western Europe and the United States , where markets are highly regulated , to the situation in some of the emerging markets , which are much less regulated .
Translation: 这些监管措施的价值，可以通过对比高度监管的西欧和美国市场与监管较少的新兴市场的情况来加以说明。

Query_Text_en: A major risk in the emerging markets is that shareholder rights will not be respected and , as a result , many stocks traded in these markets sell for substantially less than the value of their assets .
Translation: 新兴市场面临的一个主要风险是股东权益得不到尊重，因此，这些市场上许多股票的交易价格远低于其资产价值。

Query_Text_en: In emerging market countries, shareholder rights are often not respected, so shares are often sold at prices well below their actual asset value, which is a significant risk.
Translation: 在新兴市场国家，股东权益往往得不到尊重，因此股票常常以远低于其实际资产价值的价格出售，这构成了重大风险。

Query_Text_en: 4 At about the same time , Royal Dutch\/Shell , with about 17 billion barrels of reserves , had a market value of $ 94 billion in 1995 making its oil worth more than $ 5 a barrel . Lukoil is worth substantially less because of uncertainty about shareholders rights in Russia .
Translation: 大约在同一时期，拥有约170亿桶储量的荷兰皇家壳牌公司在1995年的市值为940亿美元，这使得其石油每桶价值超过5美元。卢克石油公司的价值则大大低于这一水平，原因在于俄罗斯股东权益的不确定性。

Query_Text_en: Although economists and policymakers may argue about the optimal level of regulation , most prefer the more highly regulated U. S. environment to that in the emerging markets where shareholder rights are usually not as well defined .
Translation: 尽管经济学家和政策制定者可能会对监管的最佳程度存在争议，但大多数人还是更倾向于高度监管的美国环境，而不是新兴市场，因为后者的股东权利通常界定不够明确。

Query_Text_en: Although government regulations play an important role for securities issued in the United States , this was not always so .
Translation: 尽管政府监管在美国发行的证券中发挥着重要作用，但情况并非一直如此。

Query_Text_en: Regulation in the United States expanded substantially in the 1930s because of charges of stock price manipulation that came in the wake of the 1929 stock market crash .
Translation: 由于1929年股市崩盘后出现了关于股价操纵的指控，20世纪30年代美国的监管大幅加强。

Query_Text_en: Congress enacted several pieces of legislation that radically altered the landscape for firms issuing securities .
Translation: 国会通过了多项立法，从根本上改变了发行证券企业的环境。

Query_Text_en: The three most important pieces of legislation were the Securities Act of 1933 , the Securities Exchange Act of 1934 and the Banking Act of 1933 [ commonly called the Glass-Steagall Act after the two congressmen who sponsored it ] .
Translation: 最重要的三项立法是《1933年证券法》、《1934年证券交易法》和《1933年银行法》（通常称为格拉斯-斯蒂格尔法案，以两位提出该法案的国会议员命名）。

Query_Text_en: The Securities Acts of 1933 and 1934 . The Securities Act of 1933 and the Securities Exchange Act of 1934 require registration of all public offerings by firms except short-term instruments [ less than 270 days ] and intrastate offerings .
Translation: 1933年《证券法》和1934年《证券交易法》要求企业的所有公开发行必须进行注册，唯有期限不足270天的短期工具和州内发行除外。

Query_Text_en: Specifically , the acts require that companies file a registration statement with the SEC .
Translation: 具体而言，这些法案要求公司向美国证券交易委员会提交注册声明。

Query_Text_en: General information about the firm and detailed financial data .
Translation: 公司基本信息及详细财务数据。

Query_Text_en: A description of the security being issued .
Translation: 所发行证券的说明。

Query_Text_en: The agreement between the investment bank that acts as the underwriter , who originates and distributes the issue and the issuing firm .
Translation: 投资银行作为承销商，负责发起和分销发行，与发行公司之间达成的协议。

Query_Text_en: The composition of the underwriting syndicate , a group of banks that sell the issue .
Translation: 承销团的组成，即负责发行销售的一组银行。

Query_Text_en: Most of the information in the registration statement must be made available to investors in the form of a prospectus , a printed document that includes information about the security and the firm .
Translation: 注册声明中的大部分信息必须以招股说明书的形式向投资者公开，招股说明书是一份包含有关证券及公司信息的印刷文件。

Query_Text_en: The prospectus is widely distributed before the sale of the securities and bears the dire warning , printed in red ink , that the securities have not yet been approved for sale .
Translation: 在证券发售前，招股说明书被广泛分发，并以红色字体印有严正警告，指出这些证券尚未获准销售。

Query_Text_en: Once filed with the SEC , registration statements do not become effective for 20 days , the so-called cooling off period during which selling the stock is prohibited .
Translation: 一旦向美国证券交易委员会（SEC）提交注册声明，该声明将在20天后才会生效，这一期间被称为“冷静期”，在此期间禁止出售股票。

Query_Text_en: If the SEC determines that the registration statement is complete , they approve it or make it effective .
Translation: 如果美国证券交易委员会认定注册声明已完整，他们将予以批准或使其生效。

Query_Text_en: If , however , the registration exhibits egregious flaws , the SEC requires that the firm fix it .
Translation: 然而，如果注册文件存在严重缺陷，证监会要求企业进行整改。

Query_Text_en: Once the SEC approves the registration statement , the underwriter is free to start selling the securities in what is known as the primary offering .
Translation: 一旦美国证券交易委员会批准注册声明，承销商便可开始进行证券的首次发行，即所谓的初级发行。

Query_Text_en: The SEC s approval of the registration statement is not an endorsement of the security , but simply an affirmation that the firm has met the disclosure requirements of the 1933 act .
Translation: 美国证券交易委员会对注册声明的批准并不代表对该证券的认可，而仅仅表明该公司已符合1933年证券法的信息披露要求。

Query_Text_en: Because all signatories to the registration statement are liable for any misstatements it might contain , the underwriters must investigate the issuing company with due diligence . Due diligence means investigating and disclosing any information that is relevant to investors and providing an audit of the accounting numbers by a certified public accounting firm .
Translation: 由于所有注册声明的签署方都要对其中可能存在的任何虚假陈述承担责任，承销商必须对发行公司进行尽职调查。尽职调查指的是调查并披露所有与投资者相关的信息，并由注册会计师事务所对财务数据进行审计。

Query_Text_en: If material information is not disclosed and the security performs poorly , the underwriters can be sued by investors .
Translation: 如果重大信息未被披露，且该证券表现不佳，承销商可能会被投资者起诉。

Query_Text_en: The Glass-Steagall Act . In the wake of the Depression , Congress enacted the Banking Act of 1933 commonly called the Glass-Steagall Act .
Translation: 《格拉斯-斯蒂格尔法案》。在大萧条之后，国会通过了1933年《银行法》，通常被称为《格拉斯-斯蒂格尔法案》。

Query_Text_en: This legislation changed the landscape of investment banking by requiring banks to divorce their commercial banking activities from their investment banking activities .
Translation: 该立法改变了投资银行业的格局，要求银行将商业银行业务与投资银行业务分离。

Query_Text_en: Glass-Steagall gave rise to many of the modem investment banks , both living and defunct , that most finance professionals are familiar with today .
Translation: 《格拉斯-斯蒂格尔法案》催生了许多现代投资银行，无论是现存的还是已不复存在的，这些银行如今大多数金融从业者都耳熟能详。

Query_Text_en: For instance , the firms of J. P. Morgan , Drexel , and Brown Brothers Harriman opted to abandon underwriting and instead concentrate on private banking for wealthy individuals . Several partners from J. P. Morgan and Drexel decided to form Morgan Stanley , an investment banking firm .
Translation: 例如，摩根公司、德雷克塞尔公司和布朗兄弟哈里曼公司选择放弃承销业务，转而专注于为富有个人提供私人银行服务。摩根公司和德雷克塞尔公司的几位合伙人决定成立摩根士丹利，这是一家投资银行公司。

Query_Text_en: Similarly , the First Boston Corporation , now part of Credit Suisse , is derived from the securities affiliate of the First National Bank of Boston .
Translation: 同样，现已成为瑞士信贷集团一部分的第一波士顿公司，起源于波士顿第一国家银行的证券附属机构。

Query_Text_en: After Glass-Steagall , firms that stayed in the underwriting business were forced to build Chinese walls to separate their underwriting activities from other financial functions .
Translation: 在《格拉斯-斯蒂格尔法案》实施后，仍从事承销业务的公司被迫建立“防火墙”，以将其承销活动与其他金融职能分隔开来。

Query_Text_en: Chinese walls involve structuring a company s procedures to prevent certain types of communication between the corporate side of the bank and the bank s sales and trading sectors .
Translation: “防火墙”指的是通过对公司内部流程进行结构化管理，防止银行企业部门与销售和交易部门之间进行某些类型的信息交流。

Query_Text_en: The underwriting part of these businesses must have no connection with other activities , such as stock recommendations , market making , and institu-tional sales .
Translation: 这些企业的承销业务必须与其他活动，如股票推荐、做市和机构销售等，完全隔离。

Query_Text_en: A Trend toward Deregulation . Roe [ 1994 ] advanced the provocative argument that these three pieces of legislation and others , such as the Investment Company Act of 1940 which regulates mutual funds , and the Bank Holding Company Act of 1956 which allows limited banking mergers , fundamentally altered the role of financial institutions in corporate governance .
Translation: 去监管化趋势。Roe（1994）提出了一个颇具争议的观点，认为这三项立法以及其他相关法律，如规范共同基金的《1940年投资公司法》和允许有限银行合并的《1956年银行控股公司法》，从根本上改变了金融机构在公司治理中的角色。

Query_Text_en: Roe argued that the legislation caused the fragmentation of financial institutions and institutional portfolios , thereby preventing the emergence of powerful large-block shareholders who might exert pressure on management .
Translation: Roe认为，这项立法导致金融机构和机构投资组合的分散，从而阻碍了拥有大量股份的强势股东的出现，这些股东本可能对管理层施加压力。

Query_Text_en: In contrast , countries such Japan and Germany , which do not operate under the same constraints , developed systems in which banks played a much larger role in firms affairs .
Translation: 相比之下，日本和德国等国家并不受同样的限制，因此建立了银行在企业事务中发挥更大作用的体系。

Query_Text_en: Congress and the regulatory agencies , recognizing that U. S. financial institutions are heavily constrained , have started relaxing these constraints .
Translation: 美国国会和监管机构意识到美国金融机构受到严格限制，已开始放宽这些限制。

Query_Text_en: The Glass-Steagall restrictions were repealed with the passage of the Financial Services Modernization Act of 1999 .
Translation: 随着1999年《金融服务现代化法案》的通过，格拉斯-斯蒂格尔法案的相关限制被废除。

Query_Text_en: Commercial and investment banks have been drawing closer to universal banking ; that is , they are beginning to offer a whole range of services from taking deposits to selling securities .
Translation: 商业银行和投资银行正逐步向综合银行模式靠拢，也就是说，它们开始提供从吸收存款到销售证券等全方位的服务。

Query_Text_en: In addition , interstate banking was legalized in 1994 .
Translation: 此外，州际银行业务于1994年被合法化。

Query_Text_en: Because of the fierce competition that these trends will generate , there will almost certainly be fewer commercial and investment banks in the United States in the future .
Translation: 由于这些趋势所带来的激烈竞争，美国未来的商业银行和投资银行数量几乎肯定会减少。

Query_Text_en: Surviving banks will tend to be bigger , better capitalized , and better prepared to serve business firms in creative ways .
Translation: 幸存下来的银行往往规模更大、资本实力更雄厚，并且能够以更具创新性的方式为企业客户提供服务。

Query_Text_en: Investment Banks Just as the government is ubiquitous in the process of issuing securities , so too are investment banks .
Translation: 投资银行 在证券发行过程中，政府无处不在，投资银行亦是如此。

Query_Text_en: the corporate business and the sales and trading business .
Translation: 公司业务以及销售与交易业务。

Query_Text_en: The Corporate Business . The corporate side of investment banking is a fee-for - service business ; that is , the firm sells its expertise .
Translation: 公司业务。投资银行的公司业务属于收费服务性质，即公司通过出售其专业知识获取报酬。

Query_Text_en: The main expertise banks have is in underwriting securities , but they also sell other services .
Translation: 银行的主要专长在于证券承销，但他们也提供其他服务。

Query_Text_en: They provide merger and acquisition advice in the form of prospecting for takeover targets , advising clients about the price to be offered for these targets , finding financing for the takeover , and planning takeover tactics or , on the other side , takeover defenses .
Translation: 他们提供并购咨询服务，包括寻找收购目标、为客户就收购目标的报价提供建议、协助筹集收购资金、制定收购策略，或在另一方则提供防御收购的方案。

Query_Text_en: Or on the contrary, advise for the reverse takeover.
Translation: 或者，相反，建议进行反向收购。

Query_Text_en: Large investment banks often go to great lengths to design new financial instruments.
Translation: 大型投资银行常常不遗余力地设计新的金融工具。

Query_Text_en: These investors include mutual funds , pension funds , and insurance companies . Sales and trading also consists of public market making , trading for clients , and trading on the investment banking firm s own account . Market making requires that the investment bank act as a dealer in securities , standing ready to buy and sell , respectively , at wholesale [ bid ] and retail [ ask ] prices .
Translation: 这些投资者包括共同基金、养老基金和保险公司。销售与交易还包括公开市场做市、为客户进行交易以及投资银行自营交易。做市要求投资银行作为证券交易商，随时准备以批发价（买入价）和零售价（卖出价）分别买入和卖出证券。

Query_Text_en: The bank makes money on the difference between the bid and ask price , or the bid - ask spread .
Translation: 银行通过买价与卖价之间的差额，也就是买卖价差，来赚取利润。

Query_Text_en: Banks do this not only for corporate debt and equity securities , but also as dealers in a variety of government securities .
Translation: 银行不仅在公司债务和股权证券领域开展此类业务，还作为多种政府证券的交易商进行操作。

Query_Text_en: In addition , investment banks trade securities using their own funds , which is known as proprietary trading .
Translation: 此外，投资银行还利用自有资金进行证券交易，这被称为自营交易。

Query_Text_en: Proprietary trading is riskier for an investment bank than being a dealer and earning the bid-ask spread , but the rewards can be commensurably larger .
Translation: 自营交易对投资银行而言比作为交易商赚取买卖价差更具风险，但其回报也可能相应更高。

Query_Text_en: The Largest Investment Banks . Although there are hundreds of investment banks in the United States alone , the largest banks account for most of the activity in all lines of business .
Translation: 最大的投资银行。虽然仅在美国就有数百家投资银行，但业务各领域的大部分活动都由最大的几家银行主导。

Query_Text_en: Exhibit 1 . 5 lists the top 15 global underwriters for 1999 and the amounts they underwrote .
Translation: 表1.5列出了1999年全球排名前15位的承销商及其承销金额。

Query_Text_en: These underwriters accounted for 80-90 percent of all underwritten offers .
Translation: 这些承销商占所有包销发行的80%到90%。

Query_Text_en: Although U. S. underwriters hold a dominant position in their business , foreign underwriters , such as Nomura Securities , are strong competitors in global issues .
Translation: 虽然美国的承销商在他们的业务中占据主导地位，但像野村证券这样的外国承销商在全球发行中也是强有力的竞争者。

Query_Text_en: Result 1 . 3 summarizes the key points of this discussion .
Translation: 结果1.3总结了本次讨论的要点。

Query_Text_en: Result 1 . 3 In the wake of the Great Depression , U. S. financial markets became more regulated . These regulations forced commercial banks , the most important provider of private capital , out of the investment banking business .
Translation: 在大萧条之后，美国金融市场的监管力度加强。这些监管措施迫使作为最重要私人资本提供者的商业银行退出了投资银行业务。

Query_Text_en: These regulatory constraints were relaxed in the 1980s and 1990s , making the banking industry more competitive and providing corporations with greater variety in their sources of capital .
Translation: 这些监管限制在20世纪80年代和90年代得以放松，使银行业竞争更加激烈，并为企业提供了更多元化的资本来源。

Query_Text_en: The Underwriting Process The essential outline of investment banking in the United States has been in place for almost a century .
Translation:
承销流程

美国投资银行业的基本框架已经存在近一个世纪。

Query_Text_en: The players have changed of course , but the way they do business now is roughly the same as it was a century ago .
Translation: 当然，参与者已经发生了变化，但他们现在的经营方式与一百年前大致相同。

Query_Text_en: [ 1 ] origination , [ 2 ] distribution , [ 3 ] risk bearing , and [ 4 ] certification .
Origination . Origination involves giving advice to the issuing firm about the type of security to issue , the timing of the issue , and the pricing of the issue .
Translation: 承销。承销包括为发行公司提供有关发行证券类型、发行时机及发行定价的建议。

Query_Text_en: Origination also means working with the firm to develop the registration statement and forming a syndicate of investment bankers to market the issue .
Translation: 承销还包括与公司合作制定注册声明，并组建投资银行家联合体以推广发行。

Query_Text_en: The managing or lead underwriter performs all these tasks .
Translation: 主承销商或牵头承销商负责完成所有这些工作。

Query_Text_en: Distribution . The second function an underwriter performs is the distribution , or the selling , of the issue .
Translation: 分销。承销商履行的第二项职能是分销，即发行的销售。

Query_Text_en: Distribution is generally carried out by a syndicate of banks formed by the lead underwriter .
Translation: 发行分销通常由主承销商组建的银行承销团负责进行。

Query_Text_en: The banks in the syndicate are listed in the prospectus along with how much of the issue each has agreed to sell . Once the registration is made effective , their names also appear on the tombstone ad in a newspaper which announces the issue and lists the underwriters participating in the syndicate .
Translation: 招股说明书中会列出银团中的各家银行及其各自承销的发行份额。一旦注册生效，这些银行的名称还会出现在报纸上发布的“墓碑广告”中，该广告公告此次发行并列出参与承销团的承销商。

Query_Text_en: Risk Bearing . The third function the underwriter performs is risk bearing .
Translation: 风险承担。承销商履行的第三项职能是风险承担。

Query_Text_en: In most cases , the underwriter has agreed to buy the securities the firm is selling and to resell them to its clients .
Translation: 在大多数情况下，承销商已经同意购买公司出售的证券，并将这些证券转售给其客户。

Query_Text_en: The Rules of Fair Practice [ promulgated by the National Association of Security Dealers ] prevents the underwriter from selling the securities at a price higher than that agreed on at the pricing meeting , so the underwriter s upside is limited .
Translation: 美国证券交易商协会颁布的《公平交易规则》禁止承销商以高于定价会议商定价格的价格出售证券，因此承销商的收益上限受到限制。

Query_Text_en: If the issue does poorly , the underwriter may be stuck with securities that must be sold at bargain prices .
Translation: 如果发行情况不佳，承销商可能会被迫持有只能以低价出售的证券。

Query_Text_en: However , the actual risk that underwriters take when marketing securities is generally limited since most issues are not priced until the day , or even hours , before they go on sale .
Translation: 然而，承销商在推销证券时实际承担的风险通常有限，因为大多数证券直到发行当天，甚至仅在发行前几个小时才确定价格。

Query_Text_en: Until that final pricing meeting , the investment bank is not committed to selling the issue .
Translation: 在最终定价会议召开之前，投资银行并未承诺出售该发行项目。

Query_Text_en: Certification . An additional role of an investment bank is to certify the quality of an issue which requires that the bank maintain sound reputation in capital markets .
Translation: 认证。投资银行的另一项职能是对发行质量进行认证，这要求银行在资本市场中保持良好的声誉。

Query_Text_en: An investment banker s reputation will quickly decline if the certification task is not performed correctly .
Translation: 如果投资银行家未能正确履行认证职责，其声誉将迅速受损。

Query_Text_en: If an underwriter substantially misprices an issue , its future business is likely to be damaged and it might even be sued .
Translation: 如果承销商对某一发行项目定价严重失误，其未来业务可能会受到影响，甚至可能面临诉讼。

Query_Text_en: A study by Booth and Smith [ 1986 ] suggested that underwriters , aware of the costs associated with mispricing an issue , charge higher fees on issues that are harder to value .
Translation: Booth和Smith（1986年）的一项研究表明，承销商由于意识到定价错误所带来的成本，会对那些估值难度较大的发行项目收取更高的费用。

Query_Text_en: The Underwriting Agreement The underwriting agreement between the firm and the investment bank is the document that specifies what is being sold , the amount being sold , and the selling price . The agreement also specifies the underwriting spread , which is the difference between the total proceeds of the offering and the net proceeds that accrue to the issuing firm , and the existence and extent of the overallotment option .
Translation:
承销协议

公司与投资银行之间签订的承销协议明确规定了发行的内容、发行数量及发行价格。该协议还规定了承销价差，即发行总收入与发行公司实际获得的净收入之间的差额，以及超额配售权的存在与范围。

Query_Text_en: This option , sometimes called the Green-Shoe option after the firm that first used it , permits the investment banker to request that more shares be issued on the same terms as those already sold .
Translation: 这种选择权，有时被称为“绿鞋期权”，源自最早采用该机制的公司，允许投资银行要求按已售股份的相同条件增发更多股份。

Query_Text_en: Exhibit 1 . 6 , which contains parts of a stock prospectus , illustrates many of the features of the agreement . ?
Translation: 图1.6包含了股票招股说明书的部分内容，展示了该协议的许多特征。

Query_Text_en: The underwriting agreement also shows the amount of fixed fees the firm must pay , including listing fees , taxes , SEC fees , transfer agent s fees , legal and accounting costs , and printing expenses .
Translation: 承销协议还列明了公司必须支付的各项固定费用，包括上市费用、税费、美国证券交易委员会（SEC）费用、过户代理费用、法律和会计费用以及印刷费用。

Query_Text_en: In addition to these fixed fees , firms may have to pay several other forms of compensation to the underwriters .
Translation: 除了这些固定费用外，企业还可能需要向承销商支付其他多种形式的报酬。

Query_Text_en: For example , underwriters often receive warrants as part of their compensation . Classifying Offerings If a firm is issuing equity to the public for the first time , it is making an initial public offering [ IPO ] .
Translation: 例如，承销商通常会将认股权证作为其报酬的一部分。发行类型的分类：如果一家公司首次向公众发行股票，这就是首次公开募股（IPO）。

Query_Text_en: If a firm is already publicly traded and is simply selling more common stock , it is making a seasoned offering [ SEO ] .
Translation: 如果一家公司已经公开上市，只是单纯地发行更多的普通股，那么它就是在进行一次增发（SEO，Seasoned Equity Offering）。

Query_Text_en: Both IPOs and seasoned offerings can include both primary and secondary issues .
Translation: 首次公开募股和增发可以包括原始发行和二次发行。

Query_Text_en: a secondary issue is undertaken by existing large shareholders who want to sell a substantial number of shares they currently own .
Translation: 现有大股东希望出售其持有的大量股份时，会进行二级发行。

Query_Text_en: Types of Underwriting Arrangements Firm Commitment vs. Best-Efforts Offering . A public offering can be executed on either a firm commitment or a best-efforts basis . In a firm commitment offering , the underwriter agrees to buy the whole offering from the firm at a set price and to offer it to the public at a slightly higher price . In this case , the underwriter bears the risk of not selling the issue , and the firm s proceeds are guaranteed . In a best-efforts offering , the underwriter and the firm fix a price and the minimum and maximum number of shares to be sold . The underwriter then makes the best effort to sell the issue . ?
Translation: 承销安排的类型：包销与代销。公开发行可以通过包销或代销的方式进行。在包销发行中，承销商同意以固定价格从公司购买全部发行股份，并以略高的价格向公众出售。在这种情况下，承销商承担未能售出股票的风险，公司获得的收益有保障。而在代销发行中，承销商与公司确定发行价格以及要出售的最小和最大股份数量。随后，承销商会尽最大努力销售这些股份。

Query_Text_en: Rights Offerings . Finally , for firms selling common stock , there is a possibility of a rights offering .
Translation: 配股发行。最后，对于发行普通股的公司来说，还存在进行配股发行的可能性。

Query_Text_en: Rights entitle existing shareholders to buy new shares in the firm at what is generdly a discounted price .
Translation: 认股权赋予现有股东以通常折价的价格购买公司新发行股票的权利。

Query_Text_en: Rights offerings can be made without investment bankers or with them on a standby basis .
Translation: 配股可以在没有投资银行参与的情况下进行，也可以由投资银行以备选方式参与。

Query_Text_en: A rights offering on a standby basis includes an agreement by the investment bank to take up any unexercised rights and exercise them , paying the subscription price to the firm in exchange for the new shares .
Translation: 备用包销权发行包括投资银行达成一项协议，即由其认购所有未被行使的权利，并以认购价格向公司支付资金，以换取新发行的股份。

Query_Text_en: In some cases , rights are actively traded after they are distributed by the firm .
Translation: 在某些情况下，权利在公司分配后会被积极交易。

Query_Text_en: For example , Time Warner used a rights offering to raise additional equity capital in 1991 .
Translation: 例如，时代华纳于1991年通过发行权利股份筹集了额外的股本资金。

Query_Text_en: As the case study below illustrates with respect to this offering , the value of a right is usually close to the value of the stock less the subscription price , which is the price that the rights holders must pay for the stock .
Translation: 正如下文案例所示，对于此类配股发行，认股权证的价值通常接近于股票市值减去认购价格（即权证持有人为购买股票所需支付的价格）。

Query_Text_en: The Time Warner Rights Offer The Time Warner rights offer gave shareholders the option to purchase one share at $ 80 per share for each right owned .
Translation: 时代华纳配股权发行 时代华纳的配股权发行为股东提供了以每份权利80美元的价格购买一股公司股票的选择。

Query_Text_en: Time Warner issued three rights for each five shares owned .
Translation: 时代华纳为每持有五股股票的股东发行了三份权利。

Query_Text_en: If you purchased the stock on July 16 1991 , or later , you did not receive the right .
Translation: 如果您在1991年7月16日或之后购买该股票，则不会获得该权利。

Query_Text_en: The rights expired on August 5 , 1991 .
Translation: 该权利于1991年8月5日到期。

Query_Text_en: Exhibit 1 . 8 shows Time Warner s stock price [ column [ a ] ] , the price at which the rights traded [ column [ b ] ] the exercise value of a right [ column [ c ] ] and the difference , which is calculated as the exercise value , estimated as the stock price minus the exercise price of right , minus the market price of a right .
Translation: 图表1.8展示了时代华纳的股票价格（列[a]）、权利的交易价格（列[b]）、权利的行权价值（列[c]），以及它们之间的差额。该差额的计算方法为：行权价值，即股票价格减去权利的行权价格，再减去权利的市场价格。

Query_Text_en: After July 15 , the last date at which the stock price is worth both the value of the stock and the value of the right , the stock price drops , reflecting the loss of the right .
Translation: 在7月15日之后，股票价格不再同时包含股票价值和权利价值，股价随之下跌，反映出权利价值的消失。

Query_Text_en: From July 16 on , the market price of a right is close to its exercise value .
Translation: 自7月16日起，权证的市场价格接近其行权价值。

Query_Text_en: The Time Warner rights offer was unusual in many respects .
Translation: 时代华

Query_Text_en: First , it was one of the largest equity offerings .
Translation: 首先，这是规模最大的股权发行之一。

Query_Text_en: Second , the original structure of the deal was unique .
Translation: 其次，该交易的原始结构具有独特性。

Query_Text_en: Finally , only rarely do U. S. firms choose to use rights offerings to issue new equity .
Translation: 最后，美国公司很少选择通过配股发行新股。

Query_Text_en: Some financial economists are puzzled that so few firms use rights offerings since the direct cost of a rights issue is substantially less than the direct cost of an under-written offering .
Translation: 一些金融经济学家对很少有公司采用配股发行感到困惑，因为配股发行的直接成本远低于承销发行的直接成本。

Query_Text_en: A plausible explanation for this is that rights offerings , when used , are less expensive because firms using them have a large-block shareholder who has agreed to take up the offer .
Translation: 一个合理的解释是，采用配股发行时成本较低，因为使用这一方式的公司通常拥有大额股东，而该股东已同意认购此次配股。

Query_Text_en: This is true in Europe , where large-block shareholders , who are likely to agree to exercise the rights , are more prevalent .
Translation: 在欧洲的确如此，因为持有大额股份的股东更为普遍，他们更有可能同意行使相关权利。

Query_Text_en: 11 Where rights are not used , there may be no large-block shareholders , which would make the rights offering more expensive .
Translation: 如果权利未被行使，可能不会出现大额股东，这将导致配股发行成本增加。

Query_Text_en: In addition , studies of the costs of rights offers examine only the costs to the firm and ignore the costs to the shareholders , which could conceivably be quite large .
Translation: 此外，关于配股成本的研究仅关注公司所承担的成本，而忽略了股东所需承担的成本，而这些成本实际上可能相当可观。

Query_Text_en: Raising Capital in International Markets Capital markets have truly become global .
Translation:
在国际市场上筹集资金

资本市场已经真正实现了全球化。

Query_Text_en: U. S. firms raise funds from almost all parts of the world .
Translation: 美国企业几乎从世界各地筹集资金。

Query_Text_en: Similarly , U. S. investors provide capital for foreign as well as domestic firms .
Translation: 同样，美国投资者不仅为本国企业提供资金，也为外国企业提供资本。

Query_Text_en: in what are known as the Euromarkets or in the domestic markets of various countries .
Translation: 在所谓的欧洲市场或各国的国内市场。

Query_Text_en: Euromarkets The term Euromarkets is something of a misnomer because the markets have no true physical location .
Translation: “欧洲市场”这一术语实际上有些用词不当，因为这些市场并没有真正的实体地点。

Query_Text_en: Instead , Euromarkets are simply a collection of large international banks that help firms issue bonds and make loans outside the country in which the firm is located .
Translation: 相反，欧洲市场实际上只是由一批大型国际银行组成，这些银行协助企业在其所在国以外发行债券和提供贷款。

Query_Text_en: Or a German multinational could borrow through the Euromarkets in either British pounds , Swiss francs or Euros .
Translation: 或者，一家德国跨国公司可以通过欧洲货币市场以英镑、瑞士法郎或欧元进行借款。

Query_Text_en: Direct Issuance The second way to raise money internationally is to sell directly in the foreign markets , or what is called direct issuance .
Translation:
直接发行  
第二种国际融资方式是在海外市场直接销售，也就是所谓的直接发行。

Query_Text_en: For example , a U. S. corporation could issue a yen-denominated bond in the Japanese bond market .
Translation: 例如，美国公司可以在日本债券市场发行以日元计价的债券。

Query_Text_en: Or a German firm might sell stock to U. S. investors and list its stock on one of the U. S. exchanges .
Translation: 或者一家德国公司可能会向美国投资者出售股票，并在美国的某个证券交易所上市。

Query_Text_en: Being a foreign issuer in a domestic market means satisfying all the regulations that apply to domestic firms as well as special regulations that might apply only to foreign issuers .
Translation: 作为境内市场的外国发行人，既需遵守适用于本土企业的所有法规，还需满足仅针对外国发行人的特殊规定。

Query_Text_en: 1.5 Major Financial Markets Outside the United States We will focus on three main countries – Germany, the United Kingdom, and Japan – analyzing how their financial systems differ from those in the United States.
Translation:
1.5 美国以外的主要金融市场

我们将重点关注德国、英国和日本这三个主要国家，分析它们的金融体系与美国的不同之处。

Query_Text_en: These countries have the largest financial markets outside of the United States.
Translation: 这些国家拥有除美国之外最大的金融市场。

Query_Text_en: 1.5.1 Germany Germany is the third largest economic power in the world after the United States and Japan, but its financial system is very different from that of other economic powers, especially German companies mainly obtain funds through commercial banks.
Translation:
1.5.1 德国

德国是仅次于美国和日本的世界第三大经济体，但其金融体系与其他经济强国截然不同，尤其是德国企业主要通过商业银行获得资金。

Query_Text_en: Universal Banking . One of the most important differences between the U. S. and German financial systems is that Germany has universal bankingһits banks can engage in both commercial and investment bankingһwhich is precluded in the United States under the Glass-Steagall Act [ although , as noted earlier , the situation in the United States is about to change ] .
Translation: 全能银行。美国与德国金融体系之间最重要的区别之一在于，德国实行全能银行制——其银行可以同时从事商业银行和投资银行业务——而在美国，《格拉斯-斯蒂格尔法案》禁止这种做法（不过，如前所述，美国的这一状况即将发生变化）。

Query_Text_en: The three largest banks , Deutsche Bank , Dresdner Bank , and Commerzbank , are universal banks .
Translation: 德国银行、德累斯顿银行和商业银行是德国三大银行，均为综合性银行。

Query_Text_en: German firms generally do business with one main bank , a Hausbank , which handles stock and bond placements , extends short - and longterm credit , and possibly has an ownership position in the firm .
Translation: 德国企业通常与一家主要银行（即“主银行”）开展业务，该银行负责股票和债券的发行，提供短期和长期贷款，并可能持有企业的部分股权。

Query_Text_en: For German multinationals , the main bank is usually one of the Big Three .
Translation: 对于德国跨国公司来说，主要银行通常是三大银行之一。

Query_Text_en: German multinational companies generally establish business ties with one of the three major banks.
Translation: 德国跨国公司通常会与三大银行中的一家建立业务关系。

Query_Text_en: There are also some larger regional banks (Bavarian Bank, Deutsche Cooperative Bank, Bavarian Mortgage Exchange Bank), which play a roughly equal role in providing financing services to German companies. Open and private markets Another major difference between the US and German capital markets is that publicly traded stocks in Germany are not the main source of corporate funding, and most German companies use private placements to raise capital. The total capital of the German stock market accounts for about 25% of its gross domestic product (GDP), while in the United States or Japan it is about 70%. The Frankfurt Stock Exchange is the largest stock exchange in Germany, with both stock and bond trading. The total value of securities issued on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange in 1994 was 300 billion German marks, of which only 15 billion marks were issued. These figures can be confirmed by the number of companies that have made initial public offerings in Germany. In the 80s, only about 200 German companies publicly issued securities, and in the United States this number was more than 20 times that of Germany.
Translation:
还有一些规模较大的地区性银行（如巴伐利亚银行、德国合作银行、巴伐利亚抵押交易银行），在为德国企业提供融资服务方面发挥着同等重要的作用。

公开市场与私人市场
美国与德国资本市场的另一个主要区别在于，德国上市股票并非企业融资的主要渠道，大多数德国企业通过私人配售方式筹集资金。德国股市总资本约占其国内生产总值（GDP）的25%，而美国或日本则约为70%。法兰克福证券交易所是德国最大的证券交易所，既有股票交易，也有债券交易。1994年，法兰克福证券交易所发行的证券总价值为3000亿德国马克，其中仅有150亿马克为新发行。这一数据可以从德国首次公开募股（IPO）企业数量得到印证。上世纪80年代，德国仅有约200家企业公开发行证券，而美国同期的数量则是德国的20倍以上。

Query_Text_en: The third difference between the German and the U. S. capital markets lies in the area of corporate governance , which is in turn affected by the first two differences .
Translation: 德国与美国资本市场的第三个区别体现在公司治理领域，而这一领域又受到前两项差异的影响。

Query_Text_en: By law , listed German firms have two-tiered boards of directors .
Translation: 根据法律规定，德国上市公司实行两层董事会制度。

Query_Text_en: The Vorstand , or management board , is composed of company executives who manage the firm on a day-to-day basis .
Translation: 管理董事会（Vorstand）由公司高管组成，负责企业的日常运营管理。

Query_Text_en: The Aufsichtsrat , or supervisory board , consists of 10 to 20 members , half of which must be worker representatives .
Translation: 监事会由10至20名成员组成，其中一半必须为职工代表。

Query_Text_en: The other half of this board is elected by shareholders ;
Translation: 董事会的另一半成员由股东选举产生；

Query_Text_en: these directors are similar to outside directors in the United States . It is common for these directors to be substantial shareholders in the firm either directly or indirectly as representatives of the banks , insurance companies , or families that have financed the firm . Kester [ 1992 ] estimated that banks and 20 Part I Financial Markets and Financial Instruments insurance firms own about 20 percent of the stock in German firms ; the comparable figure in the United States is about 5 percent .
Translation: 这些董事类似于美国的外部董事。通常，这些董事会直接或间接作为银行、保险公司或为企业提供资金的家族的代表，持有公司大量股份。Kester（1992）估算，银行和保险公司在德国企业中持股比例约为20%；而在美国，这一比例仅为约5%。

Query_Text_en: Large-block shareholdings probably account for roughly 60 percent of the total stockholdings in Germany ; that figure is about 10 percent in the United States .
Translation: 在德国，大额股份持有可能约占全部股票持有量的60%；而在美国，这一比例大约为10%。

Query_Text_en: Banks can vote the shares they own , as well as the shares they hold in street name that is , those shares owned by customers but held in bank brokerage accounts and mutual funds .
Translation: 银行不仅可以对其自有股份进行投票，还可以对以“街名”持有的股份进行投票，即客户所有但存放在银行经纪账户和共同基金中的股份。

Query_Text_en: These additional shares give banks more voting power and thus greater influence than their own shareholdings would command per se .
Translation: 这些额外股份赋予银行更多的投票权，因此使其影响力超过自身持股本身所能带来的程度。

Query_Text_en: However , recent tax law changes now make it easier for corporations to sell their holdings in other corporations , leading to a gradual dismantling of the cross-holdings in Germany . Other Differences between the United States and Germany .
Translation: 然而，近期税法的变动使得企业出售其在其他公司持有的股份变得更加容易，这推动了德国交叉持股结构的逐步瓦解。美国与德国之间还有其他差异。

Query_Text_en: The German financial system has several other , less salient differences from the U. S. system .
Translation: 德国的金融体系与美国体系相比，还存在若干其他不太显著的差异。

Query_Text_en: In Germany , a number of specialized banks restrict their activities to specific industries such as shipbuilding , agriculture , and brewing . The Landesbanken , owned by state governments and regional savings bank associations , are active in financing German firms .
Translation: 在德国，一些专业银行将业务限定于特定行业，如造船、农业和酿造业。由州政府和地区储蓄银行协会所有的州立银行积极参与为德国企业提供融资。

Query_Text_en: Several of them [ for example , Bayerische Landesbank and Westdeutsche Landesbank ] are among the 10 largest banks in Germany .
Translation: 其中几家银行（如巴伐利亚州银行和西德州银行）跻身德国十大银行之列。

Query_Text_en: Finally , foreign commercial banks in Germany have approximately 5 percent of the market share of total assets , but they conduct much more than 5 percent of the transactions in , for example , Eurobond issues , foreign cur-rency trading , and derivatives .
Translation: 目前，德国的外国商业银行在总资产市场中约占5%的份额，但在如欧洲债券发行、外币交易和衍生品等业务领域，其交易量远远超过5%。

Query_Text_en: Deregulation . Deregulation in Germany , as in the United States , is changing the markets and the way firms raise capital .
Translation: 放松管制。正如美国一样，德国的放松管制正在改变市场格局以及企业融资的方式。

Query_Text_en: Until the early 1990s the commercial paper market was nonexistent in Germany .
Translation: 直到20世纪90年代初，德国几乎没有商业票据市场。

Query_Text_en: In 1991 , the government abolished a tax that discouraged transactions in commercial paper and the Ministry of Finance no longer required the approval of domestic debt issues .
Translation: 1991年，政府取消了一项阻碍商业票据交易的税收，财政部也不再要求国内债券发行须经批准。

Query_Text_en: This deregulation led to the emergence of a growing commercial paper market , making it the fourth largest in Europe , and a growing bond market .
Translation: 这一放松管制促使商业票据市场不断发展，使其成为欧洲第四大市场，同时债券市场也在持续增长。

Query_Text_en: Although the domestic bond market is small , German Eurobond placements in recent years have been orders of magnitude larger and growing . Japan At first glance , the Japanese financial system appears similar to that of the United States .
Translation: 尽管国内债券市场规模较小，但近年来德国的欧洲债券发行规模却大幅增长，且远超国内市场。日本——乍看之下，日本的金融体系与美国颇为相似。

Query_Text_en: Commercial and investment banking are separate and firms must file registration statements to issue securities .
Translation: 商业银行与投资银行相互独立，企业在发行证券时必须提交注册声明。

Query_Text_en: The Tokyo Stock Exchange is the second largest in the world , after the New York Stock Exchange , and the Japanese also have active markets in bonds , commercial paper , and Euromarket offerings .
Translation: 东京证券交易所是仅次于纽约证券交易所的全球第二大证券交易所，日本还拥有活跃的债券、商业票据和欧洲市场发行等金融市场。

Query_Text_en: However , this superficial similarity masks a financial system that is markedly different from that in the United States .
Translation: 然而，这种表面上的相似掩盖了一个与美国截然不同的金融体系。

Query_Text_en: In particular , banks are much more influential in Japan than in the United States , and cross-ownership with interlocking directorships is much more common .
Translation: 尤其是在日本，银行的影响力远高于美国，交叉持股和董事会成员互相兼任的现象也更加普遍。

Query_Text_en: We now touch briefly on these two important aspects of Japanese finance .
Translation: 我们现在简要谈谈日本金融的这两个重要方面。

Query_Text_en: The Role of Japanese Banks . Exhibit 1 . 9 shows that many of the 10 largest banks in the world are located in Japan .
Translation: 日本银行的作用。图表1.9显示，全球十大银行中有许多位于日本。

Query_Text_en: Measured by assets , the 10 largest Japanese banks have many times the assets of the 10 largest U. S. banksһin an economy that is less than two-thirds the size of the U. S. economy .
Translation: 以资产规模衡量，日本排名前十的银行的资产总额是美国前十家银行的数倍，而日本经济的规模还不到美国的三分之二。

Query_Text_en: Japan s largest banks are called city banks something of a misnomer because they are nationwide banks .
Translation: 日本最大的银行被称为“城市银行”，但这一称呼其实有些名不副实，因为它们实际上是全国性银行。

Query_Text_en: These city banks are the primary suppliers of funds to Japanese firms .
Translation: 这些城市银行是日本企业的主要资金供应者。

Query_Text_en: A city bank serves as the so-called main bank for each large industrial corporation in Japan . ?
Translation: 在日本，每家大型工业公司都有一家城市银行作为其所谓的主办银行。

Query_Text_en: Historically , banks have been the major source of funds for Japanese firms , furnishing more than half the financing needs of Japanese firms in the 1970s and 1980s .
Translation: 历史上，银行一直是日本企业的主要资金来源，在20世纪70年代和80年代，银行为日本企业提供了超过一半的融资需求。

Query_Text_en: In recent years , however , as Japanese bond markets have developed , this proportion has fallen to approximately one-third of the funds needed .
Translation: 然而，近年来，随着日本债券市场的发展，这一比例已下降到所需资金的大约三分之一。

Query_Text_en: As in Germany , many Japanese firms are affiliated with a main bank which takes an active role in monitoring the decisions of the borrowing firm s management .
Translation: 与德国类似，许多日本企业都与主要银行有密切关联，这些银行积极参与监督借款企业管理层的决策。

Query_Text_en: Furthermore , additional lenders , such as other banks and insurance companies , look to the main bank for approval when loaning a firm money .
Translation: 此外，其他银行和保险公司等额外的贷款机构在向企业提供贷款时，会以主办银行的批准为依据。

Query_Text_en: Finally , the banks have significant powers to seize collateral , both as a direct lender and as a trustee for secured bond issues .
Translation: 最后，银行作为直接贷款方和担任有担保债券发行的受托人，均拥有强大的权力可以没收抵押品。

Query_Text_en: The influence of Japanese banks is further enhanced by their stock ownership .
Translation: 日本银行通过持有股票进一步增强了其影响力。

Query_Text_en: In contrast with the United States , Japanese banks can hold common stock , although the holdings of any single bank in a firm are limited to 5 percent of a company s shares .
Translation: 与美国不同，日本的银行可以持有普通股，但任何一家银行在单一公司的持股比例不得超过该公司股份的5%。

Query_Text_en: Even though 5 percent is not a large block , banks collectively own more than 20 percent of the total shares outstanding . When combined with insurance companies , the ownership percentage of financial institutions rises to 40 percent .
Translation: 尽管5%的股份并不算多，但银行合计持有超过20%的流通股。当与保险公司合并计算时，金融机构的持股比例上升至40%。

Query_Text_en: A study by Kester [ 1992 ] estimated that the top five shareholders in major Japanese firms own about 20 percent of the shares , forming a voting block that can not be ignored .
Translation: Kester（1992年）的一项研究估算，日本主要企业的前五大股东持有约20%的股份，形成了一个不可忽视的投票集团。

Query_Text_en: The large-block shareholders frequently meet to exchange information about the financial condition of the firm , and representatives of the main bank do not hesitate to step in when the firm experiences difficulties .
Translation: 大股东经常会面，交流公司财务状况的信息，而主银行的代表在公司遇到困难时也会毫不犹豫地介入。

Query_Text_en: Cross-Holdings and Keiretsus . The large cross-holdings of Japanese firms are a significant feature of the Japanese financial system .
Translation: 交叉持股与企业集团。日本企业的大规模交叉持股是日本金融体系的一个重要特征。

Query_Text_en: Japanese corporations typically own stock in other Japanese corporations , which in turn also own stock in the corporations that partly own them .
Translation: 日本企业通常持有其他日本企业的股票，而这些企业也会持有部分持股企业的股票。

Query_Text_en: A keiretsu is a group of firms in different industries bound together by cross-ownership of their common stock and by customer-supplier relationships .
Translation: 企业集团（Keiretsu）是指由不同行业的公司通过相互持有股份以及客户—供应商关系而紧密联系在一起的企业联合体。

Query_Text_en: Kester gave the example of Mitsubishi Conglomerate.
Translation: 凯斯特以三菱集团为例。

Query_Text_en: As a group, it holds 25% of its member companies, and a large number of shares held by manufacturers and customers means that the company is rarely plagued by contractual issues.
Translation: 作为一个集团，其成员公司持股比例为25%，而制造商和客户持有大量股份，这使得公司很少受到合同问题的困扰。

Query_Text_en: For example , an automobile manufacturer may be less likely to sue the company supplying its steel if the steel company owns a significant percentage of the automobile company s stock and the automobile company owns a significant percentage of the steel company s stock .
Translation: 例如，如果钢铁公司持有汽车公司大量股份，而汽车公司也持有钢铁公司大量股份，那么汽车制造商就不太可能起诉其钢材供应商。

Query_Text_en: For similar reasons , group members tend to help one another when a member of the group experiences financial difficulties .
Translation: 出于类似的原因，当小组成员遇到经济困难时，其他成员往往会相互帮助。

Query_Text_en: Deregulation . Until the 1980s Japan s bond and stock markets were highly regulated , effectively preventing Japanese firms from raising money in the public markets .
Translation: 放松管制。直到20世纪80年代，日本的债券和股票市场一直受到严格监管，这实际上阻止了日本企业在公开市场筹集资金。

Query_Text_en: For instance , most firms could not issue unsecured bonds until 1988 . Moreover , firms could not issue foreign currency bonds [ for example , Eurobonds ] and swap the proceeds into yen until 1984 , and the Ministry of Finance did not allow a commercial paper market until 1988 .
Translation: 例如，大多数公司在1988年前无法发行无担保债券。此外，公司在1984年前不能发行外币债券（如欧洲债券）并将所得资金兑换成日元，财政部也直到1988年才允许建立商业票据市场。

Query_Text_en: The main bank system and the influence of the main bank appear to be waning as a result of the deregulation of Japanese financial markets that began in the 1980s .
Translation: 自20世纪80年代日本金融市场开始放松管制以来，主银行体制及其影响力似乎正在减弱。

Query_Text_en: One piece of evidence that bank debt has become a less important source of funds is that debt and equity issues have grown dramatically in the last two decades .
Translation: 一个证据表明银行债务作为资金来源的重要性有所下降，就是在过去二十年里，债务和股权融资的规模显著增长。

Query_Text_en: It seems likely that further deregulationһabolishing the separation of commercial and industrial banking and removing limits on debt issuesһwill occur , leading to even more public capital and a concomitant reduction in the influence of the main bank .
