The first time we talked about AIDS , he spoke to me through mournful eyes about his new responsibilities as head of the National AIDS Commission . He has led a team of experts to design a national AIDS strategy that could begin to meet this horrific challenge . That team has traveled throughout the world to Harvard , Johns Hopkins , Liverpool , the London School of Hygiene and Tropical Medicine , and the World Health Organization to discuss ideas for scaling up the fight against AIDS .
Translation: 苏拉威西副总统本人因艾滋病失去了数位亲人。我们第一次谈论艾滋病时，他以哀伤的目光向我诉说，自己作为国家艾滋病委员会主席的新职责。他带领专家团队制定了国家艾滋病战略，以应对这一严峻挑战。该团队曾前往哈佛大学、约翰霍普金斯大学、利物浦大学、伦敦卫生与热带医学学院以及世界卫生组织，与各方交流如何扩大艾滋病防治工作的思路。

Query_Text_en: Malawi actually put together one of the earliest and best conceived strategies for bringing treatment to its dying population , and gave an enormously thoughtful response to the challenges of managing a new system of drug delivery , patient counseling and education , community outreach , and the financial flows that would accompany the process of training doctors . On that basis , Malawi made proposals to the international community to help Malawians try to reach about a third of the total infected population [ about three hundred thousand people ] with anti AIDS drug treatment within a five year scaleup period .
Translation: 马拉维实际上制定了最早且最完善的策略之一，以为其濒临死亡的人口提供治疗，并对管理新的药物配送系统、患者咨询与教育、社区外展以及伴随医生培训过程的资金流动等挑战作出了极为周到的回应。在此基础上，马拉维向国际社会提出建议，希望在五年扩展期内，帮助马拉维人向约三分之一的感染者（约三十万人）提供抗艾滋病药物治疗。

Query_Text_en: Yet international processes are cruel . The donor governments ? including the United States and Europeans old Malawi to scale back its proposal sharply because the first proposal was `` too ambitious and too costly . The next draft was cut back to a mere hundred thousand on treatment at the end of five years . Even that was too much . In a tense five day period , the donors prevailed on Malawi to cut another 60 percent from the proposal , down to forty thousand on treatment . This atrophied plan was submitted to the Global Fund to Fight AIDS , TB , and Malaria . Incredibly , the donors that run that fund saw fit to cut back once again . After a long struggle , Malawi received funding to save just twenty five thousand at the end of five years a death warrant from the international community for the people of this country .
Translation: 然而，国际程序是残酷的。捐助国——包括美国和欧洲国家——要求马拉维大幅削减其提案，因为最初的提案“过于雄心勃勃，成本也太高”。下一版草案被削减到五年后仅有十万人接受治疗。即便如此，还是被认为太多。在紧张的五天里，捐助方又要求马拉维将提案再削减60%，降至仅有四万人接受治疗。这个被严重削弱的计划随后提交给了全球抗击艾滋病、结核病和疟疾基金。令人难以置信的是，管理该基金的捐助方认为还需要再次削减。经过长时间的争取，马拉维最终只获得了五年后救治两万五千人的资金——这无异于国际社会对这个国家人民下达的死亡判决书。

Query_Text_en: Carol Bellamy of UNICEF has rightly described Malawi 's plight as the perfect storm , a storm that brings together climatic disaster , impoverishment , the AIDS pandemic , and the longstanding burdens of malaria , schistosomiasis , and other diseases . In the face of this horrific maelstrom , the world community has so far displayed a fair bit of handwringing and even some high minded rhetoric , but precious little action .
Translation: 联合国儿童基金会的卡罗尔·贝拉米（Carol Bellamy）曾恰当地将马拉维的困境形容为“完美风暴”——这场风暴集气候灾害、贫困、艾滋病大流行以及长期困扰的疟疾、血吸虫病和其他疾病于一体。面对如此可怕的灾难，国际社会迄今为止表现出的多是无奈和高尚的言辞，真正采取的行动却少之又少。

Query_Text_en: A few thousand miles away from this perfect storm is another scene of poverty . This is poverty in retreat , where the fight for survival is gradually being won , although still with horrendous risks and huge unmet needs . This struggle is being waged in Bangladesh , one of the most populous countries in the world , with 140 million people living in the flood plains of the deltas of the two great rivers , the Brahmaputra and the Ganges , that flow through Bangladesh on their way to the Indian Ocean .
Translation: 在距离这场完美风暴几千英里之外，呈现出另一番贫困景象。这是一种正在消退的贫困，人们在生存斗争中逐步取得胜利，尽管仍面临巨大风险和大量未被满足的需求。这场斗争正在孟加拉国进行，这个世界上人口最稠密的国家之一，有1.4亿人口生活在布拉马普特拉河和恒河两大河流三角洲的洪泛平原上，这两条大河流经孟加拉国，最终汇入印度洋。

Query_Text_en: Bangladesh was born in a war for independence against Pakistan in 1971 . That year , it experienced massive famine and disarray , leading an official in Henry Kissinger 's State Department to famously label it an `` international basket case . Bangladesh today is far from a basket case . Per capita income has approximately doubled since independence . Life expectancy has risen from forty four years to sixty two years . The infant mortality rate [ the number of children who die before their first birthday for every 1,000 born ] has declined from 145 in 1970 to 48 in 2002 . Bangladesh shows us that even in circumstances that seem the most hopeless there are ways forward if the right strategies are applied , and if the right combination of investments is made .
Translation: 孟加拉国是在1971年与巴基斯坦争取独立的战争中诞生的。那一年，孟加拉国经历了严重的饥荒和混乱，导致亨利·基辛格任职的美国国务院一位官员著名地将其称为“国际篮子案例”。如今的孟加拉国早已不是“篮子案例”。自独立以来，人均收入大约翻了一番，预期寿命从44岁提高到62岁。婴儿死亡率（每千名出生婴儿中未满一岁死亡的数量）从1970年的145降至2002年的48。孟加拉国向我们展示，即便在看似最绝望的环境下，只要采取正确的战略，做出合理的投资组合，依然可以找到前进的道路。

Query_Text_en: Still , Bangladesh is not out of the grip of extreme poverty . Although it has escaped the worst of the ravages of famine and disease in the past generation , it faces some profound challenges today . A few months after my visit to Malawi , I was up at dawn one morning in Dhaka , Bangladesh , to see a remarkable sight : thousands of people walking to work in long lines stretching from the outskirts of Dhaka and from some of its poorest neighborhoods . Looking more closely , I noticed that these workers were almost all young women , perhaps between the ages of eighteen and twenty five . These are the workers of a burgeoning garment industry in Dhaka who cut , stitch , and package millions of pieces of apparel each month for shipment to the United States and Europe .
Translation: 然而，孟加拉国仍未摆脱极端贫困的困扰。尽管在过去的一代人中，它已经避免了饥荒和疾病带来的最严重破坏，但如今依然面临着一些深刻的挑战。在我访问马拉维几个月后的一天清晨，我在孟加拉国达卡目睹了一幕令人印象深刻的景象：成千上万的人排成长队，从达卡的郊区和一些最贫困的社区步行前往工作。仔细观察后，我发现这些工人几乎都是年轻女性，年龄大约在十八到二十五岁之间。她们是达卡新兴服装产业的工人，每月为出口到美国和欧洲剪裁、缝制并包装数百万件服装。

Query_Text_en: Over the years , I have visited garment factories all over the developing world . I have grown familiar with the cavernous halls where hundreds of young women sit at sewing machines , and men at cutting tables , where the fabrics move along production lines and the familiar labels of GAP , Polo , Yves Saint Laurent , Wal Mart , J. C. Penney , and others are attached as the clothing reaches the final stages of production . There is nothing glamorous about this work . The women often walk two hours each morning in long quiet files to get to work . Arriving at seven or seven thirty , they may be in their seats for most of the following twelve hours . They often work with almost no break at all or perhaps a very short lunch break , with little chance to go to the lavatory . Leering bosses lean over them , posing a threat of sexual harassment . After a long , difficult , tedious day , the young women trudge back home , when they are again sometimes threatened with physical assault .
Translation: 多年来，我走访了世界各地的发展中国家服装工厂。我对那些宽敞的厂房已十分熟悉，成百上千的年轻女性坐在缝纫机前，男性则在裁剪台工作，布料沿着生产线流转，等到服装进入最后生产阶段时，GAP、Polo、Yves Saint Laurent、沃尔玛、J.C. Penney等熟悉的品牌标签便被贴上。这份工作毫无光鲜可言。女性工人常常每天清晨步行两小时，排成长长的队伍安静地前往工厂。她们在七点或七点半到达，之后的十二个小时大部分时间都坐在工位上。她们几乎没有休息时间，午餐也极为短暂，甚至很难有机会去洗手间。工头常常在她们身旁徘徊，带有性骚扰的威胁。经过漫长、艰难、枯燥的一天后，这些年轻女性又拖着疲惫的身躯回家，途中有时还面临身体伤害的威胁。

Query_Text_en: These sweatshop jobs are the targets of public protest in developed countries ; those protests have helped to improve the safety and quality of the working conditions . The rich world protesters , however , should support increased numbers of such jobs , albeit under safer working conditions , by protesting the trade protectionism in their own countries that keeps out garment exports from countries such as Bangladesh . These young women already have a foothold in the modern economy that is a critical , measurable step up from the villages of Malawi [ and more relevant for the women , a step up from the villages of Bangladesh where most of them were born ] . The sweatshops are the first rung on the ladder out of extreme poverty . They give lie to the Kissinger state department 's forecast that Bangladesh is condemned to extreme poverty .
Translation: 这些血汗工厂的工作岗位一直是发达国家公众抗议的对象；这些抗议确实推动了工作环境的安全性和质量的提升。然而，发达国家的抗议者们还应通过反对本国对孟加拉国等国家服装出口的贸易保护主义，来支持在更安全的工作条件下增加此类就业岗位。这些年轻女性已经在现代经济中站稳了脚跟，这对于她们来说，是从马拉维乡村（更切合实际地说，是从她们大多数出生地——孟加拉国乡村）迈出的关键且可衡量的一步。血汗工厂是她们摆脱极端贫困的第一阶梯。它们也证明了基辛格时期美国国务院关于孟加拉国注定陷于极端贫困的预言并不成立。

Query_Text_en: On one visit to Bangladesh , I picked up an English language morning newspaper , where I found an extensive insert of interviews with young women working in the garment sector . These stories were poignant , fascinating , and eyeopening . One by one , they recounted the arduous hours , the lack of labor rights , and the harassment . What was most striking and unexpected about the stories was the repeated affirmation that this work was the greatest opportunity that these women could ever have imagined , and that their employment had changed their lives for the better .
Translation: 有一次在孟加拉国访问时，我拿起了一份英文晨报，发现里面有一篇关于服装行业年轻女工的大篇幅专访。这些故事感人至深、引人入胜、发人深省。她们一个接一个地讲述着艰苦的工作时长、缺乏劳动权益以及所遭受的骚扰。最令人印象深刻且出乎意料的是，这些故事中反复强调，这份工作是她们能够想象到的最好的机会，她们的就业让自己的生活变得更加美好。

Query_Text_en: Nearly all of the women interviewed had grown up in the countryside , extraordinarily poor , illiterate and unschooled , and vulnerable to chronic hunger and hardship in a domineering , patriarchal society . Had they [ and their fore bearers of the 1970s and 1980s ] stayed in the villages , they would have been forced into a marriage arranged by their fathers , and by seventeen or eighteen , forced to conceive a child . Their trek to the cities to take jobs has given these young women a chance for personal liberation of unprecedented dimension and opportunity .
Translation: 几乎所有受访女性都在农村长大，极度贫困，文盲且未受教育，在一个强势的父权社会中长期遭受饥饿和艰难生活的威胁。如果她们（以及上世纪七八十年代的前辈们）留在村里，就会被父亲安排婚姻，十七八岁时被迫生育。她们来到城市工作，为这些年轻女性带来了前所未有的个人解放和机遇。

Query_Text_en: The Bangladeshi women told how they were able to save some small surplus from their meager pay , manage their own income , have their own rooms , choose when and whom to date and marry , choose to have children when they felt ready , and use their savings to improve their living conditions and especially to go back to school to enhance their literacy and job market skills . As hard as it is , this life is a step on the way to economic opportunity that was unimaginable in the countryside in generations past .
Translation: 这些孟加拉国女性讲述了她们如何能够从微薄的工资中积攒一些小额盈余，自己管理收入，拥有属于自己的房间，自主选择约会和结婚的时间及对象，在觉得准备好时决定是否生育，并利用储蓄改善生活条件，尤其是重返校园提升自身的识字能力和就业技能。尽管生活艰难，这种生活方式却是通往经济机会的一步，而在过去几代人的农村生活中，这样的机会是难以想象的。

Query_Text_en: Some rich country protesters have argued that Dhaka 's apparel firms should either pay far higher wage rates or be closed , but closing such factories as a result of wages forced above worker productivity would be little more than a ticket for these women back to rural misery . For these young women , these factories offer not only opportunities for personal freedom , but also the first rung on the ladder of rising skills and income for themselves and , within a few years , for their children . Virtually every poor country that has developed successfully has gone through these first stages of industrialization . These Bangladeshi women share the experience of many generations of immigrants to New York City 's garment district and a hundred other places where their migration to toil in garment factories was a step on the path to a future of urban affluence in succeeding generations .
Translation: 一些富裕国家的抗议者认为，达卡的服装企业要么应支付远高于现有水平的工资，要么就应关闭。然而，如果因强行提高工资至超出工人生产率的水平而关闭这些工厂，无异于让这些女性重新回到农村的贫困生活中去。对于这些年轻女性而言，这些工厂不仅为她们提供了实现个人自由的机会，更是她们自身以及几年后她们子女提升技能和收入的第一阶梯。几乎所有成功实现发展的贫困国家都经历了这样的工业化初期阶段。这些孟加拉国女性的经历，与许多代移民到纽约制衣区以及其他上百个地方的经历如出一辙——他们迁移到城市，在服装厂辛勤工作，正是通往后代城市富裕生活道路上的一步。

Query_Text_en: Not only is the garment sector fueling Bangladesh 's economic growth of more than 5 percent per year in recent years , but it is also raising the consciousness and power of women in a society that was long brazenly biased against women 's chances in life . As part of a more general and dramatic process of change throughout Bangladeshi society , this change and others give Bangladesh the opportunity in the next few years to put itself on a secure path of longterm economic growth . The countryside that these women have left is also changing quickly , in part because of the income remittances and ideas that the young women send back to their rural communities , and in part because of the increased travel and temporary migration between rural and urban areas , as families diversify their economic bases between rural agriculture and urban manufacturers and services .
Translation: 近年来，服装业不仅推动了孟加拉国每年超过5%的经济增长，还提升了女性在社会中的意识和力量，而这个社会长期以来对女性的生活机会存在明显偏见。作为孟加拉国社会更广泛且深刻变革的一部分，这一变化以及其他变革为孟加拉国在未来几年内走上长期经济增长的稳固道路提供了机遇。那些离开乡村的女性所生活的农村也在迅速变化，这一方面得益于年轻女性将收入汇款和新观念带回家乡，另一方面则源于城乡之间日益频繁的旅行和临时迁移，因为家庭正在将经济基础从农村农业拓展到城市制造业和服务业。

Query_Text_en: In 2003 , my colleagues at Columbia and I visited a village near Dhaka with one of the leaders of an inspiring nongovernmental organization , the Bangladeshi Rural Advancement Committee , now known universally as BRAC . There we met representatives from a village association , which BRAC had helped to organize , in which women living about an hour outside the city were engaged in small scale commercial activities food processing and trade within the village and on the roads between the village and Dhaka itself . These women presented a picture of change every bit as dramatic as that of the burgeoning apparel sector .
Translation: 2003年，我与哥伦比亚大学的同事们在一位极具影响力的非政府组织——孟加拉农村发展委员会（现已广为人知的BRAC）领导人的陪同下，访问了达卡附近的一个村庄。在那里，我们见到了一个由BRAC协助组建的村民协会的代表。该协会的成员是居住在距离城市约一小时车程的女性，她们从事着小规模的商业活动，包括食品加工以及在村内和通往达卡的道路上进行贸易。这些女性展现出的变革景象，丝毫不亚于孟加拉蓬勃发展的服装行业。

Query_Text_en: Wearing beautiful saris , the women sat on the ground in six rows , each with six women , to greet us and answer questions . Each row represented a subgroup of the local `` micro finance '' unit . The woman in the front of the row was in charge of the borrowing of the whole group behind her . The group in each line was mutually responsible for repayments of the loans taken by any member within the line . BRAC and its famed counterpart , Grameen Bank , pioneered this kind of group lending , in which impoverished recipients [ usually women ] are given small loans of a few hundred dollars as working capital for micro business activities . Such women were long considered unbankable , simply not creditworthy enough to bear the transaction costs to receive loans . Group lending changed the repayment dynamics : default rates are extremely low , and BRAC and Grameen have figured out how to keep other transaction costs to a minimum as well .
Translation: 身着美丽纱丽的妇女们席地而坐，分为六排，每排六人，迎接我们并回答问题。每一排代表当地“微型金融”单位的一个子小组。排头的妇女负责整个小组的借款事务。每排的成员对本排任何成员所借贷款的偿还互负责任。BRAC及其著名同行格莱珉银行率先开展了这种小组贷款模式，向贫困的受益者（通常是女性）提供几百美元的小额贷款，作为微型商业活动的运营资金。长期以来，这些女性被认为无法获得银行贷款，信用不足以承担贷款的交易成本。小组贷款改变了还款的动态：违约率极低，BRAC和格莱珉银行也找到了将其他交易成本降至最低的方法。

Query_Text_en: Perhaps more amazing than the stories of how micro finance was fueling small scale businesses were the women 's attitudes to child rearing .
Translation: 比微型金融如何助力小型企业的故事更令人惊叹的，或许是这些女性对育儿的态度。

Query_Text_en: When Dr. Allan Rosenfield , dean of Columbia University 's Mailman School of Public Health and one of the world 's leading experts on reproductive health , asked the women how many had five children , no hands went up . Four ? Still no hands . Three ? One nervous woman , looking around , reluctantly put her hand in the air . Two ? About 40 percent of the women . One ? Perhaps another 25 percent . None ? The remainder of the women . Here was a group where the average number of children for these mothers was between one and two children .
Translation: 当哥伦比亚大学梅尔曼公共卫生学院院长、世界著名生殖健康专家艾伦·罗森菲尔德博士问在场的女性有多少人生了五个孩子时，没有人举手。四个孩子？依然没人举手。三个孩子？有一位紧张的女士环顾四周后，勉强举起了手。两个孩子？大约有40%的女性举手。一个孩子？大约还有25%。没有孩子？剩下的女性都举了手。在这个群体中，这些母亲的平均孩子数在一到两个之间。

Query_Text_en: Rosenfield then asked them how many they wanted in total . He again started at five hands . Four ? No hands . Three ? No hands . Two ? Almost all the hands went up . This social norm was new , a demonstration of a change of outlook and possibility so dramatic that Rosenfield dwelt on it throughout the rest of our visit . He had been visiting Bangladesh and other parts of Asia since the 1960s , and he remembered vividly the days when Bangladeshi rural women would typically have had six or seven children .
Translation: 然后，罗森菲尔德又问她们总共想要多少个孩子。他再次从五个孩子开始问。四个？没有人举手。三个？还是没有人举手。两个？几乎所有人都举起了手。这种社会规范是新的，展现出一种极为显著的观念和可能性的变化，以至于罗森菲尔德在我们此行的剩余时间里都在谈论这件事。他自20世纪60年代起就一直在孟加拉国和亚洲其他地区访问，他还清楚地记得那些孟加拉农村妇女通常会生六七个孩子的日子。

Query_Text_en: The jobs for women in the cities and in rural offfarm micro enterprises ; a new spirit of women 's rights and independence and empowerment ; dramatically reduced rates of child mortality ; rising literacy of girls and young women ; and , crucially , the availability of family planning and contraception have made all the difference for these women . There is no single explanation for the dramatic , indeed historic , reduction in desired rates of fertility : it is the combination of new ideas , better public health for mothers and children , and improved economic opportunities for women . The reduced fertility rates , in turn , will fuel Bangladesh 's rising incomes . With fewer children , a poor household can invest more in the health and education of each child , thereby equipping the next generation with the health , nutrition , and education that can lift Bangladesh 's living standards in future years .
Translation: 城市和农村非农微型企业为女性提供了就业机会；女性权利、独立和赋权的新精神；儿童死亡率的显著下降；女孩和年轻女性识字率的提升；以及至关重要的计划生育和避孕措施的普及，这些因素共同改变了女性的命运。对于生育意愿率的显著甚至具有历史意义的下降，没有单一的解释原因：这是新观念、母婴公共卫生改善以及女性经济机会提升共同作用的结果。生育率的降低反过来将推动孟加拉国收入的增长。随着子女数量减少，贫困家庭能够为每个孩子投入更多的健康和教育资源，从而让下一代拥有提升孟加拉国未来生活水平所需的健康、营养和教育。

Query_Text_en: Bangladesh has managed to place its foot on the first rung of the ladder of development , and has achieved economic growth and improvements of health and education partly through its own heroic efforts , partly through the ingenuity of NGOs like BRAC and Grameen Bank , and partly through investments that have been made , often at significant scale , by various donor governments that rightly viewed Bangladesh not as a hopeless basket case but as a country worthy of attention , care , and development assistance .
Translation: 孟加拉国已经成功迈上了发展的第一阶梯，并在经济增长、健康和教育等方面取得了进步，这既得益于自身的顽强努力，也得益于像BRAC和格莱珉银行这样的非政府组织的创新举措，还得益于各捐助国政府的大规模投资。这些政府正确地将孟加拉国视为一个值得关注、关心和提供发展援助的国家，而非无望的“篮子案例”。

Query_Text_en: If Bangladesh has one foot on the ladder , India is already several steps up the ladder . The young woman whose computer screen I peered over , in an information technology center in Chennai , is a prototypical employee of the new India . She is twenty five years old and a graduate of a local teacher 's college where she obtained a two year degree following high school . Now she works as a transcriber of data for a new Indian information technology [ IT ] company operating in the capital of the southern state of Tamil Nadu . Chennai is a center of India 's IT revolution , one that is beginning to fuel unprecedented economic growth in this vast country of one billion people . The IT revolution is creating jobs that are unknown in Malawi and still largely unthinkable in Bangladesh , but that are becoming the norm for educated young women in India .
Translation: 如果说孟加拉国刚刚踏上发展之路，印度则已遥遥领先，攀升了好几个台阶。在金奈一家信息技术中心，我曾俯身观察一位年轻女性的电脑屏幕，她正是新印度职场员工的典型代表。她25岁，毕业于本地一所师范学院，高中毕业后获得了为期两年的学位。如今，她在一家新兴的印度信息技术公司担任数据录入员，这家公司位于泰米尔纳德邦首府。金奈是印度信息技术革命的中心，这场革命正推动着这个拥有十亿人口的庞大国家实现前所未有的经济增长。信息技术革命创造了许多在马拉维闻所未闻、在孟加拉国也几乎难以想象的就业岗位，但这些岗位正逐渐成为印度受过教育的年轻女性的常态。

Query_Text_en: This company has a remarkable arrangement with a hospital in Chicago , where doctors dictate their charts and transmit them by satellite to India as voice files at the end of each work day in Chicago . Because of the ten and a half hour time zone difference , the end of each work day in Chicago is the beginning of another in Chennai . When the voice files are received , dozens of young women who have taken a special course in medical data transcription sit in front of computer screens with headphones in place and speedily type in the medical charts of patients almost ten thousand miles away . I listened , for a short bit , to the transcription . The workers there know the medical jargon much better than I do because of their intensive training course and experience . They earn about $ 250 to $ 500 a month , depending on their level of experience , between a tenth and a third of what a medical data transcriber might earn in the United States . Their income is more than twice the earnings of a low skilled industrial worker in India and perhaps eight times the earnings of an agricultural laborer .
Translation: 这家公司与芝加哥的一家医院有着令人称奇的合作安排。医生们在每天工作结束时，将病历口述并通过卫星以语音文件的形式传送到印度。由于芝加哥与印度有十个半小时的时差，芝加哥的工作日结束正好是金奈新一天的开始。语音文件一经接收，数十名接受过医学数据转录专项培训的年轻女性便戴上耳机，坐在电脑屏幕前，迅速将距离近一万英里之外患者的病历录入系统。我曾短暂地听过她们的转录过程。由于经过严格的培训和积累了丰富的经验，这些工作人员对医学术语的掌握远胜于我。她们的月收入约为250至500美元，视经验水平而定，仅为美国医学数据转录员薪资的十分之一到三分之一。她们的收入是印度低技能产业工人的两倍多，甚至是农业劳工的八倍左右。

Query_Text_en: The entrepreneur who started up this firm has close relatives in the United States who made the business connections on the U.S. side . Now the business is thriving . It is moving from data transcription to financial record keeping , and soon into financial consulting and advising for American companies , as well as back office processing operations , or BPO in the new jargon of the global economy . Its employees work in gleaming buildings with broadband Internet facilities , satellite hookups , and videoconferencing capability for the heads of operations who have to be in face to face contact with their counterparts in the United States . They have access to hygienic facilities . They are women whose mothers , typically , were the first in the family to become literate and to gain a foothold in the urban economy [ perhaps as seamstresses in the sweatshops ] , and whose grandmothers were almost without a doubt rural laborers in the overwhelmingly village economy of two generations before .
Translation: 创办这家公司的企业家在美国有近亲，他们为公司在美国方面建立了业务联系。如今，公司业务蒸蒸日上，正从数据录入转向财务记录管理，并即将开展针对美国企业的财务咨询和顾问服务，以及后台处理业务，即全球经济新术语中的BPO。员工们在配备宽带互联网、卫星连接和视频会议功能的现代化大楼里工作，运营负责人能够与美国的合作伙伴进行面对面的交流。他们可以使用卫生设施。这些员工大多是女性，她们的母亲通常是家族中第一代识字并在城市经济中立足的人（也许曾在血汗工厂做裁缝），而她们的祖母几乎可以肯定是两代前以农村为主的经济中从事劳动的农妇。

Query_Text_en: India is vast . Many parts of India , particularly in the north , are still caught in the same backbreaking rural poverty that grips Malawi and parts of Bangladesh . Much of urban India resembles Dhaka . Only a few leading `` growth poles '' share the cutting edge feel of ITdriven Chennai . Throughout the Ganges Valley of northern India , home to two hundred million Indians living in the vast plains of India 's greatest river , the IT revolution has been slow to emerge , if it has emerged at all . Yet so powerful are the new trends in India , not only in IT but also in textiles and apparel , electronics , pharmaceuticals , automotive components , and other sectors , that the overall economic growth of India is reliably now 6 percent or more per year . India is beginning to nip at the heels of China 's growth rates , and investors around the world are warming to the notion of establishing operations , from IT to manufacturing to research and development , in the fast growing Indian economy .
Translation: 印度幅员辽阔。印度的许多地区，尤其是北方，仍深陷与马拉维及孟加拉国部分地区相同的沉重农村贫困之中。印度的许多城市地区也与达卡相似。只有少数几个领先的“增长极”具备以信息技术驱动的金奈那样的前沿气息。在印度最伟大的河流——恒河流域的北部平原上，居住着两亿印度人，信息技术革命在这里尚未显现，或者说进展极为缓慢。然而，印度新兴趋势的力量极为强大，不仅体现在信息技术领域，还包括纺织服装、电子、制药、汽车零部件等多个行业，使得印度整体经济增长率如今稳定在每年6%或更高。印度正开始紧追中国的增长速度，全球投资者也日益看好在这个快速增长的印度经济体中，从信息技术到制造业再到研发等领域开展业务的前景。

Query_Text_en: Progress is hard enough to achieve in the world without being perceived as a danger . One of the ironies of the recent success of India and China is the fear that has engulfed the United States that success in these two countries comes at the expense of the United States . These fears are fundamentally wrong and , even worse , dangerous . They are wrong because the world is not a zero sum struggle in which one country 's gain is another 's loss , but is rather a positive sum opportunity in which improving technologies and skills can raise living standards around the world . Not only are the Indian IT workers providing valuable goods and services to United States consumers , but they are also sitting at terminals with Dell computers , using Microsoft and SAP software , Cisco routers , and dozens of other empowering pieces of technology imported from the developed countries . As India 's economy grows , its consumers opt for a growing array of U.S. and European goods and services for their homes and businesses .
Translation: 在当今世界，取得进步本已殊为不易，更何况还要面对被视为威胁的困境。印度和中国近年来取得的成功，带来的一个讽刺现象是，美国因此陷入了恐惧，担心这两个国家的成功是以美国为代价的。这种担忧从根本上来说是错误的，甚至更糟的是，它是危险的。因为世界并不是一个你输我赢的零和博弈，而是一个正和机会，通过技术和技能的提升，可以提高全球的生活水平。印度的信息技术工作者不仅为美国消费者提供了宝贵的产品和服务，他们本身也在使用戴尔电脑、微软和SAP软件、思科路由器以及其他数十种来自发达国家的先进技术。随着印度经济的增长，印度消费者也越来越多地选择美欧国家的商品和服务来满足家庭和企业的需求。

Query_Text_en: Following another visit to India , I continued on to Beijing , China , where economic development is speeding ahead at full throttle . Beijing has emerged not only as a major capital of the developing world , but also as one of the world 's economic capitals . It is now a booming city of eleven million . Annual income has surpassed $ 4,000 per capita , and the Chinese economy continues to soar at above 8 percent growth per annum .
Translation: 在再次访问印度之后，我继续前往中国北京，这里的经济发展正以全速推进。北京不仅成为发展中国家的重要首都，也跻身世界经济重镇之列。如今，这座拥有一千一百万人口的城市正蓬勃发展，人均年收入已超过四千美元，中国经济仍以每年超过8%的速度持续增长。

Query_Text_en: On one particular night , I was the guest of two young couples , truly young urban professionals , who took me to one of the trendiest nightspots of the city . I tried to listen to them over the operatic duet taking place on the stage , a kind of retrochic performance in which a Maoera revolutionary opera was being performed for a room filled with very well dressed young business executives . Every table had at least one , and usually half a dozen , cell phones lying on it in case any of the hotshot young businessmen and women received calls from clients or the office . As I peered at the opera out of a corner of my eye , my hosts showed me the new cell phones they had just purchased that were also digital cameras . They demonstrated them by sending a picture of me from one phone to the other . This was a gadget that I had not yet seen back home .
Translation: 有一天晚上，我受邀与两对年轻夫妇共度时光，他们是真正的都市白领，带我去了城里最时髦的夜店之一。我努力在舞台上正上演的歌剧二重唱声中倾听他们的谈话，那是一场带有复古时尚风格的表演，演出内容是毛时代的革命样板戏，观众席上坐满了衣着光鲜的年轻商务精英。每张桌子上至少放着一部，通常有五六部手机，以便这些身手不凡的年轻男女随时接听客户或公司的来电。当我用余光打量着台上的表演时，主人们向我展示了他们刚买的新款手机，这些手机还带有数码相机功能。他们现场演示了一下，用一部手机拍下我的照片并发送到另一部手机上。这种新奇的设备，我在家乡还从未见过。

Query_Text_en: I would not have been so stunned had I been in London or New York or Paris or Tokyo . But I was in a country that twenty five years ago was still emerging from the chaos of the Cultural Revolution and decades of turmoil under Mao Tsetung . Within a single generation , China has become one of the most important economies and trading powers of the world .
Translation: 如果我身处伦敦、纽约、巴黎或东京，我不会如此震惊。然而，我所在的国家，二十五年前还在经历文化大革命的混乱，以及毛泽东统治下数十年的动荡。仅仅一代人的时间，中国就已成为世界上最重要的经济体和贸易大国之一。

Query_Text_en: These young Chinese men and women have the chance to attain tremendous affluence , to travel the world , and to enjoy the other benefits of the high living standards available to them because of the powers of globalization . China 's great advance during the past twenty five years reflects the fact that within two decades , it has gone from being a virtually closed society and economy to one of the great export powers of the world . Its exports have been fueled by a vast inflow of foreign investment and technology , which brought the money to build modern factories together with the machinery and techniques to run them , in combination with relatively low cost Chinese workers who are increasingly proficient in skills of all sorts . The result has been the rise , in one industry after another , of highly competitive enterprises that have increased China 's exports from around $ 20 billion in 1980 to around $ 400 billion in 2004 .
Translation: 这些中国的年轻男女有机会获得巨大的财富，周游世界，并享受全球化带来的高生活水平等诸多好处。中国在过去二十五年取得的巨大进步，正是因为在短短二十年间，中国从一个几乎封闭的社会和经济体，转变为世界上最重要的出口大国之一。中国的出口增长得益于大量外资和技术的涌入，这不仅带来了建设现代化工厂所需的资金，也带来了运营这些工厂所需的设备和技术，再加上成本相对较低、技能日益娴熟的中国工人。结果是，在一个又一个行业中，涌现出极具竞争力的企业，使中国的出口额从1980年的约200亿美元增长到2004年的约4000亿美元。

Query_Text_en: What do these four widely divergent images of the globe show us ? We see an almost unimaginable divide between the richest and poorest parts of the world , with all the gradations in between . We glimpse the pivotal roles that science and technology play in the development process . And we sense a progression of development that moves from subsistence agriculture toward light manufacturing and urbanization , and on to high tech services . In Malawi , 84 percent of the population lives in rural areas ; in Bangladesh , 76 percent ; in India , 72 percent ; and in China , 61 percent . In the United States , at the other upper end of the development spectrum , it is just 20 percent . Services account for under 25 percent of employment in Malawi , whereas in the United States , they account for 75 .
Translation: 这四幅截然不同的世界图像向我们展示了什么？我们看到了世界上最富有和最贫穷地区之间几乎难以想象的鸿沟，以及介于两者之间的各种层次。我们还看到了科学和技术在发展进程中所扮演的关键角色。我们能够感受到一种发展的进程，这种进程从自给自足的农业，逐步过渡到轻工业制造和城市化，最终迈向高科技服务业。在马拉维，84%的人口生活在农村地区；在孟加拉国为76%；在印度为72%；在中国为61%。而在发展水平另一端的美国，这一比例仅为20%。在马拉维，服务业就业人数占比不到25%，而在美国，这一比例则高达75%。

Query_Text_en: If economic development is a ladder with higher rungs representing steps up the path to economic wellbeing , there are roughly one billion people around the world , one sixth of humanity , who live as the Malawians do : too ill , hungry , or destitute even to get a foot on the first rung of the development ladder . These people are the `` poorest of the poor , '' or the `` extreme poor '' of the planet . They all live in developing countries [ poverty does exist in rich countries , but it is not extreme poverty ] . Of course , not all of these one billion people are dying today , but they are all fighting for survival each day . If they are the victims of a serious drought or flood , or an episode of serious illness , or a collapse of the world market price of their cash crop , the result is likely to be extreme suffering and perhaps even death . Cash earnings are pennies a day .
Translation: 如果将经济发展比作一架梯子，梯子的每一级都代表着迈向经济福祉的一个步伐，那么全球大约有十亿人——占人类总数的六分之一——像马拉维人一样生活：他们因疾病、饥饿或极度贫困，甚至无法踏上经济发展梯子的第一阶。这些人被称为“最贫困者”或“极端贫困人口”。他们全部生活在发展中国家（虽然富裕国家也存在贫困，但并非极端贫困）。当然，这十亿人并非都在今天死去，但他们每天都在为生存而奋斗。如果他们遭遇严重的干旱或洪水、重病，或是主要经济作物的国际市场价格崩溃，结果往往是极度的苦难，甚至可能导致死亡。他们的现金收入每天仅有几分钱。

Query_Text_en: A few rungs up the development ladder is the upper end of the low income world , where roughly another 1.5 billion people face problems like those of the young women in Bangladesh . These people are `` the poor . They live above mere subsistence . Although daily survival is pretty much assured , they struggle in the cities and countryside to make ends meet . Death is not at their door , but chronic financial hardship and a lack of basic amenities such as safe drinking water and functioning latrines are part of their daily lives . All told , the extreme poor [ at around 1 billion ] and the poor [ another 1.5 billion ] make up around 40 percent of humanity .
Translation: 在发展阶梯上稍高一些的位置，是低收入世界的上层，大约还有15亿人面临着与孟加拉国年轻女性类似的问题。这些人被称为“贫困人口”。他们的生活水平高于仅仅维持生存的状态。虽然日常生存基本有保障，但他们在城市和乡村中依然为维持生计而挣扎。死亡并未威胁到他们的门前，但长期的经济困境以及缺乏安全饮用水和正常厕所等基本设施，依然是他们生活的一部分。总体而言，极端贫困人口（约10亿）和贫困人口（另15亿）加起来约占全球人口的40%。

Query_Text_en: Another 2.5 billion people , including the Indian IT workers , are up yet another few rungs , in the middle income world . These are middle income households , but they would certainly not be recognized as middle class by the standards of rich countries . Their incomes may be a few thousand dollars per year . Most of them live in cities . They are able to secure some comfort in their housing , perhaps even indoor plumbing . They can purchase a scooter and someday even an automobile . They have adequate clothing , and their children go to school . Their nutrition is adequate , and some are even falling into the rich world syndrome of unhealthy fast food .
Translation: 还有25亿人口，包括印度的信息技术工作者，已经再向上迈进了几个台阶，进入了中等收入群体。这些家庭属于中等收入，但按照发达国家的标准，他们还远称不上中产阶级。他们的年收入可能只有几千美元。大多数人生活在城市里，能够在住房方面获得一定的舒适，甚至可能拥有室内管道设施。他们可以买得起一辆摩托车，将来甚至有望拥有汽车。他们有足够的衣物，孩子们能够上学。他们的营养状况尚可，有些人甚至开始出现发达国家常见的快餐不健康综合症。

Query_Text_en: Still higher up the ladder are the remaining one billion people , roughly a sixth of the world , in the high income world . These affluent households include the billion or so people in the rich countries , but also the increasing number of affluent people living in middle income countries the tens of millions of high income individuals in such cities as Shanghai , Sao Paolo , or Mexico City . The young professionals of Beijing are among the fortunate one sixth of the world enjoying twenty first century affluence .
Translation: 再往上，是全球剩下的大约十亿人口，约占世界总人口的六分之一，他们生活在高收入国家。这些富裕家庭不仅包括发达国家的十亿人口，还包括越来越多生活在中等收入国家的富裕人群，比如上海、圣保罗或墨西哥城等城市的数千万高收入者。北京的年轻专业人士也属于这幸运的六分之一，正享受着二十一世纪的富足生活。

Query_Text_en: The good news is that well more than half of the world , from the Bangladesh garment worker onward , broadly speaking , is experiencing economic progress . Not only do they have a foothold on the development ladder , but they are also actually climbing it . Their climb is evident in rising personal incomes and the acquisition of goods such as cell phones , television sets , and scooters . Progress is also evident in such crucial determinants of economic wellbeing as rising life expectancy , falling infant mortality rates , rising educational attainment , increasing access to water and sanitation , and the like .
Translation: 好消息是，全球超过一半的人口——从孟加拉国的服装工人开始——总体而言都在经历经济进步。他们不仅已经在发展阶梯上站稳了脚跟，而且实际上正在不断攀升。这一进步体现在个人收入的增加，以及手机、电视机和摩托车等商品的普及。同时，经济福祉的关键指标也在改善，比如预期寿命的提高、婴儿死亡率的下降、教育水平的提升，以及用水和卫生设施的普及等。

Query_Text_en: The greatest tragedy of our time is that one sixth of humanity is not even on the development ladder . A large number of the extreme poor are caught in a poverty trap , unable on their own to escape from extreme material deprivation . They are trapped by disease , physical isolation , climate stress , environmental degradation , and by extreme poverty itself . Even though life saving solutions exist to increase their chances for survival whether in the form of new farming techniques , or essential medicines , or bed nets that can limit the transmission of malaria ? these families and their governments simply lack the financial means to make these crucial investments . The world 's poor know about the development ladder : they are tantalized by images of affluence from halfway around the world . But they are not able to get a first foothold on the ladder , and so can not even begin the climb out of poverty .
Translation: 我们这个时代最大的悲剧是，人类中有六分之一的人甚至还没有踏上发展的阶梯。大量极端贫困人口被困在贫困陷阱中，无法凭借自身力量摆脱极端的物质匮乏。他们被疾病、地理隔离、气候压力、环境恶化以及极端贫困本身所困。尽管已经有能够拯救生命的解决方案，可以提高他们的生存机会——无论是新的耕作技术、基本药物，还是能够减少疟疾传播的蚊帐——这些家庭和他们的政府却根本没有经济能力进行这些至关重要的投资。世界上的穷人知道发展阶梯的存在：他们被来自世界另一端的富裕景象所吸引。但他们无法在阶梯上获得第一个立足点，因此甚至无法开始摆脱贫困的攀登。

Query_Text_en: There are many definitions , as well as intense debates , about the exact numbers of the poor , where they live , and how their numbers and economic conditions are changing over time . It is useful to start with what is agreed , and then to mention some of the areas of debate . As a matter of definition , it is useful to distinguish between three degrees of poverty : extreme [ or absolute ] poverty , moderate poverty , and relative poverty . Extreme poverty means that households can not meet basic needs for survival . They are chronically hungry , unable to access health care , lack the amenities of safe drinking water and sanitation , can not afford education for some or all of the children , and perhaps lack rudimentary shelter a roof to keep the rain out of the hut , a chimney to remove the smoke from the cook stove and basic articles of clothing , such as shoes . Unlike moderate and relative poverty , extreme poverty occurs only in developing countries . Moderate poverty generally refers to conditions of life in which basic needs are met , but just barely . Relative poverty is generally construed as a household income level below a given proportion of average national income . The relatively poor , in high income countries , lack access to cultural goods , entertainment , recreation , and to quality health care , education , and other perquisites for upward social mobility .
Translation: 关于贫困的定义以及贫困人口的具体数量、分布和其经济状况随时间变化的问题，存在诸多不同观点和激烈争论。我们可以先从已有共识出发，再提及一些争议领域。在定义方面，区分三种贫困程度是有益的：极端（或绝对）贫困、中度贫困和相对贫困。极端贫困指的是家庭无法满足基本生存需求，他们长期处于饥饿状态，无法获得医疗服务，缺乏安全饮用水和卫生设施，无法承担部分或全部子女的教育费用，甚至缺乏基本的住所——比如遮风避雨的屋顶、排烟的烟囱，以及基本的衣物如鞋子。与中度和相对贫困不同，极端贫困仅发生在发展中国家。中度贫困通常指的是基本生活需求勉强得到满足的状态。相对贫困则一般被认为是家庭收入低于国家平均收入的一定比例。在高收入国家，相对贫困者无法获得文化产品、娱乐、休闲，以及优质医疗、教育和其他促进社会向上流动的福利。

Query_Text_en: The World Bank has long used a complicated statistical standard ? income of $ 1 per day per person , measured at purchasing power parity ? to determine the numbers of extreme poor around the world . Another World Bank category , income between $ 1 per day and $ 2 per day , can be used to measure moderate poverty . These measures feature prominently in public policy circles , and most recently were estimated by World Bank economists Shaohua Chen and Martin Ravallion . They estimated that roughly 1.1 billion people were living in extreme poverty in 2001 , down from 1.5 billion in 1981 . Figure la shows the distribution of the world 's extreme poor by region . Each bar signifies the number of poor in the region , with the first bar indicating the number in 1981 , the second bar , in 2001 . The overwhelming share of the world 's extreme poor , 93 percent in 2001 , live in three regions : East Asia , South Asia , and subSaharan Africa . Since 1981 , the numbers of extreme poor have risen in subSaharan Africa , but have fallen in East Asia and South Asia .
Translation: 世界银行长期以来一直使用一个复杂的统计标准——以购买力平价计算的每人每天1美元收入——来确定全球极端贫困人口的数量。世界银行的另一个分类是，每人每天收入在1美元到2美元之间，可以用来衡量中度贫困。这些衡量标准在公共政策领域中占有重要地位，最近由世界银行经济学家陈绍华和Martin Ravallion进行了估算。他们估计，2001年大约有11亿人生活在极端贫困中，低于1981年的15亿人。图1a显示了全球极端贫困人口按地区的分布。每一根柱子代表该地区的贫困人口数量，第一根柱子表示1981年的人数，第二根柱子表示2001年的人数。2001年，全球极端贫困人口中有93%集中在三个地区：东亚、南亚和撒哈拉以南非洲。自1981年以来，撒哈拉以南非洲的极端贫困人口数量有所上升，而东亚和南亚的数量则有所下降。

Query_Text_en: Figure lb repeats the same measurement , but now shows the proportion of the region 's population in extreme poverty , rather than the absolute number . Almost half of Africa 's population is deemed to live in extreme poverty , and that proportion has risen slightly over the period . The proportion of the extreme poor in East Asia has plummeted , from 58 percent in 1981 to 15 percent in 2001 ; in South Asia the progress has also been marked , although slightly less dramatically , from 52 percent to 31 percent . Latin America 's extreme poverty rate is around 10 percent , and relatively stuck ; Eastern Europe 's rose from a negligible level in 1981 to around 4 percent in 2001 , the result of the upheavals of communist collapse and economic transition to a market economy .
Translation: 图1b重复了相同的测量方法，但这次显示的是各地区极端贫困人口所占比例，而非绝对人数。非洲近一半人口被认为生活在极端贫困中，这一比例在所考察期间略有上升。东亚极端贫困人口的比例大幅下降，从1981年的58%降至2001年的15%；南亚的进步也十分显著，虽然幅度略小，从52%降至31%。拉丁美洲的极端贫困率约为10%，基本停滞不前。东欧的极端贫困率则从1981年几乎可以忽略不计的水平上升到2001年的约4%，这主要是由于共产主义崩溃和向市场经济转型带来的剧烈变革所致。

Query_Text_en: Figures 2a and 2b show the calculations for the moderate poor , those living between $ 1 and $ 2 per day . East Asia , South Asia , and sub Saharan Africa continue to dominate the picture , with 87 percent of the world 's 1.6 billion moderately poor . The numbers of moderate poor in East Asia and South Asia have actually risen as the poorest households have improved their circumstances from extreme poverty to moderate poverty . Some 15 percent of Latin Americans live in moderate poverty , a rate that has been fairly constant since 1981 .
Translation: 图2a和图2b展示了中度贫困人口的统计结果，即每日生活费介于1美元至2美元之间的人群。东亚、南亚和撒哈拉以南非洲依然占据主导地位，三者合计占全球16亿中度贫困人口的87%。随着最贫困家庭的生活状况从极端贫困改善到中度贫困，东亚和南亚的中度贫困人口数量实际上有所增加。约有15%的拉美人生活在中度贫困中，这一比例自1981年以来基本保持稳定。

Query_Text_en: I have called this book the General Theory of Employment , Interest and Money , placing the emphasis on the prefix general . The object of such a title is to contrast the character of my arguments and conclusions with those of the classical theory of the subject , upon which I was brought up and which dominates the economic thought , both practical and theoretical , of the governing and academic classes of this generation , as it has for a hundred years past . I shall argue that the postulates of the classical theory are applicable to a special case only and not to the general case , the situation which it assumes being a limiting point of the possible positions of equilibrium . Moreover , the characteristics of the special case assumed by the classical theory happen not to be those of the economic society in which we actually live , with the result that its teaching is misleading and disastrous if we attempt to apply it to the facts of experience .
Translation: 我将本书命名为《就业、利息和货币通论》，并特别强调“通论”这一前缀。这样的标题旨在将我的论证和结论与我所受教育时所依据、并在过去一百年间主导本时代执政阶层和学术界，无论在实践还是理论上都占据主导地位的古典经济理论加以对比。我将论证，古典理论的基本假设只适用于特殊情形，而非一般情形，其所设定的情境只是各种可能均衡状态中的极限情形。此外，古典理论所假定的特殊情形，恰恰并非我们现实经济社会的特征，因此，如果我们试图将其理论应用于实际经验，就会产生误导，甚至带来灾难性的后果。

Query_Text_en: The question , also , of the volume of the available resources , in the sense of the size of the employable population , the extent of natural wealth and the accumulated capital equipment , has often been treated descriptively . But the pure theory of what determines the actual employment of the available resources has seldom been examined in great detail . To say that it has not been examined at all would , of course , be absurd . For every discussion concerning fluctuations of employment , of which there have been many , has been concerned with it . I mean , not that the topic has been overlooked , but that the fundamental theory underlying it has been deemed so simple and obvious that it has received , at the most , a bare mention .
Translation: 关于可用资源的总量问题——即可用劳动力人口的规模、自然财富的范围以及积累的资本设备——往往只是以描述性的方式进行探讨。然而，关于决定可用资源实际就业量的纯理论，却很少被深入研究。说这一问题完全未被研究，当然是荒谬的。因为有关就业波动的讨论——而这类讨论非常多——都涉及到这一问题。我的意思并非这一主题被忽视，而是其背后的基本理论被认为过于简单和显而易见，最多只是被简略提及。

Query_Text_en: The classical theory of employment supposedly simple and obvious has been based , I think , on two fundamental postulates , though practically without discussion , namely : I. The wage is equal to the marginal product of labor
Translation: 所谓的经典就业理论看似简单明了，但我认为它实际上建立在两个基本假设之上，尽管几乎没有经过讨论，即：一、工资等于劳动的边际产出。

Query_Text_en: II . The utility of the wage when a given volume of labor is employed is equal to the marginal disutility of that amount of employment . That is to say , the real wage of an employed person is that which is just sufficient [ in the estimation of the employed persons themselves ] to induce the volume of labor actually employed to be forthcoming ; subject to the qualification that the equality for each individual unit of labor may be disturbed by combination between employable units analogous to the imperfections of competition which qualify the first postulate . Disutility must be here understood to cover every kind of reason which might lead a man , or a body of men , to withhold their labor rather than accept a wage which had to them a utility below a certain minimum .
Translation: 二、在一定劳动量被雇佣的情况下，工资的效用等于该劳动量的边际非效用。也就是说，受雇者的实际工资，正好足以（按照受雇者自身的判断）激励实际被雇佣的劳动量得以供给；但需注意，每个单独劳动单位之间的这种等量关系，可能因劳动单位之间的联合而被打破，这种联合类似于第一条假设中竞争的不完全性。这里所说的“非效用”，应包括所有可能导致个人或群体拒绝提供劳动，而不是接受低于某一最低效用工资的各种原因。

Query_Text_en: This postulate is compatible with what may be called ` frictional ' unemployment . For a realistic interpretation of it legitimately allows for various inexactnesses of adjustment which stand in the way of continuous full employment : for example , unemployment due to a temporary want of balance between the relative quantities of specialised resources as a result of miscalculation or intermittent demand ; or to time-lags consequent on unforeseen changes ; or to the fact that the change-over from one employment to another can not be effected without a certain delay , so that there will always exist in a non-static society a proportion of resources unemployed ` between jobs ' . In addition to ` frictional ' unemployment , the postulate is also compatible with ` voluntary ' unemployment due to the refusal or inability of a unit of labor , as a result of legislation or social practices or of combination for collective bargaining or of slow response to change or of mere human obstinacy , to accept a reward corresponding to the value of the product attributable to its marginal productivity . But these two categories of ` frictional ' unemployment and ` voluntary ' unemployment are comprehensive . The classical postulates do not admit of the possibility of the third category , which I shall define below as ` involuntary ' unemployment .
Translation: 这一假设与所谓的“摩擦性”失业是相容的。因为对其现实的解释合理地允许各种调整上的不精确，这些不精确阻碍了持续的充分就业。例如，由于对专业资源的相对数量出现暂时失衡，可能因误算或需求间歇性波动导致失业；或因不可预见的变化产生的时间滞后；或由于从一种就业转向另一种就业无法立即完成，导致在非静态社会中总会有一部分资源处于“转岗”期间的失业状态。除了“摩擦性”失业之外，该假设还与“自愿性”失业相容，即由于劳动单位因立法、社会惯例、集体谈判的联合、对变化反应迟缓或纯粹的人类固执而拒绝或无法接受与其边际生产力所对应的报酬。这两类“摩擦性”失业和“自愿性”失业已涵盖了全部情况。经典假设并不承认第三类失业的可能性，我将在下文将其定义为“非自愿性”失业。

Query_Text_en: Subject to these qualifications , the volume of employed resources is duly determined , according to the classical theory , by the two postulates . The first gives us the demand schedule for employment , the second gives us the supply schedule ; and the amount of employment is fixed at the point where the utility of the marginal product balances the disutility of the marginal employment . It would follow from this that there are only four possible means of increasing employment :
Translation: 在上述条件下，根据古典理论，资源的使用量由两个基本假设决定。第一个假设为我们提供了就业需求曲线，第二个假设则给出了就业供给曲线；就业数量在边际产出效用与边际就业带来的非效用相平衡的点上确定。由此可见，增加就业只有四种可能的途径：

Query_Text_en: [ a ] An improvement in organization or in foresight which diminishes ` frictional ' unemployment ;
Translation: [ a ] 组织或预见能力的提升，从而减少“摩擦性”失业；

Query_Text_en: [ b ] a decrease in the marginal disutility of labor , as expressed by the real wage for which additional labor is available , so as to diminish ` voluntary ' unemployment ;
Translation: [ b ] 降低劳动的边际负效用，即降低能够吸引更多劳动力的实际工资水平，从而减少“自愿性”失业；

Query_Text_en: [ c ] an increase in the marginal physical productivity of labor in the wage-goods industries [ to use Professor Pigou 's convenient term for goods upon the price of which the utility of the money-wage depends ] ;
Translation: [ c ] 工资品行业劳动边际实际生产率的提高（采用皮古教授的便捷术语，指那些货物，其价格决定了货币工资的效用）；

Query_Text_en: This , to the best of my understanding , is the substance of Professor Pigou 's Theory of Unemployment the only detailed account of the classical theory of employment which exists .
Translation: 据我所知，这就是皮古教授《失业理论》的核心内容，也是现存关于古典就业理论的唯一详尽论述。

Query_Text_en: Is it true that the above categories are comprehensive in view of the fact that the population generally is seldom doing as much work as it would like to do on the basis of the current wage ? For , admittedly , more labor would , as a rule , be forthcoming at the existing money-wage if it were demanded . The classical school reconcile this phenomenon with their second postulate by arguing that , while the demand for labor at the existing money-wage may be satisfied before everyone willing to work at this wage is employed , this situation is due to an open or tacit agreement amongst workers not to work for less , and that if labor as a whole would agree to a reduction of money-wages more employment would be forthcoming . If this is the case , such unemployment , though apparently involuntary , is not strictly so , and ought to be included under the above category of ` voluntary ' unemployment due to the effects of collective bargaining , etc.
Translation: 鉴于一般人口很少能以现行工资从事他们希望的那么多工作，上述分类是否真的已经全面？因为，诚然，如果有需求，通常在现行货币工资下会有更多劳动力愿意出来工作。古典学派通过他们的第二命题来解释这种现象，认为虽然在现行货币工资下对劳动力的需求可能在所有愿意以该工资工作的人都被雇用之前就已经满足了，但这种情况是由于工人之间公开或默许的协议，不愿以更低的工资工作造成的。如果全体劳动力同意降低货币工资，就会有更多就业机会。如果情况确实如此，那么这种失业虽然表面上看似非自愿，其实并非严格意义上的非自愿失业，应该被归入上述由于集体谈判等影响所导致的“自愿”失业类别。

Query_Text_en: Let us assume , for the moment , that labor is not prepared to work for a lower money-wage and that a reduction in the existing level of money-wages would lead , through strikes or otherwise , to a withdrawal from the labor market of labor which is now employed . Does it follow from this that the existing level of real wages accurately measures the marginal disutility of labor ? Not necessarily . For , although a reduction in the existing money-wage would lead to a withdrawal of labor , it does not follow that a fall in the value of the existing money-wage in terms of wage-goods would do so , if it were due to a rise in the price of the latter . In other words , it may be the case that within a certain range the demand of labor is for a minimum money-wage and not for a minimum real wage . The classical school have tacitly assumed that this would involve no significant change in their theory . But this is not so . For if the supply of labor is not a function of real wages as its sole variable , their argument breaks down entirely and leaves the question of what the actual employment will be quite indeterminate . They do not seem to have realized that , unless the supply of labor is a function of real wages alone , their supply curve for labor will shift bodily with every movement of prices . Thus their method is tied up with their very special assumptions , and can not be adapted to deal with the more general case .
Translation: 让我们暂时假设，劳动力不愿意以更低的货币工资工作，并且降低现有的货币工资水平会通过罢工或其他方式导致目前已就业的劳动力退出劳动力市场。那么，这是否意味着现有的实际工资水平准确地衡量了劳动的边际不愉快程度呢？未必如此。因为，尽管降低现有的货币工资会导致劳动力退出，但如果现有货币工资的购买力因工资商品价格上涨而下降，并不一定会产生同样的结果。换句话说，在某一范围内，劳动力的需求可能是对最低货币工资的需求，而不是对最低实际工资的需求。古典学派默许地认为，这不会对他们的理论造成重大影响。但事实并非如此。因为如果劳动力的供给不是实际工资的单一函数，他们的论证就完全站不住脚，实际就业量的问题也就变得无法确定。他们似乎没有意识到，除非劳动力供给仅仅是实际工资的函数，否则他们的劳动力供给曲线会随着每一次价格变动整体移动。因此，他们的方法依赖于他们极为特殊的假设，无法适用于更一般的情形。

Query_Text_en: It would be interesting to see the results of a statistical enquiry into the actual relationship between changes in money-wages and changes in real wages . In the case of a change peculiar to a particular industry one would expect the change in real wages to be in the same direction as the change in money - wages . But in the case of changes in the general level of wages , it will be found , I think , that the change in real wages associated with a change in money-wages , so far from being usually in the same direction , is almost always in the opposite direction . When money-wages are rising , that is to say , it will be found that real wages are falling ; and when money-wages are falling , real wages are rising . This is because , in the short period , falling money-wages and rising real wages are each , for independent reasons , likely to accompany decreasing employment ; labor being readier to accept wage-cuts when employment is falling off , yet real wages inevitably rising in the same circumstances on account of the increasing marginal return to a given capital equipment when output is diminished .
Translation: 如果对货币工资变动与实际工资变动之间的实际关系进行统计调查，其结果将颇具意义。对于某一特定行业的工资变动，我们可以预期实际工资的变动方向与货币工资的变动方向一致。但就整体工资水平的变动而言，我认为，实际工资随货币工资变动的方向不仅通常不一致，反而几乎总是相反的。也就是说，当货币工资上升时，实际工资往往在下降；而当货币工资下降时，实际工资则在上升。这是因为，在短期内，货币工资下降和实际工资上升各自由于不同原因，往往都伴随着就业减少；当就业减少时，劳动力更容易接受降薪，而在同样情况下，由于产出减少时既有资本设备的边际回报提高，实际工资必然上升。

Query_Text_en: Now the assumption that the general level of real wages depends on the money-wage bargains between the employers and the workers is not obviously true . Indeed it is strange that so little attempt should have been made to prove or to refute it . For it is far from being consistent with the general tenor of the classical theory , which has taught us to believe that prices are governed by marginal prime cost in terms of money and that money-wages largely govern marginal prime cost . Thus if money-wages change , one would have expected the classical school to argue that prices would change in almost the same proportion , leaving the real wage and the level of unemployment practically the same as before , any small gain or loss to labor being at the expense or profit of other elements of marginal cost which have been left unaltered . They seem , however , to have been diverted from this line of thought , partly by the settled conviction that labor is in a position to determine its own real wage and partly , perhaps , by preoccupation with the idea that prices depend on the quantity of money . And the belief in the proposition that labor is always in a position to determine its own real wage , once adopted , has been ina ~ ntained by its being confused with the proposition that labor is always in a position to determine what real wage shall correspond to full employment , i.e. the maximum quantity of employment which is compatible with a given real wage .
Translation: 现在，普遍认为实际工资水平取决于雇主与工人之间的货币工资谈判，这一假设并非显而易见。事实上，鲜有人对此进行过充分的论证或反驳，这本身就颇为奇怪。因为这一假设与古典理论的总体倾向并不一致。古典理论教导我们相信，价格受以货币计的边际主要成本支配，而货币工资在很大程度上决定边际主要成本。因此，如果货币工资发生变化，古典学派本应认为价格会以几乎相同比例变化，从而实际工资和失业水平基本保持不变，劳工所获得的微小收益或损失只是其他未变动的边际成本要素的损益。然而，他们似乎偏离了这一思路，部分原因在于他们坚信劳工能够决定自身的实际工资，部分原因或许是他们过于关注价格取决于货币数量的观点。而一旦接受了“劳工始终能够决定自身实际工资”的观点，这一信念又因与“劳工始终能够决定与充分就业相对应的实际工资，即与既定实际工资相适应的最大就业数量”这一命题混淆而被持续维持。

Query_Text_en: To sum up : there are two objections to the second postulate of the classical theory . The first relates to the actual behavior of labor . A fall in real wages due to a rise in prices , with money-wages unaltered , does not , as a rule , cause the supply of available labor on offer at the current wage to fall below the amount actually employed prior to the rise of prices . To sthat it does is to suppose that all those who are now unemployed though willing to work at the current wage will withdraw the offer of their labor in the event of even a small rise in the cost of living . Yet this strange supposition apparently underlies Professor Pigou 's Theory of Unemployment , and it is what all members of the orthodox school are tacitly assuming .
Translation: 总而言之，针对古典理论的第二假设有两点异议。第一点涉及劳动力的实际行为。通常情况下，若由于物价上涨导致实际工资下降，而货币工资保持不变，并不会使以现行工资愿意提供劳动力的人数低于物价上涨前实际受雇的人数。认为会出现这种情况，等于假设所有目前虽愿意以现行工资工作但处于失业状态的人，在生活成本稍有上升时都会撤回劳动力供给。然而，这一奇怪的假设显然是皮古教授《失业理论》的基础，也是所有正统学派成员默认的前提。

Query_Text_en: But the other , more fundamental , objection , which we shall develop in the ensuing chapters , flows from our disputing the assumption that the general level of real wages is directly determined by the character of the wage bargain . In assuming that the wage bargain determines the real wage the classical school have slipt in an illicit assumption . For there may be no method available to labor as a whole whereby it can bring the wage-goods equivalent of the general level of money wages into conformity with the marginal disutility of the current volume of employment . There may exist no expedient by which labor as a whole can reduce its real wage to a given figure by making revised money bargains with the entrepreneurs . This will be our contention . We shall endeavor to show that primarily it is certain other forces which determine the general level of real wages . The attempt to elucidate this problem will be one of our main themes . We shall argue that there has been a fundamental misunderstanding of how in this respect the economy in which we live actually works .
Translation: 但另一个更为根本的反对意见，我们将在接下来的章节中详细阐述，其根源在于我们质疑这样一种假设：即实际工资的一般水平是由工资协商的性质直接决定的。古典学派在假定工资协商决定实际工资时，实际上夹带了一个不合法的假设。因为，劳动者整体可能并没有任何办法能够使货币工资的一般水平所能购买的工资品数量，与当前就业量的边际厌恶程度相一致。劳动者整体也可能没有任何手段，仅仅通过与企业家重新协商货币工资，就能将实际工资降至某一特定水平。这将是我们的主要观点。我们将努力证明，决定实际工资一般水平的，主要是其他某些力量。阐明这一问题将成为我们的主要论题之一。我们将指出，在这一点上，人们对我们所处经济体实际运行方式存在根本性的误解。

Query_Text_en: III Though the struggle over money-wages between individuals and groups is often believed to determine the general level of real-wages , it is , in fact , concerned with a different object . Since there is imperfect mobility of labor , and wages do not tend to an exact equality of net advantage in different occupations , any individual or group of individuals , who consent to a reduction of money-wages relatively to others , will suffer a relative reduction in real wages , which is a sufficient justification for them to resist it . On the other hand it would be impracticable to resist every reduction of real wages , due to a change in the purchasing-power of money which affects all workers alike ; and in fact reductions of real wages arising in this way are not , as a rule , resisted unless they proceed to an extreme degree . Moreover , a resistance to reductions in money-wages applying to particular industries does not raise the same insuperable bar to an increase in aggregate employment which would result from a similar resistance to every reduction in real wages .
Translation: 三、尽管人们常认为个人或群体之间围绕货币工资的博弈决定了实际工资的一般水平，实际上，这种博弈关注的对象并非如此。由于劳动力流动性并不完善，且不同职业间的净收益并不会趋于完全相等，任何个人或群体如果同意其货币工资相对于他人降低，就会在实际工资上遭受相对损失，这足以成为他们加以抵制的正当理由。另一方面，对于因货币购买力变化而导致所有工人实际工资普遍下降的情况，抵制每一次实际工资的降低在实际操作中并不可行；事实上，除非实际工资的下降达到极端程度，否则通常不会遭到抵制。此外，对于特定行业货币工资下降的抵制，并不会像对所有实际工资下降的普遍抵制那样，对整体就业的增加构成无法逾越的障碍。

Query_Text_en: Thus it is fortunate that the workers , though unconsciously , are instinctively more reasonable economists than the classical school , inasmuch as they resist reductions of money-wages , which are seldom or never of an all-round character , even though the existing real equivalent of these wages exceeds the marginal disutility of the existing employment ; whereas they do not resist reductions of real wages , which are associated with increases in aggregate employment and leave relative money-wages unchanged , unless the reduction proceeds so far as to threaten a reduction of the real wage below the marginal disutility of the existing volume of employment . Every trade union will put up some resistance to a cut in money-wages , however small . But since no trade union would dream of striking on every occasion of a rise in the cost of living , they do not raise the obstacle to any increase in aggregate employment which is attributed to them by the classical school .
Translation: 因此，值得庆幸的是，工人们虽然并非有意识，但本能上比古典学派更为理性地看待经济问题，因为他们会抵制货币工资的降低——这种降低很少或几乎不会是全面性的——即便现有工资的实际价值高于现有就业的边际不效用；而对于实际工资的降低，只要这种降低伴随着整体就业的增加且不会改变相对货币工资，他们则不会加以抵制，除非实际工资的降低已经威胁到低于现有就业量的边际不效用。每个工会都会对货币工资的削减提出一定的反对，无论幅度多小。但由于没有任何工会会在生活成本上升时每次都发起罢工，他们并未像古典学派所认为的那样，成为阻碍整体就业增加的障碍。

Query_Text_en: We must now define the third category of unemployment , namely ` involuntary ' unemployment in the strict sense , the possibility of which the classical theory does not admit .
Translation: 现在我们必须界定第三类失业，即严格意义上的“非自愿”失业，而经典理论并不承认这种可能性。

Query_Text_en: Clearly we do not mean by ` involuntary ' unemployment the mere existence of an unexhausted capacity to work . An eight-hour day does not constitute unemployment because it is not beyond human capacity to work ten hours . Nor should we regard as ` involuntary ' unemployment the withdrawal of their labor by a body of workers because they do not choose to work for less than a certain real reward . Furthermore , it will be convenient to exclude ` frictional ' unemployment from our definition of ` involuntary ' unemployment . My definition is , therefore , as follows : Men are involuntarily unemployed If , in the event of a small rise in the price of wage-goods relatively to the money-wage , both the aggregate supply of labor willing to work for the current money-wage and the aggregate demand for it at that wage would be greater than the existing volume of employment . An alternative definition , which amounts , however , to the same thing , will be given in the next chapter [ Chapter 3 ] .
Translation: 显然，我们所说的“非自愿失业”并不是指仅仅存在尚未被充分利用的劳动能力。八小时工作制并不构成失业，因为人类完全有能力工作十小时。同样，如果一群工人因为不愿接受低于某一实际报酬的工资而选择不工作，这种情况也不应被视为“非自愿失业”。此外，为方便起见，我们还应将“摩擦性失业”排除在“非自愿失业”的定义之外。因此，我的定义如下：如果在工资商品价格相对于货币工资略有上升的情况下，愿意以现行货币工资工作的劳动力总供给和以该工资水平的劳动力总需求都超过现有的就业规模，那么这些人就是非自愿失业。另一种定义方式将在下一章（第三章）中给出，实际上与此含义相同。

Query_Text_en: It follows from this definition that the equality of the real wage to the marginal disutility of employment presupposed by the second postulate , realistically interpreted , corresponds to the absence of ` involuntary ' unemployment . This state of affairs we shall describe as ` full ' employment , both ` frictional ' and ` voluntary ' unemployment being consistent with ` full ' employment thus defined . This fits in , we shall find , with other characteristics of the classical theory , which is best regarded as a theory of distribution in conditions of full employment . So long as the classical postulates hold good , unemployment , which is in the above sense involuntary , can not occur . Apparent unemployment must , therefore , be the result either of temporary loss of work of the ` between jobs ' type or of intermittent demand for highly specialised resources or of the effect of a trade union ` closed shop ' on the employment of free labor . Thus writers in the classical tradition , overlooking the special assumption underlying their theory , have been driven inevitably to the conclusion , perfectly logical on their assumption , that apparent unemployment [ apart from the admitted exceptions ] must be due at bottom to a refusal by the unemployed factors to accept a reward which corresponds to their marginal productivity . A classical economist may sympathise with labor in refusing to accept a cut in its money - wage , and he will admit that it may not be wise to make it to meet conditions which are temporary ; but scientific integrity forces him to declare that this refusal is , nevertheless , at the bottom of the trouble .
Translation: 由这一定义可知，第二公设所假定的实际工资等于就业的边际不效用，若作现实解释，则意味着不存在“非自愿”失业。我们将这种状态称为“充分就业”，其中“摩擦性”失业和“自愿性”失业均与上述定义的“充分就业”相容。这一点与古典理论的其他特征相吻合，我们将发现，古典理论最好被视为在充分就业条件下的分配理论。只要古典公设成立，按上述意义的非自愿失业就不会发生。因此，表面上的失业必然是由于“换工作”期间的暂时失业、对高度专业化资源的间歇性需求，或工会“封闭式经营”对自由劳动力就业的影响所致。因此，古典学派的作者们忽略了其理论所依赖的特殊假设，不可避免地得出了一个结论——在他们的假设下完全合乎逻辑——即表面上的失业（除公认的例外外）归根结底是由于失业要素拒绝接受与其边际生产力相对应的报酬。古典经济学家可能会同情劳动者拒绝接受货币工资的削减，并承认在应对暂时性状况时这样做未必明智；但科学诚信迫使他不得不声明，这种拒绝归根结底正是问题的根源。

Query_Text_en: It means that , with a given organization , equipment and technique , real wages and the volume of output [ and hence of employment ] are uniquely correlated , so that , in general , an increase in employment can only occur to the accompaniment of a decline in the rate of real wages . Thus I am not disputing this vital fact which the classical economists have [ rightly ] asserted as indefeasible . In a given state of organization , equipment and technique , the real wage earned by a unit of labor has a unique [ inverse ] correlation with the volume of employment . Thus if employment increases , then , in the short period , the reward per unit of labor in terms of wage-goods must , in general , decline and profits increase . This is simply the obverse of the familiar proposition that industry is normally working subject to decreasing returns in the short period during which equipment etc. is assumed to be constant ; so that the marginal product in the wage-good industries [ which governs real wages ] necessarily diminishes as employment is increased . So long , indeed , as this proposition holds , any means of increasing employment must lead at the same time to a diminution of the marginal product and hence of the rate of wages measured in terms of this product .
Translation: 这意味着，在既定的组织、设备和技术条件下，实际工资与产出量（因此也与就业量）之间存在唯一的相关关系，因此，一般来说，就业的增加只能伴随着实际工资率的下降。因此，我并不否认古典经济学家所坚持的这一重要事实——在既定的组织、设备和技术状态下，每单位劳动所获得的实际工资与就业量之间存在唯一的（反向）相关关系。也就是说，如果就业增加，那么在短期内，每单位劳动以工资商品计的报酬通常会下降，而利润则会上升。这正是大家熟知的命题的另一面：在短期内，设备等被假定为不变，产业通常处于递减收益状态，因此，工资商品行业的边际产出（决定实际工资）必然随着就业增加而减少。只要这一命题成立，任何增加就业的方式都必然导致边际产出的减少，从而以该产出衡量的工资率也会下降。

Query_Text_en: But when we have thrown over the second postulate , a decline in employment , although necessarily associated with labour 's receiving a wage equal in value to a larger quantity of wage-goods , is not necessarily due to labour 's demanding a larger quantity of wage-goods ; and a willingness on the part of labor to accept lower money-wages is not necessarily a remedy for unemployment . The theory of wages in relation to employment , to which we are here leading up , can not be fully elucidated , however , until chapter 19 and its Appendix have been reached .
Translation: 但当我们抛弃了第二个假设后，虽然就业减少必然伴随着劳动者获得等值于更多工资品的工资，但这并不一定是由于劳动者要求更多工资品所致；而劳动者愿意接受较低的货币工资，也不一定能够解决失业问题。我们在此所要引出的关于工资与就业关系的理论，直到第十九章及其附录才能得到全面阐释。

Query_Text_en: From the time of Say and Ricardo the classical economists have taught that supply creates its own demand ; meaning by this in some significant , but not clearly defined , sense that the whole of the costs of production must necessarily be spent in the aggregate , directly or indirectly , on purchasing the product .
Translation: 自萨伊和李嘉图时代以来，古典经济学家一直认为“供给创造自身的需求”；其含义在某种重要但并未明确定义的意义上，是指生产的全部成本最终必然会以总量的形式，直接或间接地用于购买产品。

Query_Text_en: What constitutes the means of payment for commodities is simply commodities . Each person 's means of paying for the productions of other people consist of those which he himself possesses . All sellers are inevitably , and by the meaning of the word , buyers . Could we suddenly double the productive powers of the country , we should double the supply of commodities in every market ; but we should , by the same stroke , double the purchasing power . Everybody would bring a double demand as well as supply ; everybody would be able to buy twice as much , because every one would have twice as much to offer in exchange .
Translation: 商品的支付手段其实就是商品本身。每个人用于支付他人产品的手段，都是他自己所拥有的商品。所有卖家必然也是买家，这正是“卖家”一词的含义。如果我们突然将国家的生产能力翻倍，那么每个市场上的商品供应也会翻倍；与此同时，购买力也会随之翻倍。每个人不仅带来双倍的需求，也带来双倍的供应；每个人都能购买两倍的商品，因为每个人都拥有两倍的商品用于交换。

Query_Text_en: As a corollary of the same doctrine , it has been supposed that any individual act of abstaining from consumption necessarily leads to , and amounts to the same thing as , causing the labor and commodities thus released from supplying consumption to be invested in the production of capital wealth . The following passage from Marshall 's Pure Theory of Domestic Values illustrates the traditional approach :
Translation: 作为同一理论的推论，人们认为任何个人的消费节制行为必然导致，并等同于，使由此释放出来的劳动力和商品不再用于满足消费，而是投入到资本财富的生产中。以下引自马歇尔《国内价值纯理论》的段落，正好说明了这一传统观点：

Query_Text_en: The whole of a man 's income is expended in the purchase of services and of commodities . It is indeed commonly said that a man spends some portion of his income and saves another . But it is a familiar economic axiom that a man purchases labor and commodities with that portion of his income which he saves just as much as he does with that he is said to spend . He is said to spend when he seeks to obtain present enjoyment from the services and commodities which he purchases . He is said to save when he causes the labor and the commodities which he purchases to be devoted to the production of wealth from which he expects to derive the means of enjoyment in the future .
Translation: 一个人的全部收入都用于购买服务和商品。人们通常认为，一个人会花掉部分收入，另一些则用于储蓄。但经济学中有一个常识性的原则，即无论是花掉还是储蓄，一个人都用收入购买劳动力和商品。所谓“花掉”，是指他希望通过购买的服务和商品获得即时的享受；所谓“储蓄”，则是指他让所购买的劳动力和商品用于生产财富，并期望未来能从中获得享受的来源。

Query_Text_en: It is true that it would not be easy to quote comparable passages from Marshall 's later work or from Edgeworth or Professor Pigou . The doctrine is never stated to-day in this crude form . Nevertheless it still underlies the whole classical theory , which would collapse without it . Contemporary economists , who might hesitate to agree with Mill , do not hesitate to accept conclusions which require Mill 's doctrine as their premiss . The conviction , which runs , for example , through almost all Professor Pigou 's work , that money makes no real difference except frictionally and that the theory of production and employment can be worked out [ like Mill 's ] as being based on ` real ' exchanges with money introduced perfunctorily in a later chapter , is the modern version of the classical tradition . Contemporary thought is still deeply steeped in the notion that if people do not spend their money in one way they will spend it in another . Post-war economists seldom , indeed , succeed in maintaining this standpoint consistently ; for their thought to-day is too much permeated with the contrary tendency and with facts of experience too obviously inconsistent with their former view . But they have not drawn sufficiently far-reaching consequences ; and have not revised their fundamental theory .
Translation: 确实，要在马歇尔后期的著作、埃奇沃斯或庇古教授的著作中，找到类似的表述并不容易。如今，这一理论已不再以如此粗糙的形式被陈述。然而，它依然是整个古典理论的基础，离开了它，古典理论便会崩溃。当代经济学家虽然可能对密尔的观点有所保留，但在接受以密尔理论为前提的结论时却毫不犹豫。例如，庇古教授几乎所有著作中贯穿始终的信念——货币除了带来摩擦外并无实质影响，生产与就业理论可以像密尔那样，在以“实物”交换为基础的框架下推导，货币仅在后续章节被例行公事地引入——这正是古典传统的现代版本。当代思想依然深受这样一种观念的影响：如果人们不以某种方式花钱，就会以另一种方式花钱。事实上，战后经济学家很少能始终如一地坚持这一立场，因为他们的思想已深受相反倾向的影响，且现实经验中有太多与以往观点明显不符的事实。但他们并未据此得出足够深远的结论，也未对其基本理论进行修正。

Query_Text_en: In the first instance , these conclusions may have been applied to the kind of economy in which we actually live by false analogy from some kind of non-exchange Robinson Crusoe economy , in which the income which individuals consume or retain as a result of their productive activity is , actually and exclusively , the output in specie of that activity . But , apart from this , the conclusion that the costs of output are always covered in the aggregate by the sale-proceeds resulting from demand , has great plausibility , because it is difficult to distinguish it from another , similar-looking proposition which is indubitable , namely that the income derived in the aggregate by all the elements in the community concerned in a productive activity necessarily has a value exactly equal to the value of the output .
Translation: 首先，这些结论可能是通过对某种非交换性的鲁宾逊式经济体的错误类比，应用到我们实际所处的经济类型中。在这种经济体中，个人因生产活动而消费或保留的收入，实际上完全等同于该活动的产出本身。然而，除此之外，关于产出的成本总是能够通过需求所带来的销售收入在总体上得到覆盖的结论，具有很大的说服力，因为它很难与另一条看似相似、但无可置疑的命题区分开来，即：一个社区中所有参与生产活动的要素所获得的总收入，其价值必然与产出的价值完全相等。

Query_Text_en: It is , then , the assumption of equality between the demand price of output as a whole and its supply price which is to be regarded as the classical theory 's ` axiom of parallels ' . Granted this , all the rest follows the social advantages of private and national thrift , the traditional attitude towards the rate of interest , the classical theory of unemployment , the quantity theory of money , the unqualified advantages of laissez-faire in respect of foreign trade and much else which we shall have to question .
Translation: 因此，正是将总产出需求价格与其供给价格相等这一假设，被视为古典理论的“平行公理”。在此基础上，其余一切便顺理成章：私人和国家节俭的社会效益、对利率的传统看法、古典失业理论、货币数量论、自由放任在对外贸易中的绝对优势，以及其他许多我们将要质疑的内容。

Query_Text_en: [ 1 ] that the real wage is equal to the marginal disutility of the existing employment ;
Translation: [1] 实际工资等于现有就业的边际非效用；

Query_Text_en: [ 2 ] that there is no such thing as involuntary unemployment in the strict sense ;
Translation: [2] 严格意义上并不存在非自愿失业。

Query_Text_en: [ 3 ] that supply creates its own demand in the sense that the aggregate demand price is equal to the aggregate supply price for all levels of output and employment .
Translation: [3] 供给创造自身需求，即在所有产出和就业水平上，总需求价格等于总供给价格。

Query_Text_en: These three assumptions , however , all amount to the same thing in the sense that they all stand and fall together , any one of them logically involving the other two .
Translation: 然而，这三个假设实际上是同一回事，因为它们是相互依存的，任何一个假设在逻辑上都包含另外两个。

Query_Text_en: I We need , to start with , a few terms which will be defined precisely later . In a given state of technique , resources and costs , the employment of a given volume of labor by an entrepreneur involves him in two kinds of expense : first of all , the amounts which he pays out to the factors of production [ exclusive of other entrepreneurs ] for their current services , which we shall call the factor cost of the employment in question ; and secondly , the amounts which he pays out to other entrepreneurs for what he has to purchase from them together with the sacrifice which he incurs by employing the equipment instead of leaving it idle , which we shall call the user cost of the employment in question . The excess of the value of the resulting output over the sum of its factor cost and its user cost is the profit or , as we shall call it , the income of the entrepreneur . The factor cost is , of course , the same thing , looked at from the point of view of the entrepreneur , as what the factors of production regard as their income . Thus the factor cost and the entrepreneur 's profit make up , between them , what we shall define as the total income resulting from the employment given by the entrepreneur . The entrepreneur 's profit thus defined is , as it should be , the quantity which he endeavors to maximize when he is deciding what amount of employment to offer . It is sometimes convenient , when we are looking at it from the entrepreneur 's standpoint , to call the aggregate income [ i.e. factor cost plus profit ] resulting from a given amount of employment the proceeds of that employment . On the other hand , the aggregate supply price of the output of a given amount of employment is the expectation of proceeds which will just make it worth the while of the entrepreneurs to give that employment .
Translation: 首先，我们需要引入一些术语，这些术语将在后文中作出精确定义。在既定的技术状态、资源和成本条件下，企业家雇佣一定数量的劳动，会产生两类支出：第一类，是他向生产要素（不包括其他企业家）支付的当前服务报酬，我们称之为该项雇佣的“要素成本”；第二类，是他为购买其他企业家的产品所支付的金额，以及因使用设备而非闲置所承担的牺牲，我们称之为该项雇佣的“使用成本”。产出价值超过要素成本与使用成本之和的部分，就是利润，或者我们称之为企业家的收入。要素成本，从企业家的角度来看，实际上就是生产要素所获得的收入。因此，要素成本与企业家利润共同构成了我们所定义的由企业家提供的雇佣所带来的总收入。如此定义的企业家利润，正是企业家在决定提供多少就业时力图实现最大化的量。有时，从企业家的角度出发，我们也可以将由一定雇佣量带来的总收入（即要素成本加利润）称为该项雇佣的“收益”。另一方面，某一雇佣量所对应的产出总供给价格，是企业家愿意提供该雇佣量所期望获得的收益。

Query_Text_en: It follows that in a given situation of technique , resources and factor cost per unit of employment , the amount of employment , both in each individual firm and industry and in the aggregate , depends on the amount of the proceeds which the entrepreneurs expect to receive from the corresponding output . For entrepreneurs will endeavor to fix the amount of employment at the level which they expect to maximize the excess of the proceeds over the factor cost .
Translation: 由此可见，在特定的技术条件、资源状况和单位就业要素成本下，无论是单个企业、行业还是整体经济中的就业数量，均取决于企业家对相应产出所预期获得的收益。因为企业家会努力将就业数量确定在他们认为能够使收益超过要素成本的差额达到最大化的水平。

Query_Text_en: Let Z be the aggregate supply price of the output from employing N men , the relationship between Z and Nbeing written Z = f [ N ] , which can be called the aggregate supply function . Similarly , let D be the proceeds which entrepreneurs expect to receive from the employment of N men , the relationship between D and Nbeing written D = f [ N ] , which can be called the aggregate demand function .
Translation: 设Z为雇佣N名工人所产生的总供给价格，Z与N之间的关系可表示为Z = f[N]，这被称为总供给函数。同样，设D为企业家预期因雇佣N名工人而获得的收益，D与N之间的关系可表示为D = f[N]，这被称为总需求函数。

Query_Text_en: Now if for a given value of N the expected proceeds are greater than the aggregate supply price , i.e. if D is greater than Z , there will be an incentive to entrepreneurs to increase employment beyond N and , if necessary , to raise costs by competing with one another for the factors of production , up to the value of Nfor which Zhas become equal to D. Thus the volume of employment is given by the point of intersection between the aggregate demand function and the aggregate supply function ; for it is at this point that the entrepreneurs ' expectation of profits will be maximized . The value of D at the point of the aggregate demand function , where it is intersected by the aggregate supply function , will be called the effective demand . Since this is the substance of the General Theory of Employment , which it will be our object to expound , the succeeding chapters will be largely occupied with examining the various factors upon which these two functions depend .
Translation: 如果对于某一给定的就业人数N，预期收益大于总供给价格，即D大于Z，那么企业家就有动力将就业人数增加到超过N，并且如果需要，还会通过相互竞争争夺生产要素，从而推高成本，直到Z等于D的N值为止。因此，就业总量由总需求函数与总供给函数的交点决定；因为在这一点上，企业家的利润预期将达到最大。总需求函数与总供给函数交点处的D值，被称为“有效需求”。由于这正是就业总论的核心内容，也是我们接下来要阐述的重点，后续章节将主要探讨这两个函数所依赖的各种因素。

Query_Text_en: The classical doctrine , on the other hand , which used to be expressed categorically in the statement that ` Supply creates its own Demand ' and continues to underlie all orthodox economic theory , involves a special assumption as to the relationship between these two functions . For ` Supply creates its own Demand ' must mean that fN ] and f [ N ] are equal for all values of N , i.e. for all levels of output and employment ; and that when there is an increase in Z [ = f [ N ] ] corresponding to an increase in N , D [ = f [ N ] ] necessarily increases by the same amount as Z. The classical theory assumes , in other words , that the aggregate demand price [ or proceeds ] always accommodates itself to the aggregate supply price ; so that , whatever the value of N may be , the proceeds D assume a value equal to the aggregate supply price Z which corresponds to N. That is to say , effective demand , instead of having a unique equilibrium value , is an infinite range of values all equally admissible ; and the amount of employment is indeterminate except in so far as the marginal disutility of labor sets an upper limit .
Translation: 另一方面，经典学说通常以“供给创造自身需求”这一断言来表达，并且至今仍是所有正统经济理论的基础，其实包含了对这两者关系的特殊假设。所谓“供给创造自身需求”，必须意味着对于所有的N值——即所有产出和就业水平——fN和f[N]都是相等的；并且当Z（即f[N]）因N的增加而增加时，D（即f[N]）也必然以同样的幅度增加。换句话说，经典理论假定，社会总需求价格（或收益）总是与社会总供给价格相适应；无论N的取值如何，收益D都等于与N相对应的社会总供给价格Z。也就是说，有效需求并非具有唯一的均衡值，而是存在无限多个同样合理的取值范围；就业数量则是未定的，除非劳动的边际不适效用设定了一个上限。

Query_Text_en: If this were true , competition between entrepreneurs would always lead to an expansion of employment up to the point at which the supply of output as a whole ceases to be elastic , i.e. where a further increase in the value of the effective demand will no longer be accompanied by any increase in output . Evidently this amounts to the same thing as full employment . In the previous chapter we have given a definition of full employment in terms of the behavior of labor . An alternative , though equivalent , criterion is that at which we have now arrived , namely a situation in which aggregate employment is inelastic in response to an increase in the effective demand for its output . Thus Say 's law , that the aggregate demand price of output as a whole is equal to its aggregate supply price for all volumes of output , is equivalent to the proposition that there is no obstacle to full employment . If , however , this is not the true law relating the aggregate demand and supply functions , there is a vitally important chapter of economic theory which remains to be written and without which all discussions concerning the volume of aggregate employment are futile .
Translation: 如果这一观点成立，企业家之间的竞争将始终推动就业规模扩大，直到整体产出供应不再具有弹性，也就是说，当有效需求的价值进一步增加时，产出将不再随之增长。显然，这与充分就业的概念是一致的。在上一章中，我们已经从劳动力行为的角度对充分就业进行了定义。现在我们得出了另一种等价的标准，即在有效需求增加时，整体就业对产出需求的反应变得无弹性的情形。因此，萨伊定律——即无论产出规模如何，整体产出需求价格总等于整体供应价格——实际上等同于认为充分就业不存在任何障碍。然而，如果这并非描述整体需求与供应函数的真实规律，那么经济理论中还有一个至关重要的章节尚未写成，而没有这一部分，关于整体就业规模的所有讨论都将毫无意义。

Query_Text_en: A brief summary of the theory of employment to be worked out in the course of the following chapters may , perhaps , help the reader at this stage , even though it may not be fully intelligible . The terms involved will be more carefully defined in due course . In this summary we shall assume that the money - wage and other factor costs are constant per unit of labor employed . But this simplification , with which we shall dispense later , is introduced solely to facilitate the exposition . The essential character of the argument is precisely the same whether or not money-wages , etc. , are liable to change .
