Query_Text_en: In the near term , Beijing 's new push for wider use of yuan abroad could help the offshore market continue to grow , the result of increased trade and investment flows and bond sales .
Translation: 在短期内，北京推动人民币在海外更广泛使用的新举措，可能有助于离岸市场的持续增长，这得益于贸易和投资流动的增加以及债券发行的扩大。

Query_Text_en: The market for yuan bonds , known as dim sum bonds , has tripled in size this year , to about 210 billion yuan of debt outstanding , according to HSBC .
Translation: 汇丰银行表示，离岸人民币债券市场（即“点心债”市场）今年规模已增长三倍，未偿还债务总额约为2100亿元人民币。

Query_Text_en: But growth in new bond sales is likely to slow next year as investors dial down their expectations for yuan appreciation , said Michael Lam , director of Asia debt capital markets at Deutsche Bank AG .
Translation: 德意志银行亚洲债务资本市场总监林迈克尔表示，随着投资者对人民币升值的预期逐渐降低，明年新债发行的增长速度可能会放缓。

Query_Text_en: ` Earlier this year , people were expecting yuan deposits to reach one trillion yuan by the end of this year , ' he said , ` Now this is obviously looking like a very tough target , ' he said .
Translation: 他说：“今年年初，人们还预计到年底人民币存款将达到一万亿元。”他表示：“现在看来，这显然是一个非常艰难的目标。”

Query_Text_en: Baosteel Group Corp. , a state-owned steelmaker based in Shanghai , on Thursday became the first mainland Chinese company outside the financial sector to sell dim sum bonds .
Translation: 总部位于上海的国有钢铁企业宝钢集团有限公司于周四成为首家在金融行业之外发行点心债的中国内地企业。

Query_Text_en: The company sold 3.6 billion yuan of the bonds for yields ranging from 3.125 % to 4.375 % .
Translation: 该公司发行了36亿元人民币的债券，票面利率区间为3.125%至4.375%。

Query_Text_en: China also is moving to lessen the red tape issuers of dim-sum bonds , especially foreign companies , face in bringing money back to the mainland .
Translation: 中国也在采取措施，简化点心债发行人，尤其是外国公司，将资金汇回内地时所面临的繁琐审批程序。

Query_Text_en: ` Multinational corporations would likely find it more predictable now than before whether they can send the proceeds back , ' said Augusto King , co-head of debt capital markets in Asia for Royal Bank of Scotland .
Translation: “现在跨国公司是否能够将收益汇回，比以前更具可预测性，”苏格兰皇家银行亚洲债务资本市场联席主管奥古斯托·金表示。

Query_Text_en: While Yao Ming was growing up in Shanghai , wine was served with ice cubes .
Translation: 姚明在上海成长的时期，葡萄酒是加冰块一起饮用的。

Query_Text_en: It was n't until the 7-foot-6-inch Chinese basketball player spent time with National Basketball Association teammate Dikembe Mutombo , a 7-foot-2-inch Congolese player , that he began to appreciate wine .
Translation: 直到这位身高七英尺六英寸的中国篮球运动员与身高七英尺二英寸的刚果籍国家篮球协会队友迪肯贝·穆托姆博相处之后，他才开始欣赏葡萄酒。

Query_Text_en: ' I always watched him at our dinners and I 'd sometimes ask him ` Why are you doing that ? '' said Mr. Yao , swirling an imaginary glass . ' I was just trying to copy him . '
Translation: “我总是在我们吃饭的时候观察他，有时候我会问他‘你为什么要那样做？’”姚先生一边旋转着一只假想的酒杯一边说。“我只是想模仿他。”

Query_Text_en: Now retired and living in his native Shanghai , Mr. Yao is an unlikely connoisseur and a trailblazer on the Chinese wine scene .
Translation: 现已退休并定居于家乡上海的姚先生，是中国葡萄酒界一位颇为意外的鉴赏家和开拓者。

Query_Text_en: The 31-year-old is launching his own Californian winery geared exclusively for the Chinese market this week called Yao Family Wines .
Translation: 这位31岁的企业家本周将推出专为中国市场打造的加州酒庄——姚家葡萄酒。

Query_Text_en: Distributed by French beverage giant Pernod Ricard SA , bottles in the first 5,000-case run will be labeled simply Yao Ming and aimed at the top end of the market .
Translation: 由法国饮料巨头保乐力加公司负责分销，首批5,000箱的酒瓶将仅以“姚明”命名，定位于高端市场。

Query_Text_en: The wine , made from cabernet sauvignon grapes harvested in 2009 from California 's Napa Valley , is priced at 1,775 yuan -LRB- US$ 289 -RRB- a bottle .
Translation: 这款葡萄酒采用2009年加利福尼亚纳帕谷的赤霞珠葡萄酿制，每瓶售价为1775元人民币（合289美元）。

Query_Text_en: -LRB- The price includes a 27 % import duty and a 17 % sales tax . -RRB- A second wine , called Yao Family Reserve , will be released later this year , and its small 500-case production will be even pricier .
Translation: （价格已包含27%的进口关税和17%的销售税。）另一款名为“姚家珍藏”的葡萄酒将于今年晚些时候推出，其限量生产仅500箱，价格将更加昂贵。

Query_Text_en: Yao Family Wines currently does n't own any vineyards in California , but is aiming to acquire land in the next few years .
Translation: 姚氏家族酒庄目前在加利福尼亚尚未拥有任何葡萄园，但计划在未来几年内购置土地。

Query_Text_en: California could n't have a better pitchman in China than Mr. Yao .
Translation: 加利福尼亚在中国找不到比姚先生更好的代言人了。

Query_Text_en: He is one of the country 's biggest stars and is credited with boosting China 's interest in the NBA .
Translation: 他是中国最著名的明星之一，被认为推动了中国对NBA的关注。

Query_Text_en: During his nine seasons with the Houston Rockets , his games were broadcast on national television in China , and he was selected to carry China 's flag during the opening ceremonies at the 2008 Olympics in Beijing .
Translation: 在他为休斯顿火箭队效力的九个赛季中，他的比赛在中国国家电视台播出，并在2008年北京奥运会开幕式上被选为中国代表团旗手。

Query_Text_en: He has endorsed everything from Apple Inc. products to his father 's Chinese restaurant in Houston .
Translation: 他曾为各种产品代言，从苹果公司的产品到他父亲在休斯敦经营的中餐馆。

Query_Text_en: But wine imported into China came predominantly from France , and he spotted a market opportunity for Californian wines .
Translation: 但中国进口的葡萄酒主要来自法国，他看到了加州葡萄酒的市场机会。

Query_Text_en: Mr. Yao asked BDA Sports International , the agency that represents him , to explore the idea of starting his own Napa Valley winery .
Translation: 姚先生委托代表他的BDA国际体育公司，探索创办自己纳帕谷酒庄的可能性。

Query_Text_en: including winemaker Tom Hinde , who had made wines for Flowers Vineyard and Winery and Kendall-Jackson Wine Estates .
Translation: 包括酿酒师汤姆·海德，他曾为弗劳尔斯葡萄园酒庄和肯德尔-杰克逊酒庄酿制葡萄酒。

Query_Text_en: We wanted to capture that in the wine . '
Translation: 我们希望将这一点体现在葡萄酒中。

Query_Text_en: Mr. Hinde insists Yao Family Wines is n't a short-lived bid to capitalize on China 's wine boom and the star 's celebrity before either of them wane .
Translation: 亨德先生坚称，姚家葡萄酒并不是为了在中国葡萄酒热潮和姚明的明星效应消退之前，短暂地借机获利。

Query_Text_en: He said the business plan is based on a 10-year timeline .
Translation: 他说，这项商业计划以十年为周期制定。

Query_Text_en: Mr. Hinde and four others involved with the winery are minority shareholders in the venture , while Mr. Yao is the principal owner .
Translation: Hinde先生和其他四位与酒庄相关的人士是该项目的少数股东，而姚先生则是主要所有者。

Query_Text_en: Neither Mr. Yao nor his winemaking team disclosed how much has been invested , though wine-industry experts estimate that it requires $ 2 to $ 5 million to get a winery to reach full production .
Translation: 姚先生及其酿酒团队均未透露具体投资金额，但业内专家估计，要使一家酒庄实现全面投产，所需投资约为200万至500万美元。

Query_Text_en: While most of the wine sold in China is from domestic sources , the imported market has grown dramatically .
Translation: 尽管中国市场上销售的葡萄酒大多为国产产品，但进口葡萄酒市场增长迅猛。

Query_Text_en: China has a heavy bias toward French wines .
Translation: 中国对法国葡萄酒有着明显的偏好。

Query_Text_en: Last year , France led bottled-wine imports with a 47 % market share .
Translation: 去年，法国以47%的市场份额位居瓶装葡萄酒进口首位。

Query_Text_en: Australia ranked a distant second with 16 % of the market .
Translation: 澳大利亚以16%的市场份额位居第二，差距较大。

Query_Text_en: The U.S. came in sixth , trailing Italy , Spain and Chile , with a 6.4 % share .
Translation: 美国以6.4%的市场份额位列第六，落后于意大利、西班牙和智利。

Query_Text_en: Chinese collectors have bid top dollar for the world 's most sought-after bottles of Bordeaux and Burgundy at auctions in Hong Kong , putting the city ahead of London and New York in sales .
Translation: 中国收藏家在香港的拍卖会上为全球最受追捧的波尔多和勃艮第葡萄酒出价高昂，使香港在销售额上超过伦敦和纽约。

Query_Text_en: In September , an anonymous Chinese bidder spent $ 539,280 on a single lot of 300 bottles of Chateau Lafite-Rothschild wine at a Sotheby 's wine auction in Hong Kong .
Translation: 今年九月，一位匿名中国买家在香港苏富比葡萄酒拍卖会上，以53.928万美元购得一批共300瓶拉菲酒庄葡萄酒。

Query_Text_en: Mr. Yao 's new winery is n't his only business venture .
Translation: 姚先生的新酒庄并非他的唯一商业项目。

Query_Text_en: He is the owner of his first professional basketball team , the Shanghai Sharks , and an investor in a digital-music site called Top100.cn .
Translation: 他是他第一支职业篮球队——上海大鲨鱼队的拥有者，同时也是数字音乐网站Top100.cn的投资人。

Query_Text_en: Mr. Yao is also attending classes at Shanghai Jiaotong University .
Translation: 姚先生也在上海交通大学上课。

Query_Text_en: He is going to miss a day of school this week for one of the many launch events scheduled for the new winery .
Translation: 本周，他将因参加新酒庄众多启动活动之一而缺席一天课程。

Query_Text_en: ` I 'll need an extra bottle for my history professor so he can give me a good grade and let me skip his class , ' Mr. Yao said .
Translation: 姚先生说：“我还需要多带一瓶给我的历史教授，这样他就能给我一个好成绩，还让我不用上他的课。”

Query_Text_en: Companies that provide the plumbing for the $ 4 trillion-a-day foreign-exchange market are testing systems that could handle trading of previously shelved European currencies .
Translation: 为日交易额达4万亿美元的外汇市场提供基础设施的公司，正在测试能够处理此前已被搁置的欧洲货币交易的系统。

Query_Text_en: ICAP PLC , which operates the biggest system for enabling currency trades between banks , said Sunday that it is prepping electronic-trading systems for a possible exit by Greece from the euro zone and a return of the drachma , the country 's previous currency .
Translation: ICAP PLC表示，该公司运营着全球最大的银行间货币交易系统，目前正在为希腊可能退出欧元区、重新启用其前货币德拉克马而准备电子交易系统。

Query_Text_en: CLS Bank International , whose platform enables banks to settle their currency trades , is running ` stress tests ' to prepare for a dissolution of the euro , people familiar with the matter said .
Translation: 据知情人士透露，CLS银行国际公司正在进行“压力测试”，以应对欧元解体的可能。该公司的平台能够帮助银行完成货币交易结算。

Query_Text_en: Several politicians have acknowledged that the situation is increasingly perilous .
Translation: 多位政界人士已承认，局势正变得日益危险。

Query_Text_en: Italian Prime Minister Mario Monti on Friday said top European leaders raised the prospect of the end of the euro , acknowledging in a meeting with him that the collapse of Italy 's austerity measures would likely mean the end of the 17-member currency union .
Translation: 意大利总理马里奥·蒙蒂周五表示，欧洲主要领导人提出了欧元终结的可能性，并在与他会面时承认，如果意大利的紧缩措施崩溃，17国货币联盟也很可能随之瓦解。

Query_Text_en: U.K. Chancellor of the Exchequer George Osborne said Sunday the government has stepped up its planning measures in recent months to be prepared for a possible collapse of the euro zone .
Translation: 英国财政大臣乔治·奥斯本周日表示，英国政府近年来已加强相关规划措施，以应对欧元区可能出现的崩溃局面。

Query_Text_en: The U.K. is n't a member of the euro zone , but it is home to Europe 's financial hub and is the world 's biggest currency-dealing center .
Translation: 英国虽然不是欧元区成员国，但却是欧洲金融中心所在地，也是全球最大的外汇交易中心。

Query_Text_en: ` Countries like Germany and France have now openly asked the question whether countries like Greece can stay in the euro , ' Mr. Osborne told the British Broadcasting Corp. .
Translation: 奥斯本先生在接受英国广播公司采访时表示：“像德国和法国这样的国家现在已经公开提出，像希腊这样的国家是否还能留在欧元区的问题。”

Query_Text_en: ` It is a very , very difficult and dangerous situation . '
Translation: “这是一个非常非常艰难且危险的局势。”

Query_Text_en: Leaders of the euro zone are slated to meet again this week to try to shore up plans to contain the bloc 's burgeoning debt crisis .
Translation: 欧元区领导人计划于本周再次会面，努力加强遏制该地区不断扩大的债务危机的方案。

Query_Text_en: Proposals on the table include bulking up a bailout fund , and some policy makers have called for the European Central Bank to do more to bolster government bond markets , where yields on sovereign debt have shot up in recent weeks .
Translation: 目前的提议包括扩大救助基金的规模，一些政策制定者还呼吁欧洲央行采取更多措施，以提振政府债券市场，近期主权债券收益率大幅上升。

Query_Text_en: ` It is becoming increasingly evident that institutional investors are frantically shuffling through a menu of post-euro scenarios , ' analysts at independent research firm GaveKal Research wrote in a report Friday . ` The fact that investors are even considering such options underlines the current key problem for the European bond market : credibility . '
Translation: 独立研究机构GaveKal Research的分析师在周五的一份报告中写道：“机构投资者正在疯狂地翻查各种欧元后时代的方案，这一点正变得越来越明显。投资者甚至开始考虑这些选项，凸显了当前欧洲债券市场的核心问题：公信力。”

Query_Text_en: It is n't uncommon for financial institutions to prepare for worst-case scenarios , even if they do n't rate them as having a high likelihood .
Translation: 金融机构为最坏情况做准备并不罕见，即使他们认为这种情况发生的可能性并不高。

Query_Text_en: Bank of America Merrill Lynch analysts in London issued a report on Friday that suggested how the euro would react to any breakup , and placed a value on individual currencies from the mark to the French franc to the lira .
Translation: 美国银行美林证券伦敦分析师于周五发布报告，探讨了欧元在任何解体情况下的反应，并对包括德国马克、法国法郎和意大利里拉在内的各国货币进行了估值。

Query_Text_en: While a breakup is n't a ` base-case ' scenario , the analysts noted , ` It is worth considering . '
Translation: 分析师指出，尽管分裂并非“基本情形”，但“值得加以考虑”。

Query_Text_en: Analysts at other banks , including Japan 's Nomura Holdings , have also released reports discussing the prospect of the end of the euro .
Translation: 包括日本野村控股在内的其他银行的分析师也发布了报告，讨论欧元终结的可能性。

Query_Text_en: Nomura has advised clients to check the fine print of their euro-denominated bonds to ascertain whether they could be converted into local currencies , such as the drachma , which could quickly plunge .
Translation: 野村证券建议客户仔细查阅其以欧元计价的债券条款，以确认这些债券是否可能被转换为当地货币，如德拉克马，而后者可能会迅速贬值。

Query_Text_en: Barclays Capital last week said almost half the 1,000 investors it surveyed thought at least one country would leave the euro in 2012 .
Translation: 巴克莱资本上周表示，在其调查的1000名投资者中，近一半认为至少有一个国家将在2012年退出欧元区。

Query_Text_en: ICAP 's executives say their preparations have focused on defining the relationship between the drachma and other currencies and how currency pairs might be quoted .
Translation: ICAP的高管表示，他们的准备工作主要集中在界定德拉克马与其他货币之间的关系，以及货币对的报价方式。

Query_Text_en: ` What precipitated this were customer concerns , ' said Edward Brown , executive vice president in business development and research at ICAP .
Translation: “引发这一情况的原因是客户的担忧，”ICAP公司业务发展与研究执行副总裁爱德华·布朗表示。

Query_Text_en: The firm has been testing technology that would allow dealer banks to trade the drachma against the dollar and the euro , the executives said .
Translation: 高管表示，公司一直在测试一项技术，允许交易商银行将德拉克马与美元和欧元进行交易。

Query_Text_en: They said the measures taken in recent weeks are precautionary and that the currency wo n't be accessible for trading unless required by market events .
Translation: 他们表示，最近几周采取的措施是预防性的，除非市场情况需要，否则该货币不会对外开放交易。

Query_Text_en: Firms such as ICAP are attempting to anticipate what would be likely to happen in the hours and days of the initial shock if a breakup were to occur .
Translation: 像ICAP这样的公司正在试图预测，如果发生分裂，在最初冲击的数小时和数天内可能会出现的情况。

Query_Text_en: ICAP executives say their drachma project could be used as a roadmap for how to prepare for an outcome involving multiple currencies exiting the euro .
Translation: ICAP高管表示，他们的德拉克马项目可以作为一份路线图，指导如何为多种货币退出欧元区的情形做好准备。

Query_Text_en: The firm has dusted off old drachma templates for spot foreign-exchange and derivatives called nondeliverable forwards , which were archived after Greece joined the euro a decade ago and which serve as the nuts and bolts of a trade-matching engine .
Translation: 该公司重新启用了十年前希腊加入欧元区后被封存的旧版德拉克马即期外汇和衍生品（即不可交割远期合约）模板，这些模板作为交易撮合引擎的核心工具。

Query_Text_en: China May Find It Hard to Break Fall
Translation: 中国或难阻经济下行

Query_Text_en: A key measure of conditions in China 's manufacturing sector to be released this week could provide further evidence of deteriorating output in the world 's second-largest economy .
Translation: 本周即将公布的一项衡量中国制造业状况的关键指标，可能会进一步印证这个世界第二大经济体产出恶化的迹象。

Query_Text_en: Stock markets will be focused on whether the official purchasing managers index will fall below the 50 mark that signals contraction .
Translation: 股市将关注官方采购经理人指数是否会跌破50这一代表经济收缩的临界点。

Query_Text_en: It registered 50.4 in October .
Expectations are already low , after a report last week from an HSBC survey of purchasing managers pointed to a fall in manufacturing output .
Translation: 上周，汇丰银行对采购经理的调查报告显示制造业产出下降，因此市场预期已经较低。

Query_Text_en: The HSBC poll has a smaller sample than the official one and the two polls can sometimes offer differing outlooks . But markets are expecting the official reading to be similarly dour .
Translation: 汇丰的调查样本量小于官方调查，两者有时会给出不同的前景预期。但市场普遍预计，官方数据的表现也将同样低迷。

Query_Text_en: For example , a reduction in the reserve-requirement ratio , freeing up resources for banks to lend more , would be a sure sign of a move to pro-growth policy .
Translation: 例如，降低存款准备金率，释放银行更多可用于贷款的资金，将是转向促进增长政策的明确信号。

Query_Text_en: And an uptick in lending would provide some relief to Shanghai 's hard-pressed stock market , which is down 15 % this year .
Translation: 信贷的增加将为上海备受压力的股市带来一定缓解，而该股市今年已下跌了15%。

Query_Text_en: But stubborn inflation may limit the government 's room to maneuver .
Translation: 但顽固的通胀可能会限制政府的操作空间。

Query_Text_en: The picture is further clouded by economic uncertainty around the globe , largely thanks to Europe 's crisis , which makes it difficult to gauge the outlook for Chinese exporters .
Translation: 全球经济的不确定性，主要源于欧洲的危机，使得中国出口企业的前景难以判断，进一步加剧了局势的复杂性。

Query_Text_en: All of this may make it more likely that Beijing will bide its time before signaling a major policy shift .
Translation: 所有这些因素可能会使北京在发出重大政策转变信号之前更加倾向于观望等待。

Query_Text_en: In that case , it will take more than continued fine-tuning policy to get Chinese stocks back into gear .
Translation: 在这种情况下，仅靠持续优化政策已难以推动中国股市重新回到正轨。

Query_Text_en: China will maintain its tightening measures in property sectors next year and continue its efforts to construct affordable housing , state-run media reported Sunday , citing Vice Premier Li Keqiang .
Translation: 据国家媒体周日报道，副总理李克强表示，明年中国将继续对房地产行业实施调控措施，并将持续推进保障性住房建设。

Query_Text_en: There has been speculation among some economists that authorities may ease controls on the property market if a steep drop in prices threatens economic growth .
Translation: 一些经济学家猜测，如果房价大幅下跌威胁到经济增长，相关部门可能会放松对房地产市场的管控。

Query_Text_en: ` Tightening measures in the property sector have had a certain effect , ' Mr. Li said . ` The market is entering a critical period , so we must stick to the policy stance of curbing -LSB- the -RSB- overly fast increase of housing prices . '
Translation: 李先生表示：“房地产行业的调控措施已经取得了一定成效。目前市场正处于关键时期，因此我们必须坚持遏制房价过快上涨的政策立场。”

Query_Text_en: The high cost of housing has been a key complaint across the country , and Beijing views the problem as a potential source of social unrest .
Translation: 高房价一直是全国范围内的主要投诉问题，北京方面将其视为潜在的社会不稳定因素。

Query_Text_en: Since April 2010 , China has launched a raft of measures to curb property prices , including higher down-payments , limits on the number of residences people can own , the introduction of a property tax in some cities and the construction of low-income housing .
Translation: 自2010年4月以来，中国出台了一系列遏制房价的措施，包括提高首付比例、限制个人购房套数、在部分城市试点房产税以及建设保障性住房。

Query_Text_en: Mr. Li also urged local governments to ensure the construction of affordable housing and the quality of such homes . ` Construction of affordable housing will give a large boost to consumption and investment , which are key to China amid the global economic slowdown , ' Mr. Li said .
Translation: 李先生还敦促地方政府切实推进保障性住房建设，并确保住房质量。他表示：“保障性住房建设将极大促进消费和投资，这对于在全球经济放缓背景下的中国来说至关重要。”

Query_Text_en: ` It matters a lot to maintain China 's stable and fast economic growth , ' he added .
Translation: 他补充道：“保持中国经济的稳定快速增长至关重要。”

Query_Text_en: It is exactly the kind of investment on which heads of state and government will be focused as they fly into the Indonesian holiday island of Bali this week for the annual summit of the 10-country Association of Southeast Asian Nations .
Translation: 这正是各国元首和政府首脑本周飞往印度尼西亚度假胜地巴厘岛，参加东南亚国家联盟（东盟）十国年度峰会时所关注的那类投资。

Query_Text_en: Yet there is a paradox .
Translation: 然而，这其中存在一个悖论。

Query_Text_en: China 's banks have been building up their bulwarks against bad loans , underscoring the potential risk to the financial system in the world 's No. 2 economy even amid other signs that growth is picking up again .
Translation: 中国各大银行一直在加大对不良贷款的防控力度，这凸显出即便在其他经济增长回暖迹象显现的情况下，全球第二大经济体的金融体系仍面临潜在风险。

Query_Text_en: China 's biggest state-run banks since last week have reported double-digit profit growth for the third quarter - with some beating estimates - and flat or declining nonperforming loans , typically of 1 % or less of their portfolios .
Translation: 自上周以来，中国最大的国有银行公布了第三季度的利润实现两位数增长，其中部分银行业绩超出预期；不良贷款率保持稳定或有所下降，通常占其贷款组合的1%或更低。

Query_Text_en: Industrial & Commercial Bank of China Ltd. , China 's largest bank by assets , on Tuesday reported a 15 % rise in net profit compared with a year earlier .
Translation: 中国资产规模最大的银行——中国工商银行有限公司周二公布，其净利润同比增长15%。

Query_Text_en: But China 's biggest banks increased their provisions against nonperforming loans for the third consecutive quarter .
Translation: 但中国最大的几家银行已连续第三个季度提高了不良贷款拨备。

Query_Text_en: ICBC said Tuesday that its provisions are 288.33 % of nonperforming loans , up 21.44 percentage points from the end of last year .
Translation: 工商银行周二表示，其拨备覆盖率为288.33%，较去年年底上升21.44个百分点。

Query_Text_en: The banks have cited improved credit-quality controls in recent years for helping them avoid nonperforming loans . ` If economic growth is still stuck at a low point , bad loans may increase , but that increase should be capped , ' said Yang Dongping , chief risk officer for Bank of Communications , at a Tuesday news conference .
Translation: 近年来，银行表示，通过加强信贷质量控制，帮助其避免了不良贷款。交通银行首席风险官杨东平在周二的新闻发布会上表示：“如果经济增长仍处于低位，不良贷款可能会上升，但这种上升应该是可控的。”

Query_Text_en: It said its provisions were 263.26 % of nonperforming loans , up 6.89 percentage points from the end of last year .
Translation: 其拨备覆盖率为不良贷款的263.26%，较去年年底上升6.89个百分点。

Query_Text_en: Chinese banks ' profit growth has been exceptionally high in recent years , as the banks reaped the benefits of expanding their loan books in 2009 to fuel a construction and investment boom that supported the economy in the wake of the global financial crisis .
Translation: 近年来，中国银行业的利润增长异常迅猛。2009年，银行通过扩大贷款规模，助推了建筑和投资热潮，从而在全球金融危机后为经济提供了有力支撑，银行也因此获得了丰厚回报。

Query_Text_en: However , analysts say many of those loans are likely to present headaches for the banks in coming years as falling profits make it difficult for companies to make repayments and with many bank-backed infrastructure projects unlikely to generate revenue for some time .
Translation: 然而，分析人士表示，随着企业利润下滑导致还款困难，以及许多银行支持的基础设施项目在短期内难以产生收益，这些贷款在未来几年很可能会给银行带来不少麻烦。

Query_Text_en: The banks will likely also face pressure as China moves to liberalize interest rates , which is expected to eat into the net interest margins - or the spread between interest rates charged for loans and paid on deposits - that Chinese banks typically enjoy .
Translation: 随着中国推进利率市场化，银行也可能面临压力，这预计将侵蚀中国银行通常享有的净利息差——即贷款利率与存款利率之间的差额。

Query_Text_en: Given those factors , bank profit growth ` will get slower going into next year , ' said Mike Werner , an analyst with Bernstein Research in Hong Kong .
Translation: 伯恩斯坦研究公司驻香港分析师迈克·沃纳表示：“鉴于这些因素，银行利润增速在进入明年后将会放缓。”

Query_Text_en: ` We expect earnings growth to come down to low single-digits and in some cases no growth for some banks . '
Translation: 我们预计银行的盈利增速将降至个位数，部分银行甚至可能出现零增长。

Query_Text_en: China 's economy , which in the third quarter hit its slowest growth rate since the global financial crisis , at 7.4 % , has started showing some promising signs .
Translation: 中国经济在第三季度创下自全球金融危机以来的最低增速，仅为7.4%，但目前已开始出现一些令人期待的积极迹象。

Query_Text_en: Indicators show property sales have been rising and manufacturing activity has slowed its decline .
Translation: 数据显示，房地产销售持续回升，制造业活动的下滑趋势有所放缓。

Query_Text_en: China 's major industrial companies saw their collective profits increase 7.8 % in September from a year earlier , after dropping 6.3 % in August , according to the National Bureau of Statistics .
Translation: 据国家统计局数据显示，9月份中国规模以上工业企业利润同比增长7.8%，而8月份则下降了6.3%。

Query_Text_en: So far Beijing has avoided launching another round of stimulus spending to pick up the economy , which could burden the banks with even more low-quality loans .
Translation: 到目前为止，北京一直避免启动新一轮刺激措施来提振经济，因为这可能会让银行背负更多低质量贷款。

Query_Text_en: Instead , the People 's Bank of China , China 's central bank , has injected huge amounts of funds into China 's banking system in recent months to bring down the interest rate at which banks lend to each other .
Translation: 相反，近几个月来，中国央行——中国人民银行向中国银行体系注入了大量资金，以降低银行间的拆借利率。

Query_Text_en: The central bank has injected almost 1.3 trillion yuan , or about $ 208 billion , into the banking system since late June .
Translation: 自6月下旬以来，央行已向银行体系注入近1.3万亿元人民币，约合2080亿美元。

Query_Text_en: On Tuesday , the central bank injected a record-high 290 billion yuan worth of cash into the system , after the benchmark gauge of short-term interbank lending rates jumped to 4.32 % late Monday , well above the 3 % the central bank is comfortable with , though analysts said the move was due to a regular end-of-month spike in banks ' funding needs .
Translation: 周二，央行向市场注入了创纪录的2900亿元资金，此前短期同业拆借利率基准指标在周一晚间飙升至4.32%，远高于央行所能接受的3%。不过，分析人士表示，此举主要是由于月底银行资金需求常规性上升所致。

Query_Text_en: While new loan growth this year has been healthy , lending has been heavily weighted toward short-term loans that companies borrow to meet their everyday needs , and not the long-term loans used for investment that might help buoy the economy .
Translation: 尽管今年新增贷款增长势头良好，但贷款主要集中在企业为日常需求而借的短期贷款，而非用于投资、可能有助于提振经济的长期贷款。

Query_Text_en: The central bank also faces a balancing act in trying to stimulate lending , and has so far avoided implementing more aggressive measures to relax monetary policy , such as reducing the volume of funds that banks are required to keep in reserve .
Translation: 央行在试图刺激信贷的同时，也面临着平衡的挑战，目前尚未采取更为激进的货币政策宽松措施，例如下调银行存款准备金率。

Query_Text_en: ` If there 's no demand for loans and you 're trying to push in liquidity ... it wo n't end up in the real economy , ' said Igor Arsenin , the Asian-Pacific head of rates strategy for Barclays . ` Then you get bubbles and you get inflation . '
Translation: “如果没有贷款需求，而你却试图向市场注入流动性……这些资金最终不会流向实体经济。”巴克莱银行亚太区利率策略主管伊戈尔·阿尔谢宁表示，“这样就会导致资产泡沫和通货膨胀。”

Query_Text_en: ICBC said its third-quarter net profit rose 15 % from a year earlier to 62.44 billion yuan , slower than the 27 % increase in profits it posted in the third quarter of 2011 .
Translation: 工商银行表示，第三季度净利润同比增长15%，达到624.4亿元，增速低于2011年第三季度27%的利润增长。

Query_Text_en: China Construction Bank , China second-biggest bank by assets , said Sunday that its third-quarter net profit rose 12 % to 51.91 billion yuan , down from the 16.2 % rise it posted last year .
Translation: 中国建设银行——中国资产规模第二大的银行——周日表示，第三季度净利润同比增长12%，达到519.1亿元，增速较去年同期的16.2%有所放缓。

Query_Text_en: AgBank said its third-quarter profit rose 16 % from a year earlier to 39.58 billion yuan , compared with the 27 % rise in the third quarter last year .
Translation: 农业银行表示，第三季度净利润同比增长16%，达到395.8亿元，而去年第三季度的增幅为27%。

Query_Text_en: With the slowdown in China 's economic growth claiming headline casualties from sellers of luxury goods to shipping companies , a new report says the debt problems of a less visible victim the Chinese steel trader could impact China 's banks .
Translation: 随着中国经济增速放缓，从奢侈品销售商到航运公司等行业纷纷成为头条受害者，一份最新报告指出，另一个不太引人注目的受害者——中国钢铁贸易商的债务问题，可能会影响中国的银行业。

Query_Text_en: According to the report , produced by Bernstein Research , the problem began as do so many financial bubbles with plentiful cash .
Translation: 据伯恩斯坦研究公司发布的报告，问题的起因与许多金融泡沫一样，都是由于资金充裕。

Query_Text_en: As in other corners of the commodity world , Chinese steel traders who can get bank loans pledged against their steel inventory availed themselves of the easy credit that came from the construction-led , stimulus-induced boom China enjoyed in the aftermath of the financial crisis .
Translation: 与其他大宗商品领域类似，能够以钢材库存作为抵押从银行获得贷款的中国钢贸商，也充分利用了金融危机后中国因建设驱动和刺激政策带来的经济繁荣所带来的宽松信贷环境。

Query_Text_en: But many were n't prudent in how they acquired or used the loans , according to Bernstein .
Translation: 但据伯恩斯坦表示，许多人在获取或使用贷款时并不谨慎。

Query_Text_en: The traders particularly those in the Shanghai and Yangtze River delta region began to secure credit by pledging nonexistent collateral , or by pledging the same steel inventory multiple times .
Translation: 商人们，尤其是上海及长三角地区的商人，开始通过抵押并不存在的担保品，或将同一批钢材库存多次抵押来获取信贷。

Query_Text_en: Bernstein did n't name any banks or traders involved in the fraud in its report .
Translation: 伯恩斯坦在其报告中并未提及涉及该欺诈行为的任何银行或交易员。

Query_Text_en: A news department official at the China Banking Regulatory Commission said the commission was monitoring the issue , but did n't immediately offer further comment .
Translation: 中国银行业监督管理委员会新闻部门的一位官员表示，银监会正在关注这一问题，但未立即作出进一步评论。

Query_Text_en: An official at the China Iron and Steel Association , which has jurisdiction over steel businesses , said the quasi-governmental body is aware of the allegations .
Translation: 中国钢铁协会的一位官员表示，该准政府机构已知悉相关指控。

Query_Text_en: Deputy secretary-general Chi Jingdong said he could n't ascertain if the abuses were widely prevalent but said the association believes there have been such occurrences of fraudulent loans .
Translation: 副秘书长迟京东表示，他无法确定此类违规行为是否普遍存在，但协会认为确实发生过骗贷现象。

Query_Text_en: Mr. Chi said he was n't aware if the association has conducted a detailed probe yet .
Translation: 迟先生表示，他不清楚该协会是否已经开展了详细调查。

Query_Text_en: In some cases , the report says , traders plowed the loans into gambles on equity markets , as steel sales alone were n't sufficient to cover interest payments .
Translation: 报告指出，在某些情况下，贸易商将贷款投入到股市投机中，因为仅靠钢铁销售不足以支付利息。

Query_Text_en: As the stock markets slowed and steel prices fell to record lows , the traders got caught in the receding tide .
Translation: 随着股市放缓，钢价跌至历史低点，交易商在退潮中被困。

Query_Text_en: Banks began to choke off credit , spurred by a directive in April from the China Banking Regulatory Commission to stamp out the steel fraud , Bernstein said .
Translation: 伯恩斯坦表示，受中国银监会四月份下发的打击钢铁欺诈指令的推动，银行开始收紧信贷。

Query_Text_en: The shakeout among steel traders is ongoing .
Translation: 钢铁贸易商之间的行业洗牌仍在持续。

Query_Text_en: Bernstein said its survey of steel traders along the Bohai Sea coast and Guangzhou indicated that only about half of contracted orders for steel products in September were fulfilled .
Translation: 伯恩斯坦表示，其对渤海沿岸和广州地区钢铁贸易商的调研显示，9月份钢材产品的合同订单仅有约一半得以履行。

Query_Text_en: The danger from loans made to steel traders is not spread evenly throughout China 's banking sector .
Translation: 钢贸贷款风险在中国银行业并未均匀分布。

Query_Text_en: For large banks , nonperforming loans made to steel traders on average amount to less than 0.5 % of total loans , the report said .
Translation: 报告称，对于大型银行，向钢铁贸易商发放的不良贷款平均占总贷款的比例不足0.5%。

Query_Text_en: For smaller banks , however , exposure is 2 % to 4 % .
Translation: 然而，对于规模较小的银行，风险敞口为2%至4%。

Query_Text_en: Smaller banks told Bernstein they find it difficult to call these steel manufacturers to make good on the traders ' fraud . As a bank , you always want to please a large steel customer .
Translation: 伯恩斯坦表示，小型银行认为很难要求这些钢铁制造商为交易员的欺诈行为买单。作为银行，总是希望能够讨好大型钢铁客户。

Query_Text_en: Larger banks tend to hog direct relationships with the more credit-worthy larger steel producers , leaving the higher risks steel traders to their smaller brethren .
Translation: 大型银行往往优先与信用较高的大型钢铁生产企业建立直接关系，而将风险较高的钢铁贸易商留给规模较小的银行。

Query_Text_en: The Bernstein report said smaller banks have especially been in a quandary .
Translation: 伯恩斯坦报告指出，中小银行尤其陷入了两难境地。

Query_Text_en: Faced with steel traders backed in their credit guarantees by large state-owned steel producers , these smaller banks often find themselves powerless to collect the debts , Bernstein said .
Translation: 伯恩斯坦表示，面对由大型国有钢铁企业提供信用担保的钢铁贸易商，这些规模较小的银行往往无力追讨债务。

Query_Text_en: China 's steel industry including its top five producers is dominated by state-owned enterprises .
Translation: 中国钢铁行业，包括前五大生产企业，主要由国有企业主导。

Query_Text_en: The problem is far from being resolved .
Translation: 问题远未得到解决。

Query_Text_en: Until the fraudulent debt shakes out , Bernstein says , the loan portfolios of small and medium-sized banks in China with exposure to troubled steel-trader lending will only keep deteriorating .
Translation: 伯恩斯坦表示，在虚假债务清除之前，中国中小银行的贷款组合，尤其是涉及钢贸商问题贷款的部分，只会持续恶化。

Query_Text_en: Natalie Keyssar for The Wall Street Journal Tuesday, a statue of the Virgin Mary stands in Breezy Point, Queens, New York.
Translation: 纳塔莉·凯萨尔为《华尔街日报》拍摄：周二，纽约皇后区布里齐角，一尊圣母玛利亚雕像矗立在那里。

Query_Text_en: Sandy is delivering a blow to the U.S. economy that will reverberate for weeks , disrupting commerce in the nation 's most-populous region , destroying billions of dollars ' worth of property and likely boosting gasoline prices .
Translation: 桑迪飓风正对美国经济造成冲击，这种影响将在数周内持续发酵，不仅扰乱了全国人口最稠密地区的商业活动，毁坏了数十亿美元的财产，还可能推高汽油价格。

Query_Text_en: Along the East Coast , some restaurants , car dealers and other retailers are likely to see sales slip .
Translation: 在东海岸，一些餐馆、汽车经销商及其他零售商的销售额可能会出现下滑。

Query_Text_en: Many workers are n't being paid for lost hours .
Translation: 许多工人因工时减少而未获得相应的补偿。

Query_Text_en: Shipments of goods through eastern seaports and airports are being delayed .
Translation: 货物通过东部海港和机场的运输正在延迟。

Query_Text_en: That would drain billions of dollars from the economy at a time when it already is growing sluggishly .
Translation: 这将在经济本已增长乏力之际，使数十亿美元从经济体系中流失。

Query_Text_en: Much of this economic activity will be delayed or shifted , such as when the money not spent in a coffee shop this week is spent on a movie next week .
Translation: 许多经济活动将会被推迟或转移，例如，本周未在咖啡店消费的钱，下周可能会用于看电影。

Query_Text_en: And other commerce will pick up as utility workers earn overtime pay , construction crews start rebuilding and homeowners buy materials to repair damage .
Translation: 随着公用事业工人获得加班工资、施工队伍开始重建，以及房主购买材料修复损坏，其他商业活动也将随之恢复。

Query_Text_en: Many grocers and home-improvement stores rang up higher sales as people prepared for the storm .
Translation: 许多杂货店和家居建材商店的销售额有所上升，因为人们在为风暴做准备。

Query_Text_en: Still , the short-term damage likely will cause the economy to grow more slowly in the final three months of the year than it did over the summer , when the economy grew at a tepid 2 % annual pace , forecasters said .
Translation: 不过，预测人士表示，短期损失可能会导致经济在今年最后三个月的增长速度低于夏季，彼时经济年增长率仅为温和的2%。

Query_Text_en: Consultancy IHS Global Insight estimated Tuesday that the storm could shave 0.6 percentage point off the annualized pace of growth in the nation 's gross domestic product in the fourth quarter .
Translation: 咨询公司IHS全球透视周二估算，这场风暴可能会使该国第四季度国内生产总值年化增速减少0.6个百分点。

Query_Text_en: This does n't capture the complete impact because GDP measures the value of the economy 's output of goods and services , but not the wealth destroyed .
Translation: 这并不能全面反映影响，因为国内生产总值只衡量经济产出的商品和服务的价值，而未计入被毁损的财富。

Query_Text_en: Analysts do n't expect the storm 's effects to show up immediately in the economic data .
Translation: 分析人士认为，风暴的影响不会立即反映在经济数据中。

Query_Text_en: The Labor Department said Tuesday it intends to release its October employment report Friday , as scheduled .
Translation: 美国劳工部周二表示，计划按原定时间于周五发布10月就业报告。

Query_Text_en: SThe U.S. Department of Labor said on Tuesday that it intends to release its October jobs report on Friday as originally planned.
Translation: 美国劳工部周二表示，将按原计划于周五发布10月就业报告。

Query_Text_en: Several hundred traders battled road closures and high waters to get to their posts on the floor of the New York Stock Exchange in time for the markets to open at 9:30 a.m.
Translation: 数百名交易员克服道路封闭和高水位的困难，及时赶到纽约证券交易所的交易大厅，确保市场能在上午9:30准时开盘。

Query_Text_en: Some arrived as early as 5:45 a.m.
Translation: 有些人早在凌晨5点45分就抵达了。

Query_Text_en: Some NYSE officials , including Chief Operating Officer Lawrence Leibowitz , spent the night at the office to ensure the exchange was ready .
Translation: 包括首席运营官劳伦斯·莱博维茨在内的一些纽约证券交易所官员，整夜留守办公室，以确保交易所做好准备。

Query_Text_en: ` Out of this postapocalyptic world that we 're all looking at , that 's a ray of good news , that they 're actually able to get the exchange open , ' said Keith Bliss , senior vice president at Cuttone & Co. , a brokerage with operations on the NYSE floor .
Translation: “在我们所目睹的这个后末日世界中，能够成功开放交易所，这无疑是一线好消息。”Cuttone & Co.高级副总裁、在纽约证券交易所运营的经纪公司Keith Bliss表示。

Query_Text_en: It was n't until Mayor Michael Bloomberg and NYSE Euronext Chief Executive Officer Duncan Niederauer rang the opening bell that traders knew for sure that the systems would work .
Translation: 直到市长迈克尔·布隆伯格和纽约泛欧交易所首席执行官邓肯·尼德劳尔敲响开市钟，交易员们才真正确信系统能够正常运行。

Query_Text_en: By day 's end , 3.5 million shares had changed hands in NYSE composite trading , near the 3.6 million daily average , though many traders had expected a busier day .
Translation: 截至当天收盘，纽约证券交易所综合交易中共有350万股易手，接近每日平均的360万股，尽管许多交易员原本预计当天会更加活跃。

Query_Text_en: The Dow Jones Industrial Average rose as many as 82 points shortly after the opening bell before closing down 10.75 points at 13096.46 .
Translation: 道琼斯工业平均指数在开盘后不久一度上涨82点，最终收盘下跌10.75点，报13096.46点。

Query_Text_en: The markets opening with relatively little fanfare was a welcome milestone for the NYSE .
Translation: 市场开盘时反响平淡，这对纽约证券交易所来说是一个值得欢迎的里程碑。

Query_Text_en: The Big Board had come under pressure over the past few days from critics who said the exchanges , as well as brokerages and banks , should have been better prepared to operate in an emergency such as the storm that hit Monday night .
Translation: 在过去几天里，纽约证券交易所受到了批评者的压力，他们认为包括交易所、券商和银行在内的相关机构，应该为应对类似于周一夜间袭来的风暴这样的紧急情况做好更充分的准备。

Query_Text_en: Trader participation is vital to operations on the exchange , which only handles about 11 % of U.S. stock trading but plays a key role in setting benchmark open and closing prices used by brokerage firms .
Translation: 交易员的参与对交易所的运作至关重要。尽管该交易所仅占美国股票交易量的约11%，但在确定由券商采用的基准开盘价和收盘价方面发挥着关键作用。

Query_Text_en: Though the exchange does n't lie within a zone for which New York City officials issued a mandatory evacuation , power is out at the NYSE and much of the surrounding area .
Translation: 尽管纽约证券交易所所在区域并未被纽约市政府列为强制疏散区，但纽约证券交易所及其周边大部分地区已断电。

Query_Text_en: ` Things went very , very smoothly ' as stock trading resumed Wednesday morning , said Henry Mulholland , head of Americas equity trading at Bank of America Merrill Lynch . ` There were some minor issues ... but nothing that moved the needle . '
Translation: 美国银行美林证券美洲股票交易主管亨利·穆赫兰表示：“周三上午股票交易恢复时，一切进展非常非常顺利。虽然出现了一些小问题……但都无关紧要，没有产生实质性影响。”

Query_Text_en: Exchange officials said Tuesday they needed at least 100 traders and support staff to function .
Translation: 交易所官员周二表示，正常运作至少需要100名交易员和支持人员。

Query_Text_en: On Wednesday , spokesman Richard Adamonis said there were ` probably several hundred ' traders , market makers , floor brokers and operations staff at the Big Board .
Translation: 周三，发言人理查德·亚当尼斯表示，纽约证券交易所现场大约有“几百名”交易员、做市商、场内经纪人以及运营人员。

Query_Text_en: ' I think no matter what day it is , a trader on the New York Stock Exchange wants to go to work , ' said Ben Willis , managing director at Albert Fried & Co. , a broker on the NYSE floor who says he drove in from New Jersey through the Lincoln Tunnel .
Translation: “我认为，无论是哪一天，纽约证券交易所的交易员都希望去上班。”阿尔伯特·弗里德公司（Albert Fried & Co.）的董事总经理、本身也是纽交所场内经纪人的本·威利斯（Ben Willis）表示，他当天是从新泽西州经林肯隧道驱车前来的。

Query_Text_en: While the lights were on , communication was largely out .
Translation: 灯火通明之时，通讯却基本中断。

Query_Text_en: Since the employees of many companies' trading rooms have not come, and some major news will be announced, the trading in various markets is relatively light. According to fund tracker Morningstar, October 31 is the end of the fiscal year for 22% of mutual funds in the United States, but the stock market has only reached the average trading volume.
Translation: 由于许多公司交易室的员工尚未到岗，加之一些重大消息即将公布，各市场的交易相对清淡。根据基金追踪机构晨星的数据，10月31日是美国22%共同基金的财政年度结束日，但股市的交易量仅达到平均水平。

Query_Text_en: Many investors appeared content to do only what was absolutely necessary Wednesday ahead of Friday 's October employment report and next Tuesday 's presidential election .
Translation: 许多投资者似乎只愿在周三做最必要的操作，以等待周五的十月就业报告和下周二的总统选举。

Query_Text_en: Across the markets , banks and fund companies reported varying levels of staffing in their trading and investment groups , but most said there more empty desks than usual .
Translation: 在各个市场，银行和基金公司报告称其交易和投资团队的人员配备情况不一，但大多数表示，空置工位比往常更多。

Query_Text_en: Many companies say that given the difficulty of getting around in the New York area, employees are working remotely if they have electricity at home.
Translation: 许多公司表示，鉴于纽约地区出行困难，如果员工家中有电，他们就可以远程办公。

Query_Text_en: For some stock traders , however , there was frustration .
Translation: 然而，对一些股票交易者来说，情况却令人感到沮丧。

Query_Text_en: The two-day shutdown in trading came in the middle of earnings season .
Translation: 这次为期两天的交易中断正值财报季中期。

Query_Text_en: While many companies postponed earnings releases , some still went ahead and released their results while the markets were closed .
Translation: 尽管许多公司推迟了财报发布，但仍有一些公司选择在市场休市期间公布业绩。

Query_Text_en: That left some traders in positions they did n't necessarily want to have , they said .
Translation: 他们表示，这导致一些交易员持有了他们并不一定想要的头寸。

Query_Text_en: Many traders were stranded throughout the tri-state area , unable to get into the office .
Translation: 许多交易员滞留在三州地区各地，无法前往办公室。

Query_Text_en: Scott Redler , chief strategic officer at T3 Trading Group , spent the day trading shares of Apple at an Equinox fitness center in Summit , N.J. , one of the few buildings near his home with a reliable power source .
Translation: T3交易集团首席战略官斯科特·雷德勒在新泽西州萨米特的一家Equinox健身中心度过了一天，交易苹果公司的股票。这是他家附近少数几个拥有可靠电源的建筑之一。

Query_Text_en: By the time the market opened, Deloitte was already snapping up Apple shares. He bought and sold Apple shares electronically, quickly taking profits when the stock price recovered from intraday lows. His orders were placed through the company's backup office in Rye, New York.
Translation: 在市场开盘时，德勤已经开始大量买入苹果股票。他通过电子方式买卖苹果股票，在股价从盘中低点回升时迅速获利。他的交易指令是通过公司位于纽约赖伊的后备办公室下达的。

Query_Text_en: Home Depot posted the biggest advance among the blue chips , rising $ 1.34 , or 2.2 % , to $ 61.38 amid expectations of a sales jump following the destruction wreaked by the superstorm Sandy .
Translation: 受超级风暴“桑迪”带来的破坏影响，市场预期销售将大幅增长，家得宝股价在蓝筹股中涨幅最大，上涨1.34美元，或2.2%，收于61.38美元。

Query_Text_en: Chinese listed companies reported a surge in unpaid bills in the third quarter, one of the clearest signs to date, indicating that China's economic slowdown has hit companies' balance sheets hard.
Translation: 中国上市公司在第三季度报告显示，未偿付账款激增，这是迄今为止最明显的迹象之一，表明中国经济放缓已对企业资产负债表造成严重冲击。

Query_Text_en: While that is still very fast by international standards , many companies have invested on the expectation of sustained double-digit growth and the sharp rise in accounts receivable is an indication of how a mild slowdown?has?caught?them off guard .
Translation: 虽然按照国际标准来看，这仍然非常快，但许多公司是在预期持续的两位数增长的基础上进行投资的，而应收账款的急剧上升则表明，哪怕是温和的放缓也让他们措手不及。

Query_Text_en: Although this growth rate is still fast by international standards, many companies are investing in the expectation that China's economy will maintain double-digit growth. The surge in accounts receivable shows that although the economic slowdown is mild, it has caught these companies off guard.
Translation: 尽管这一增长速度在国际标准下仍属较快，但许多企业的投资预期是中国经济能够保持两位数增长。应收账款的大幅增加表明，尽管经济放缓幅度有限，却让这些企业措手不及。

Query_Text_en: 'Due to the impact of the macroeconomic environment, there was a partial delay in sales repayment,' the company said.
Translation: 公司表示：“受宏观经济环境影响，部分销售回款出现延迟。”

Query_Text_en: Other machinery companies reported similar problems : at Shanghai-listed First Tractor , accounts receivable rose 169 per cent from the beginning of the year .
Translation: 其他机械公司也报告了类似问题：在上海上市的第一拖拉机，年初以来应收账款增长了169%。

Query_Text_en: At present, there are few external signs that Chinese banks are facing a credit crisis.
Translation: 目前，外界几乎没有迹象表明中国银行业正面临信用危机。

Query_Text_en: At the end of the first half , the overall bad debt ratio for the banking sector was just 0.9 per cent .
Translation: 截至上半年末，银行业整体不良贷款率仅为0.9%。

Query_Text_en: There has been a slight increase in overdue loans , however , and many analysts believe banks might be disguising a more serious deterioration in asset quality by moving bad loans off their balance sheets .
Translation: 不过，逾期贷款有所上升，许多分析人士认为，银行可能通过将不良贷款转移出资产负债表，掩盖了资产质量更为严重的恶化。

Query_Text_en: Investors eagerly awaiting the Canadian government's ruling on Cnooc Ltd.'s $15.1 billion acquisition of Nexen Inc. will know the outcome by the end of next week .
Translation: 投资者们热切关注的中国海洋石油有限公司以151亿美元收购尼克森公司一案，加拿大政府将于下周末前公布裁决结果。

Query_Text_en: However, it may not be possible to get results by then.
Translation: 然而，届时可能无法取得结果。

Query_Text_en: The initial 75-day government review of the takeover , announced back in July , is set to end late next week .
Translation: 政府于七月宣布的对该收购案的初步75天审查预计将于下周末结束。

Query_Text_en: Ottawa must sign off on all big foreign deals to ensure they are of net benefit to the economy .
Translation: 渥太华必须批准所有重大外资交易，以确保其对经济具有净收益。

Query_Text_en: But that deadline -- Nov. 9 or Nov. 10 , depending on how you 're counting -- falls when Prime Minister Stephen Harper is traveling to Asia .
Translation: 但这一截止日期——11月9日或11月10日，具体取决于计算方式——恰逢总理斯蒂芬·哈珀前往亚洲访问期间。

Query_Text_en: While that might seem a good time to announce that Canada is green-lighting the deal , Mr. Harper is n't likely to make much noise on the issue of foreign investment , according to a briefing Thursday by his spokesman  .
Translation: 尽管现在似乎是宣布加拿大批准该交易的好时机，但据哈珀的发言人周四的简报，哈珀本人不太可能在外国投资问题上大张旗鼓。

Query_Text_en: A spokeswoman for Mr. Paradis declined to comment .
Translation: 帕拉迪斯先生的女发言人拒绝置评。

Query_Text_en: When the iPad Mini was launched last Friday, Apple Inc. Fans lined up in long lines.
Translation: 上周五，iPad Mini发布时，苹果公司的粉丝们排起了长队。

Query_Text_en: EuropeanPressphotoAgency iPad Mini advertisement in the window of a Berlin shop .
Translation: 柏林一家商店橱窗内张贴的欧洲新闻图片社iPad Mini广告。

Query_Text_en: Demand was strong in storm-ravaged New York , where hundreds still gathered outside Apple 's flagship Fifth Avenue store .
Translation: 在遭受风暴袭击的纽约，需求依然强劲，数百人仍聚集在苹果公司第五大道旗舰店外。

Query_Text_en: But the initial crowd of 580 fell below the 750 that greeted the launch of the last version of the iPad this March , according to counts from Piper Jaffray .
Translation: 据Piper Jaffray统计，最初到场的580人低于今年3月上一代iPad发布时迎接新品的750人。

Query_Text_en: Elsewhere in the U.S. , lines were also shorter than recent launches .
Translation: 在美国其他地区，排队人数也比近期的新品发布时要少。

Query_Text_en: In Apple 's backyard of San Francisco , lines at a downtown store were half to less than a third of the size they have been for other Apple gadgets .
Translation: 在苹果公司所在地旧金山市中心的一家门店，排队人数仅为以往其他苹果产品的一半甚至不到三分之一。

Query_Text_en: ' I was planning to stop by during lunch , ' he said .
Translation: “我本来打算午饭时间过来的，”他说。

Query_Text_en: He said: I originally planned to come over during my lunch break.
Translation: 他说：我本来打算午休时间过来的。

Query_Text_en: The iPad Mini , which measures 7.9 inches diagonally , is a test of whether Apple can shore up the lower end of the tablet market with a pricier product than rivals .
Translation: iPad Mini 的屏幕对角线尺寸为7.9英寸，这款产品是对苹果能否凭借比竞争对手价格更高的产品巩固平板电脑市场中低端份额的一次考验。

Query_Text_en: The iPad Mini starts at $ 329 , while rival products such as Google Inc. 's Nexus 7 and Amazon.com Inc. 's Kindle Fire start at $ 199 respectively .
Translation: iPad Mini的起售价为329美元，而谷歌公司的Nexus 7和平板电脑以及亚马逊公司的Kindle Fire的起售价则分别为199美元。

Query_Text_en: Those devices have a slightly smaller 7-inch screen .
Translation: 这些设备配备了略小的7英寸屏幕。

Query_Text_en: Analysts have predicted Apple could sell more than a million iPad Minis this first weekend and several million for the quarter .
Translation: 分析人士预测，苹果公司在首个周末的iPad Mini销量可能超过一百万台，季度销量则有望达到数百万台。

Query_Text_en: The smaller iPad is part of the largest product push Apple has made ahead of a holiday season in recent history .
Translation: 这款较小的iPad是苹果近年来在假日季前推出的最大规模产品推广的一部分。

Query_Text_en: On Friday , the Cupertino , Calif. , company also started selling a slightly updated version of its full-sized iPad , which has a screen that measures 9.7 inches diagonally .
Translation: 周五，这家位于加利福尼亚州库比蒂诺的公司还开始销售其全尺寸iPad的略微升级版，该产品配备9.7英寸对角线屏幕。

Query_Text_en: The launches come as investors are newly cautious about Apple after driving up its stock to record highs in September .
Translation: 在投资者于去年九月将苹果股价推至历史新高后，如今对苹果持更加谨慎态度之际，这些新品发布正值此时。

Query_Text_en: Apple shares fell 3.3 % on Friday to $ 576.80 .
Translation: 苹果公司股价周五下跌3.3%，至576.80美元。

Query_Text_en: The calmer scenes over the iPad Mini were expected because the device is only part of Apple 's overall iPad line-up and versions with cellular access do n't go on sale until mid-November .
Translation: iPad Mini发布现场的平静氛围在预料之中，因为该设备只是苹果整体iPad产品线的一部分，并且支持蜂窝网络的版本要到11月中旬才会上市。

Query_Text_en: For investors who want some clarity on important U.S. fiscal policy issues, the sooner Tuesday's presidential and congressional elections end, the better.
Translation: 对于希望美国重要财政政策问题更加明朗的投资者来说，周二的总统和国会选举越早结束越好。

Query_Text_en: For investors who want some clarity on important U.S. fiscal policy issues, the sooner Tuesday's presidential and congressional elections end, the better.
Translation: 对于希望在美国重要财政政策问题上获得更多明确信息的投资者来说，周二的总统和国会选举越早结束，越好。

Query_Text_en: ` The fiscal cliff becomes front and center , ' says Michael Jones , chief investment officer at RiverFront Investment Group in Richmond , Va. , which manages $ 3.3 billion .
Translation: “财政悬崖成为焦点，”位于弗吉尼亚州里士满、管理着33亿美元资产的RiverFront投资集团首席投资官迈克尔·琼斯表示。

Query_Text_en: Many investors expect a close contest , but for President Barack Obama to win .
Translation: 许多投资者预计选举将十分激烈，但认为奥巴马总统会获胜。

Query_Text_en: They also anticipate that Republicans will keep a majority in the House of Representatives and that Democrats will retain slim control of the Senate , which would set up an instant battle over whether to keep or kill the tax cuts and spending .
Translation: 他们还预计，共和党将继续保持众议院多数席位，而民主党则将以微弱优势控制参议院，这将立即引发一场关于是否保留或取消减税和支出政策的激烈争论。

Query_Text_en: A win by Mitt Romney is seen as taking fiscal-cliff concerns off the table , as both sides of the aisle are expected to agree to an extension that would defer the need for immediate fixes .
Translation: 如果米特·罗姆尼获胜，财政悬崖问题预计将不再成为焦点，因为两党都可能同意延期，从而推迟对紧急措施的需求。

Query_Text_en: But a Romney victory also could introduce fresh unknowns , particularly when it comes to the end of Federal Reserve Chairman Ben Bernanke 's term in 2014 .
Translation: 但如果罗姆尼获胜，也可能带来新的不确定性，尤其是在美联储主席伯南克于2014年任期结束的问题上。

Query_Text_en: ` Knowing who the president is will allow investors to again focus on the fundamentals and put this uncertainty behind them , ' says Matthew Rubin , head of the investment-strategy group at Neuberger Berman , which manages $ 203 billion .
Translation: “知道总统是谁，将使投资者能够重新关注基本面，把这份不确定性抛诸脑后。”管理着2030亿美元资产的Neuberger Berman投资策略团队负责人Matthew Rubin表示。

Query_Text_en: Stocks have posted healthy gains for the year .
Translation: 今年以来，股市表现强劲，取得了可观的涨幅。

Query_Text_en: The Dow Jones Industrial Average finished Friday 's session up 7.2 % so far in 2012 while the Standard & Poor 's 500-stock index is up 12.5 % .
Translation: 截至2012年，周五道琼斯工业平均指数累计上涨7.2%，标准普尔500指数则上涨12.5%。

Query_Text_en: Some say a win for the president could spark safe-haven buying of U.S. Treasurys and the U.S. dollar and a selloff in riskier investments such as stocks .
Translation: 有人认为，如果总统获胜，可能会引发对美国国债和美元的避险买盘，同时导致股票等风险资产的抛售。

Query_Text_en: That is because House Republicans have refused to back any revenue increases and President Obama has said he would veto any extension of upper-income tax cuts , notes John Bellows , investment management strategy analyst at Western Asset Management , which manages $ 459 billion .
Translation: 这是因为众议院的共和党人拒绝支持任何增加财政收入的措施，而奥巴马总统则表示，他将否决任何延长高收入者减税政策的提案，西方资产管理公司（管理资产达4590亿美元）的投资管理策略分析师约翰·贝洛斯指出。

Query_Text_en: A prolonged fight , while potentially damaging , may not be as significant to the markets as last summer 's debt-ceiling debacle , even if it is accompanied by another downgrade to the government 's credit rating , says Benjamin Pace , chief investment officer at Deutsche Bank 's DBK.XE -1.03 % private wealth management group . ` It 's not like the shock of last summer when we woke up ... and realized we were no longer triple-A rated , ' he said .
Translation: 德意志银行私人财富管理集团首席投资官本杰明·佩斯表示，虽然旷日持久的争斗可能带来负面影响，但其对市场的影响或许不及去年夏天债务上限危机，即便政府信用评级再次被下调。“这不像去年夏天那样令人震惊，当时我们醒来后才意识到，我们已经不再是三A级别了，”他说。

Query_Text_en: A Romney win , by contrast ` would lead to a pretty-good sized relief rally ' for stocks and other risky investments , predicts RiverFront 's Mr. Jones .
Translation: RiverFront公司的琼斯先生预测，相比之下，如果罗姆尼获胜，股票及其他高风险投资将迎来一次规模相当可观的反弹行情。

Query_Text_en: This is largely because the sector may not be affected by automatic cost cuts. If no agreement can be reached on the fiscal cliff, the cost reduction measures will be automatically triggered.
Translation: 这主要是因为该行业可能不会受到自动削减开支措施的影响。如果无法就“财政悬崖”达成协议，削减开支的措施将会被自动启动。

Query_Text_en: In addition , Mr. Jones believes a win by Mr. Romney would be a boost for banks because it would raise expectations of a repeal of the Dodd Frank financial-oversight law .
Translation: 此外，琼斯先生认为，罗姆尼先生的胜选将提振银行业，因为这将提升市场对废除《多德-弗兰克金融监管法案》的预期。

Query_Text_en: The re-election of President Obama likely would hurt stocks of high-end retailers because of expectations of higher taxes on the wealthy , he adds .
Translation: 他补充道，奥巴马总统的再次当选可能会对高端零售商的股票造成不利影响，因为人们预期对富人征收更高的税收。

Query_Text_en: J.P. Morgan JPM -0.98 % stock-market strategist Thomas Lee also expects a victory by Mr. Romney to benefit energy and health-care stocks because he would be expected to loosen rules on energy exploration and push to repeal health-care reform .
Translation: 摩根大通股票市场策略师托马斯·李也认为，罗姆尼的胜利将利好能源和医疗保健板块，因为他预计将放宽能源勘探的相关规定，并推动废除医疗改革。

Query_Text_en: Small-company stocks also could get a boost on an expected pickup in mergers-and-acquisition activity .
Translation: 预计并购活动的增加也可能推动小型公司股票上涨。

Query_Text_en: Meanwhile , a re-election of President Obama would be a positive for hospital stocks as health care reforms are preserved , Mr. Lee says .
Translation: 与此同时，李先生表示，奥巴马总统若能连任，将对医院类股票构成利好，因为医疗改革措施将得以保留。

Query_Text_en: Some investors see a win by Mr. Romney as introducing new uncertainties , particularly as it relates to the course of monetary policy , says Carlos Asilis , chief investment officer at Glovista Investments , which manages $ 500 million .
Translation: Glovista Investments首席投资官卡洛斯·阿西利斯表示，一些投资者认为，如果罗姆尼获胜，尤其是在货币政策走向方面，将带来新的不确定性。该公司管理着5亿美元资产。

Query_Text_en: Mr. Romney has criticized the Fed 's Mr. Bernanke and any successor could enact more restrictive policy , he says .
Translation: 罗姆尼先生批评了美联储的伯南克，并表示任何继任者都可能采取更为紧缩的政策。

Query_Text_en: Mr. Asilis says he would play a win by Mr. Romney by betting on a decline in gold prices and a rise in the dollar . He would play a win by Mr. Obama by emphasizing ` reflation trades ' such as bullish bets on housing and commodities and bets against the U.S. dollar .
Translation: 阿西利斯先生表示，如果罗姆尼获胜，他将通过押注金价下跌和美元升值来应对。如果奥巴马获胜，他则会侧重于“再通胀交易”，例如看涨房地产和大宗商品，以及做空美元。

Query_Text_en: A forecast from consulting firm Johnson Associates scheduled to be released on Monday shows that so-called 'incentive compensation,' which includes cash and stock awards, will remain flat or increase by 5% to 10% year-on-year.
Translation: 咨询公司约翰逊联合（Johnson Associates）预计于周一发布的预测显示，包括现金和股票奖励在内的所谓“激励性薪酬”将在同比持平或增长5%至10%之间。

Query_Text_en: At the same time , financial firms are keeping a lid on cash outlays by deferring more pay and trimming their workforces .
Translation: 与此同时，金融机构通过推迟薪酬发放和裁减员工来控制现金支出。

Query_Text_en: ` We are as low as we have been in 10 or 15 years , ' said Alan Johnson , managing director of Johnson Associates , referring to Wall Street 's bonus pool . ` It 's the new normal . '
Translation: “我们现在的水平已经是过去十年或十五年来的最低点了，”约翰逊联合公司董事总经理艾伦·约翰逊在谈到华尔街的奖金池时表示，“这已经成为新的常态。”

Query_Text_en: The forecast is the latest sign that the weak economy , tougher regulations and uneasy markets that are hampering banks ' financial performance are pinching their workers ' wallets .
Translation: 这一预测再次表明，疲弱的经济、更为严格的监管以及动荡的市场环境正在影响银行的财务表现，并进一步压缩了员工的收入。

Query_Text_en: Job cuts have slowed from their frenetic pace in the second half of 2011 , when two dozen global financial firms announced plans to cut more than 100,000 positions , but rethinking cutbacks and compensation is now the norm
Translation: 裁员速度已较2011年下半年大幅放缓。当时有二十多家全球金融机构宣布计划裁减逾十万个岗位，但如今，重新审视裁员和薪酬调整已成为常态。

Query_Text_en: Many securities-industry employees still rake in far more in pay than most other professions . But gone are the days when scores of star traders would get million-dollar , year-end windfalls .
Translation: 许多证券行业员工的薪酬仍远高于大多数其他职业，但昔日众多明星交易员年终获得百万美元奖金的时代已经一去不复返了。

Query_Text_en: The average managing director is set to take home about $ 930,000 in total pay for 2012 , up 3.3 % from $ 900,000 a year ago but down about 23 % from $ 1.2 million in 2010 .
Translation: 2012年，普通董事总经理的平均薪酬预计约为93万美元，比去年增长3.3%，从90万美元上升，但较2010年的120万美元下降约23%。

Query_Text_en: Mr. Johnson said an equity trader who is managing director at a major firm could receive as much as 70 % of his pay at a later date , an arrangement that ties more compensation to long-term performance .
Translation: 约翰逊先生表示，一家大型公司的股票交易员兼董事总经理，可能有多达70%的薪酬会延后发放，这种安排将更多薪酬与长期业绩挂钩。

Query_Text_en: Equity volumes remain weak , while global merger and acquisition volume is down 16 % to $ 1.7 trillion through the first nine months of the year , according to Thomson Reuters .
Translation: 据汤森路透数据显示，股票交易量依然疲弱，全球并购总量在今年前九个月下降了16%，至1.7万亿美元。

Query_Text_en: Investment bankers and equity traders may receive as much as 10 % less in bonuses than last year .
Translation: 投资银行家和股票交易员的奖金可能比去年减少多达10%。

Query_Text_en: Equity volumes remain weak , while global merger and acquisition volume is down 16 % to $ 1.7 trillion through the first nine months of the year , according to Thomson Reuters .
Translation: 据汤森路透数据显示，股票交易量依然低迷，全球并购交易量今年前九个月同比下降16%，至1.7万亿美元。

Query_Text_en: The quarterly survey is based on public financial data from eight of the largest investment and commercial banks and 10 of the largest asset-management firms as well as conversations with employees at those firms .
Translation: 该季度调查基于八家最大的投资和商业银行以及十家最大的资产管理公司公开的财务数据，并结合对这些公司员工的访谈。

Query_Text_en: The latest numbers shows growth in the third quarter at just 7.4 % . Is 7 % 8 % growth the new normal ?
Translation: 最新数据显示，第三季度的增长仅为7.4%。7%到8%的增长是否成为了新常态？

Query_Text_en: Or is a further sharp slowdown in China 's economy inevitable ? China Real Time has asked two of the leading experts on the world 's second-largest economy to debate that question :
Translation: 或者，中国经济进一步大幅放缓是否不可避免？中国实时报已经邀请了两位全球第二大经济体领域的顶尖专家，就这个问题展开辩论：

Query_Text_en: The latest data shows that China's economy grew by only 7.4% in the third quarter.
Translation: 最新数据显示，中国经济在第三季度仅增长了7.4%。

Query_Text_en: The opening exchange of views is posted below , with more to be posted next week .
Translation: 开场的观点交流已发布，更多内容将于下周发布。

Query_Text_en: Dear Michael ,
Translation: 亲爱的迈克尔，

Query_Text_en: The following is the first part of the debate between the two, with more to be published next week.
Translation: 以下是两人辩论的第一部分，更多内容将于下周发布。

Query_Text_en: China 's economic growth has now slowed for seven consecutive quarters and the bears are arguing not only is real growth lower than the headline number but that a further sharp slowdown in China 's economy is inevitable .
Translation: 中国经济增长已连续七个季度放缓，悲观者认为，实际增长率不仅低于官方公布的数据，而且中国经济不可避免地将出现进一步大幅放缓。

Query_Text_en: Of course, it is obviously impossible to quickly recover from a growth rate of 7.7% in the first three quarters of this year to double-digit growth in recent years.
Translation: 当然，显然不可能在今年前三季度实现7.7%的增长率后，迅速恢复到近年来的两位数增长。

Query_Text_en: Indeed it is more likely that we will see growth over the next two to three years in the 6.5 % 8 % range , with some possibility for slightly higher growth beyond that time horizon , if the new leaders can introduce the right reforms .
Translation: 实际上，在未来两到三年内，我们更有可能看到经济增长保持在6.5%至8%的区间。如果新一届领导人能够推出合适的改革措施，未来增长率还有可能略高于这一水平。

Query_Text_en: The slowdown in economic growth is mainly due to weak exports and weakening investment, especially real estate investment. In the first three quarters of this year, the contraction in net exports caused economic growth to lose nearly 0.5 percentage points.
Translation: 经济增速放缓主要归因于出口疲软和投资减弱，尤其是房地产投资。今年前三季度，净出口的收缩使经济增长损失了近0.5个百分点。

Query_Text_en: But with China 's broad external surplus at a 10-year low in the first half of this year , absent a complete European melt down (in which case all bets are off), the drag on growth from the external sector is not likely to worsen significantly from here .
Translation: 但今年上半年中国的广义外部盈余已降至十年来的最低水平，除非欧洲出现全面崩溃（那样一切都难以预料），否则外部因素对经济增长的拖累不太可能进一步显著加剧。

Query_Text_en: The bigger worry is property investment , which is growing at barely half the pace of 2011 but still twice as fast as the underlying economy .
Translation: 更令人担忧的是房地产投资，其增长速度仅为2011年的一半，但仍然是整体经济增速的两倍。

Query_Text_en: If property investment moderates further for several additional quarters , GDP growth could slide to under 7 % .
Translation: 如果房地产投资在接下来的几个季度进一步放缓，GDP增速可能会降至7%以下。

Query_Text_en: On a more bullish note , consumption demand played a more positive role in generating economic growth last year as both private and government consumption as a share of GDP notched up their biggest increases in more than a decade .
Translation: 从更为乐观的角度来看，去年消费需求在推动经济增长方面发挥了更加积极的作用，私人消费和政府消费占GDP的比重均创下十多年来的最大增幅。

Query_Text_en: The growth of average disposable income of urban residents relative to GDP growth in the first three quarters is even more favorable this year than last , providing the foundation for relatively strong private consumption growth again this year , helping to cushion any further slowdown in property investment .
Translation: 今年前三季度，城镇居民人均可支配收入增速相较于GDP增速的表现较去年更加优异，为今年私人消费的持续较强增长提供了基础，有助于缓冲房地产投资进一步放缓带来的影响。

Query_Text_en: If the government strengthens its policies to rebalance the sources of economic growth by continuing to allow the value of the renminbi to be mostly market determined , further liberalizing deposit interest rates , and eliminating unwarranted subsidies for industrial energy consumption , the sources of China 's economic growth could be gradually rebalanced away from investment in favor of private consumption expenditure , thus putting China 's growth on a more sustainable path .
Translation: 如果政府通过继续允许人民币汇率主要由市场决定、进一步放开存款利率、取消对工业能源消费的不合理补贴等措施，加强经济增长动力再平衡的政策，那么中国经济增长的动力有望逐步从投资转向私人消费支出，从而使中国的经济增长走上更加可持续的道路。

Query_Text_en: Adopting this policy package is a not an unlikely outcome of the upcoming leadership transition .
Translation: 在即将到来的领导层更迭中，采纳这一政策组合并非不可能的结果。

Query_Text_en: It is one thing for the Hu Jintao Wen Jiabao leadership to go out of office on a weak economic note - after all they achieved the highest average 10 year economic growth in recorded Chinese history .
Translation: 胡锦涛、温家宝领导班子在经济低迷时期卸任是一回事——毕竟，他们创造了中国历史上最高的十年平均经济增长率。

Query_Text_en: It is quite another for the Xi Jinping-Li Keqiang leadership coming into office to contemplate a further deterioration of China 's economic performance in their first years .
Translation: 对于刚刚上任的习近平-李克强领导层来说，在执政初期就要面对中国经济表现进一步恶化的局面，则是完全不同的情形。

Query_Text_en: The intellectual case for an accelerated pace of economic reform has been well established in China .
Translation: 中国加快经济改革步伐的理论依据已经充分确立。

Query_Text_en: If Xi and Li can overcome the entrenched vested interests that have slowed reform to a crawl in recent years they will be laying the foundation for stronger economic growth over the medium term , say something in the 7.5 % 8.5 % range beginning in about three years .
Translation: 如果习近平和李克强能够克服近年来导致改革步履维艰的既得利益阻碍，他们将在未来几年为经济中期更强劲增长奠定基础，预计三年后经济增速将达到7.5%至8.5%的区间。

Query_Text_en: China's economic growth will slow sharply in the next few years for at least two reasons .
Translation: 未来几年，中国经济增速将显著放缓，至少有两个原因。

Query_Text_en: The first is related to historical precedents, and the second is related to China's way of thinking about restoring economic balance.
Translation: 第一点涉及历史先例，第二点则关乎中国恢复经济平衡的思维方式。

Query_Text_en: The historical precedents are clear .
Translation: 历史先例十分明确。

Query_Text_en: Many countries in the past one hundred years have gone through periods of extraordinary growth , powered by very high and rising levels of investment .
Translation: 在过去一百年中，许多国家经历了由极高且不断上升的投资水平推动的非凡增长时期。

Query_Text_en: In every case these countries developed serious imbalances , either internally , if the investment was financed by consumption-constraining policies , or externally , if they were not .
Translation: 在所有情况下，这些国家都出现了严重的失衡：如果投资通过抑制消费的政策来融资，就会导致内部失衡；如果没有采取这样的政策，则会出现外部失衡。

Query_Text_en: In the early stages , it was always relatively easy to find economically viable investments , but as institutional constraints required the persistence of high levels of investment , and as it became increasingly difficult to ensure that investment was economically viable , in later stages investment was always misallocated and debt grew faster than debt servicing capacity .
Translation: 在早期阶段，寻找经济上可行的投资总是相对容易，但随着制度性约束要求持续保持高水平的投资，并且确保投资经济可行性变得越来越困难，到了后期阶段，投资总是出现错配，债务增长速度也超过了偿债能力的提升。

Query_Text_en: This combination of extreme imbalances and high levels of debt , driven by misallocated investment , resulted in a subsequent period of rebalancing that turned out to be far more difficult than even the skeptics had predicted .
Translation: 这种由投资错配导致的极端失衡和高债务水平的组合，最终引发了一段远比怀疑者预期更加艰难的再平衡时期。

Query_Text_en: China 's development model has differed from its predecessors only in that the imbalances have exceeded any that we have seen in prior history , and the amount of misallocated investment may have also exceeded all precedents .
Translation: 中国的发展模式与以往相比，唯一的不同在于其不平衡程度超过了历史上任何先例，且投资错配的规模也可能创下了历史新高。

Query_Text_en: For this reason it would be surprising , and an historical anomaly , if China 's rebalancing were not a very difficult one .
Translation: 因此，如果中国的再平衡过程并非异常艰难，那将令人惊讶，也将成为历史上的一个例外。

Query_Text_en: Not only has China pushed the imbalances associated with the investment growth model to extremes that exceed any seen before , but it is becoming increasingly clear that the obstruction to any meaningful adjustment by sectors that have benefitted most from domestic economic distortions will make the adjustment politically very difficult .
Translation: 中国不仅将与投资驱动增长模式相关的失衡推向了前所未有的极端，而且越来越明显的是，那些最受国内经济扭曲红利的部门对任何实质性调整的阻碍，将使调整在政治上变得极为困难。

Query_Text_en: In addition to historical reasons, the lack of necessary means has also made it more difficult to rebalance China's economy.
Translation: 除了历史原因之外，缺乏必要的手段也使中国经济再平衡变得更加困难。

Query_Text_en: It is widely recognized that investment growth must be curtailed sharply , but it is n't at all clear what will replace it as China 's growth engine .
Translation: 众所周知，必须大幅削减投资增长，但目前尚不清楚什么将成为中国新的经济增长引擎。

Query_Text_en: THIRTY YEARS AGO marked the publication of what has come to be known as the Fundamental Theorem of Finance and the discovery of risk-neutral pricing . The earlier option pricing results of Black and Scholes [ 1973 ] and Merton [ 1973 ] were the catalyst for much of this work , and certainly one of the central themes of this research has been an effort to understand option pricing . History alone , then , makes the topic of these monographs the neoclassical theory of finance-particularly appropriate . But , history aside , the basic theorem and its attendant results have unified our understanding of asset pricing and the theory of derivatives , and have gener ? ated an enormous literature that has had a significant impact on the world of financial practice .
Translation: 三十年前，被称为金融基本定理的理论发表，以及风险中性定价的发现。Black和Scholes [1973] 以及Merton [1973] 早期的期权定价成果成为了这一研究的催化剂，而理解期权定价无疑也是该领域研究的核心主题之一。因此，仅从历史角度来看，这些专著所探讨的新古典金融理论就是一个极为恰当的话题。但抛开历史不谈，这一基本定理及其相关成果统一了我们对资产定价和衍生品理论的理解，并催生了大量文献，对金融实践领域产生了深远影响。

Query_Text_en: Finance is about the valuation of cash flows that extend over time and are usually uncertain . The basic intuition that underlies valuation is the absence of arbitrage . An arbitrage opportunity is an investment strategy that guaran ? tees a positive payoff in some contingency with no possibility of a negative payoff and with no initial net investment . In simple terms , an arbitrage op ? portunity is a money pump , and the canonical example is the opportunity to borrow at one rate and lend at a higher rate . Clearly individuals would want to take advantage of such an opportunity and would do so at unlimited scale . Equally clearly , such a disparity between the two rates can not persist : by bor ? rowing at the low rate and lending at the high rate , arbitragers will drive the rates together . The Fundamental Theorem derives the implications of the ab ? sence of such arbitrage opportunities .
Translation: 金融学关注的是对延续一段时间且通常具有不确定性的现金流进行估值。支撑估值的基本直觉是无套利原则。套利机会是一种投资策略，在某些情形下能够保证获得正收益，同时不存在负收益的可能，并且不需要初始净投资。简单来说，套利机会就是“赚钱机器”，最典型的例子是以一个利率借入资金，再以更高的利率贷出资金。显然，个人都会想要利用这样的机会，并且会无限制地扩大操作规模。同样显然，这种利率差异不可能长期存在：通过低息借入、高息贷出，套利者会促使两种利率趋于一致。基本定理正是推导了不存在此类套利机会时所带来的各种影响。

Query_Text_en: It s been said that you can teach a parrot to be an economist if it can learn to say `` supply and demand . Supply , demand , and equilibrium are the catch ? words of economics , but finance , or , if one is being fancy , financial economics , has its own distinct vocabulary . Unlike labor economics , for example , which specializes the methodology and econometrics of supply , demand , and eco ? nomic theory to problems in labor markets , neoclassical finance is qualitatively different and methodologically distinct . With its emphasis on the absence of arbitrage , neoclassical finance takes a step back from the requirement that the markets be in full equilibrium . While , as a formal matter , the methodology of neoclassical finance can be fitted into the framework of supply and demand , depending on the issue , doing so can be awkward and may not be especially useful . In this chapter we will eschew supply and demand and develop the methodology of finance as the implication of the absence of arbitrage .
Translation: 有人说，如果一只鹦鹉能学会说“供给与需求”，你就可以把它培养成经济学家。供给、需求和平衡是经济学的关键词，但金融学，或者说如果讲得更正式些，金融经济学，则有自己独特的词汇。与劳动经济学不同，后者是将供给、需求和经济理论的方法论及计量经济学专门应用于劳动力市场的问题，而新古典金融学则在性质上有本质区别，方法论上也独具一格。新古典金融学强调无套利的原则，这使它在一定程度上摆脱了市场必须完全均衡的要求。虽然从形式上说，新古典金融学的方法论可以纳入供给与需求的框架，具体要看所讨论的问题，但这样做往往显得生硬，而且未必有多大用处。在本章中，我们将摒弃供给与需求的方法，而将金融学的方法论发展为无套利原则的推论。

Query_Text_en: The assumption of no arbitrage [ NA ] is compelling because it appeals to the most basic beliefs about human behavior , namely that there is someone who prefers having more wealth to having less . Since , save for some anthropologi ? cally interesting societies , a preference for wealth appears to be a ubiquitous human characteristic , it is certainly a minimalist requirement . NA is also a necessary condition for an equilibrium in the financial markets . If there is an arbitrage opportunity , then demand and supply for the assets involved would be infinite , which is inconsistent with equilibrium . The study of the implica ? tions of NA is the meat and potatoes of modern finance .
Translation: 无套利假设（NA）之所以具有说服力，是因为它诉诸于人类行为最基本的信念，即总有人更喜欢拥有更多的财富而不是更少。除了某些在人类学上有趣的社会之外，对财富的偏好似乎是人类普遍的特征，因此这无疑是一个最低限度的要求。NA 也是金融市场实现均衡的必要条件。如果存在套利机会，那么相关资产的需求和供给将是无限的，这与均衡状态相矛盾。研究无套利假设的含义正是现代金融学的核心内容。

Query_Text_en: The early observations of the implications of NA were more specific than the general theory we will describe . The law of one price [ LOP ] is the most important of the special cases of NA , and it is the basis of the parity theory of forward exchange . The LOP holds that two assets with identical payoffs must sell for the same price . We can illustrate the LOP with a traditional example drawn from the theory of international finance . If s denotes the current spot price of the Euro in terms of dollars , and f denotes the currently quoted for ? ward price of Euros one year in the future , then the LOP implies that there is a lockstep relation between these rates and the domestic interest rates in Europe and in the United States .
Translation: 对无套利（NA）含义的早期观察比我们将要描述的一般理论更为具体。单一价格法则（LOP）是NA最重要的特殊情形之一，也是远期汇率平价理论的基础。LOP认为，两个具有相同收益的资产必须以相同的价格出售。我们可以用国际金融理论中的一个传统例子来说明LOP。如果s表示以美元计价的欧元现汇价格，f表示当前报出的未来一年后的欧元远期价格，那么LOP意味着这些汇率与欧洲和美国的本国利率之间存在着同步关系。

First , they loan $ 1 out for one year at the domestic interest rate of r , resulting in a payment to them one year from now of [ 1 + r ] . Simultaneously they can enter into a forward contract guaranteeing that they will deliver Euros in one year . With f as the current one-year forward price of Euros , they can guarantee the delivery of Euros in one year s time . Since this is the amount they will have in Euros in one year , they can borrow against this amount in Europe : letting the Euro in ? terest rate be re , the amount they will be able to borrow is

Translation: 这种在国内放贷、在国外借款，并利用远期和现货市场兑换货币的循环，如果上述金额与投资者最初投入的1美元不同，就会构成套利。因此，一般来说，利率平价理论（NA）以及购买力平价理论（LOP）都要求……

Query_Text_en: This means that the amount of euros obtained after one year is equal to that of buying euros directly in dollars in the spot market and lending them in foreign bond markets by lending dollars now and exchanging dollars for euros at the forward exchange rate.
Translation: 这意味着，一年后获得的欧元数量，无论是直接用美元在即期市场购买欧元并将其投资于海外债券市场，还是现在借出美元并按远期汇率将美元兑换成欧元，结果都是相同的。

Query_Text_en: Not surprisingly , as a practical matter , the above parity equation holds nearly without exception in all of the foreign currency markets . In other words , at least for the outside observer , none of this kind of arbitrage is avail ? able . This lack of arbitrage is a consequence of the great liquidity and depth of these markets , which permit any perceived arbitrage opportunity to be ex ? ploited at arbitrary scale . It is , however , not unusual to come across apparent arbitrage opportunities of mispriced securities , typically when the securities themselves are only available in limited supply .2
Translation: 毫不奇怪，实际上，上述平价方程几乎在所有外汇市场中都成立，几乎没有例外。换句话说，至少对于外部观察者来说，这类套利机会是不存在的。这种缺乏套利机会的现象，是由于这些市场具有极高的流动性和深度，使得任何被发现的套利机会都可以被任意规模地利用。然而，遇到表面上的套利机会并不罕见，通常是在相关证券本身供应有限的情况下出现的。

Query_Text_en: While the LOP is a nice illustration of the power of assuming NA , it is some - what misleading in that it does not fully capture the implications of removing arbitrage opportunities . Not all arbitrage possibilities involve two different posi ? tions with identical cash flows . Arbitrage also arises if it is possible to establish two equally costly positions , one of which has a greater set of cash flows in all circumstances than the other . To accommodate this possibility , we adopt the following framework and definitions . While the results we obtain are quite gen ? eral and apply in an intertemporal setting , for ease of exposition we will focus on a one-period model in which decisions are made today , at date 0 , and payoffs are received in the future at date 1 . By assumption , nothing happens in between these two dates , and all decisions are undertaken at the initial date , 0 .
Translation: 虽然LOP很好地说明了假设无套利（NA）所带来的强大力量，但它在某种程度上具有误导性，因为它并未完全体现消除套利机会的全部含义。并非所有套利机会都涉及两个现金流完全相同的不同头寸。如果能够建立两个成本相同的头寸，其中一个在所有情况下的现金流都大于另一个，也会出现套利。为了涵盖这种可能性，我们采用如下的框架和定义。虽然我们得到的结果具有相当的普遍性，并适用于跨期情形，但为了便于阐述，我们将重点放在单周期模型上，在该模型中，决策在今天（即第0期）做出，收益在未来（即第1期）获得。根据假设，在这两个时间点之间不会发生任何事情，所有决策都在初始时刻（0期）完成。

Query_Text_en: To capture uncertainty , we will assume that there is a state space , 11 and to keep the mathematics at a minimum , we will assume that there are only a fi ? nite number of possible states of nature : The state space , lists the mutually exclusive states of the world that can oc ? cur , m. In other words , at time 1 the uncertainty is resolved and the world is in one and only one of the m states of nature in
Translation: 为了体现不确定性，我们假设存在一个状态空间，为了尽量简化数学处理，我们假设自然状态只有有限个可能性：状态空间列出了可能发生的、互不相容的世界状态，共有m种。换句话说，在时刻1时，不确定性被消除，世界只会处于m种自然状态中的某一种。

Query_Text_en: Merton pointed out that since the returns on the call were perfectly corre ? lated with those on the underlying stock , a portfolio of the risk-free asset and the stock could be constructed at each point in time that would have identical returns to those on the call . To prevent arbitrage , then , a one-dollar investment in this replicating portfolio would be equivalent to a one-dollar investment in the call . The resulting algebra produces the same differential equation , and , as a consequence , there is no need to employ an asset-pricing model . Black and Scholes and Merton appealed to the literature on differential equations to find the solution to the boundary value problem with the terminal value equal to the payoff on the call at time T.
Translation: 默顿指出，由于认购期权的收益与其标的股票的收益完全相关，可以在每一时刻构建一个由无风险资产和股票组成的投资组合，使其收益与认购期权的收益相同。为了防止套利，这个复制投资组合中的一美元投资就等同于认购期权中的一美元投资。由此产生的代数运算得出了相同的微分方程，因此无需使用资产定价模型。布莱克、斯科尔斯和默顿借助微分方程领域的文献，来求解以期权到期时的收益为终值的边值问题。

Query_Text_en: Cox and Ross observed that once it was known that arbitrage alone would determine the value of the call option , analysts were handing off the problem to the mathematicians prematurely . Translation: 其中，T 是剩余到期周期数，即 T - t。方程中下一期数值的系数被称为二项过程的风险中性概率，也就是说，在假设预期收益率为无风险利率的情况下，这些就是该过程的概率。请注意，这与扩散模型中漂移项不起作用的情况类似，因为市场在局部上是完备的，存在两个状态和三种资产，其中一种资产是冗余的，已知另外两种资产的价值后，二项跳跃的概率在对第三种证券定价时并不需要。如果我们让节点之间的时间间隔变得很小，并增加节点数量，以保持股票收益的波动率不变，那么这个差分方程会收敛到Black-Scholes微分方程。

Query_Text_en: Alternatively , we can derive the difference equation directly from the Fundamental Theorem by invoking NA directly to price a derivative security such as a call option . Since the stock and the option are perfectly correlated assets locally , we can form a portfolio of the two of them that is riskless , for example , we can short the stock and go long the option in just the correct proportions so as to eliminate all risk in the portfolio . Equivalently , we could construct a replicating portfolio composed of the risk-free rate and the stock whose return is locally identical to the return on the call option . NA in the form of the LOP requires that the portfolio , as a riskless asset , have the unique risk-free rate of return , r. The resulting equation is the discrete equation of the binomial model and the famous partial differential equation of Black and Scholes . In either case , the solution is the pricing equation derived from risk - neutral pricing .7

Query_Text_en: It took decades from this initial set of concepts to the development of mean variance portfolio theory and the intuitive leap of the Capital Asset Pricing Model [ CAPM ] to recognize that this way of thinking about the risk premium was not quite correct . We can illustrate this with a look at the three main asset-pricing theories .

Query_Text_en: Historically , the CAPM [ Sharpe 1964 ; Lintner 1965 ] preceded the APT , but it is a bit less obvious what its relation is to NA . By assuming that returns are normally distributed [ or locally normal in a continuous time-diffusion model ] , or by assuming that individuals all have quadratic utility functions , it is possible to develop a beautiful theory of asset pricing . In this theory two additional concepts emerge . First , since the only focus is on the mean and the variance of asset returns , individuals will choose portfolios that are mean-variance efficient , that is , portfolios that lie on the frontier in mean - variance space . This is equivalent to what is called two-fund separation [ see Ross [ 1978b ] , who observes that all efficient portfolios lie on a line in the n-dimensional portfolio space ] . Second , a consequence of mean-variance efficiency is that the market portfolio , m , that is , the portfolio in which all as ? sets are held in proportion to their values , will itself be mean-variance efficient . Indeed , the mean-variance efficiency of the market portfolio is equivalent to the CAPM .10 Not surprisingly , in any such model where valuation is by a quadratic , the pricing kernel will be in terms of marginal utilities or derivatives of a quad ? ratic and will be linear in the market portfolio .
