Here , as elsewhere in economics , but with rather more irony here , the best way of understanding the economics of capitalism may be to think about a socialist economy .
Translation: 工人因劳动而获得报酬；那么资本家因为什么获得报酬呢？是因为他们在更为迂回的生产过程中耐心等待，或者因为他们克制了当前的某些消费，转而用于补充或增加资本存量，从而维持或提高未来的消费。由于这种“等待”往往是在昂贵的汽车和豪华度假胜地中度过的，而这种“克制”在哪怕是稍微有些愤世嫉俗的观察者看来也难以引发同情，整个说法就开始显得像是一个明显的文字游戏。[事实上，我认为“克制”这个说法比“等待”更让人反感，尽管如果能剥除其道德或说教色彩，我认为它在经济学上是更有用的描述。但即便如此，经济学家也没有理由仅仅因为反感这种措辞就丢弃这个概念。经济学中最精妙的成果之一，就是对价格或影子价格体系下资源配置影响的分析。我们已经学会了让这种分析摆脱道德色彩。在资本理论中，所需的只是在资本的归因收益和资本家的收入之间做出概念上的区分。在经济学的其他领域也是如此，但在这里更具讽刺意味——理解资本主义经济学的最佳方式，或许是去思考一个社会主义经济。

Query_Text_en: There is also an intrinsic reason for the controversial character of capital theory : it is very complicated and very difficult . I think the Austrian school overdid the identification of capital itself [ and capital theory ] with time it was an inspired simplification that didnt work but the need for a theory of capital does arise only when we try to take ac-count of production processes which involve time in some essential way . I say some essential way : the point is that there are many essential ways in which time may enter the production process . Adding the time dimension opens up a bewildering variety of partial models of production , of theories which take careful account of some aspect of intertemporal life only at the expense of neglecting other aspects . What pass for different theories of capital often turn out to be simply idealizations of different aspects of the role of time in production . And some of the violent polemics arise because one economist persists in thinking about grape juice while another thinks about machinery .
Translation: 资本理论之所以具有争议性，还有一个内在原因：它本身非常复杂且极其困难。我认为奥地利学派过度将资本本身（以及资本理论）与时间等同起来，这是一种富有创见的简化，但并未奏效。然而，只有当我们试图解释那些在某种本质意义上涉及时间的生产过程时，才真正需要资本理论。我之所以强调“某种本质意义”，是因为时间可以以多种本质方式进入生产过程。引入时间维度，会带来令人眼花缭乱的各种生产局部模型，以及那些只关注跨期生活某一方面、却忽视其他方面的理论。所谓不同的资本理论，往往只是对时间在生产中作用不同方面的理想化。而一些激烈的论战之所以产生，是因为一位经济学家始终在思考葡萄汁，另一位则在思考机器设备。

Query_Text_en: A man from Mars reading the literature on capital theory would be inclined sometimes to think that capital consists mainly of stocks of consumer goods to maintain workers until their output can be sold ; sometimes he would think that the earth is given over to the maturing of wine and the growing of trees , so that capital consists largely of goods in process ; sometimes he would realize that most of what we think of as capital consists of durable assets like buildings and machinery , or what we call fixed capital . He would perhaps wonder why Wick sell , in the course of a careful analysis of a model with fixed capital in the form of axes , did not pay any attention to the age of the trees being cut down [ though he had done so 30 years earlier ] , whereas Bohm-Bawerk , who seemed to be thinking mainly about the age at which trees should be cut down , seemed to worry too little about the implement to be used in felling them . He would be a little uncertain whether gestation periods matter a lot or not , whether production is like making elephants or making mosquitoes . The truth , of course , is that all these aspects of capitalistic production are important , that it is useless to try to represent all of them by any one of them , and extraordinarily complicated to deal simultaneously with them all .
Translation: 如果一个来自火星的人阅读有关资本理论的文献，他有时会认为资本主要是由用于维持工人直到其产出能够出售的消费品存量构成；有时他会觉得地球上的主要活动是葡萄酒的酿造和树木的种植，因此资本在很大程度上是处于生产过程中的在制品；有时他又会意识到，我们通常所说的资本大多是像建筑物和机器这样的耐用资产，也就是我们所称的固定资本。他或许会疑惑，为什么维克塞尔在对以斧头为固定资本的模型进行细致分析时，并未关注被砍伐树木的年龄（尽管他在三十年前曾做过类似研究），而伯姆-巴维克似乎主要关心树木应在何时砍伐，却又对用于砍伐的工具关注甚少。他会有些不确定，孵化期到底是否重要，生产究竟更像是繁殖大象还是繁殖蚊子。当然，事实是，资本主义生产的所有这些方面都很重要，试图用其中任何一个方面来代表全部都是徒劳的，而要同时处理所有这些方面则极其复杂。

Query_Text_en: If this complexity of structure were all that stood between us and a satisfactory theory of capital , it would be nothing that a team from the Netherlands School of Economics and the Massachusetts Institute of Technology could not lick in a few years of hard work . But there is a further fundamental difficulty that bedevils even uncomplicated models . Capital problems are inevitably bound up with questions of un-certainty , limited foresight , and reactions to the unexpected . One must admit that economics has barely scratched the sur-face here . Yet without a satisfactory account of behavior under uncertainty we can not have a complete theory of capital .
Translation: 如果结构的复杂性是我们与令人满意的资本理论之间唯一的障碍，那么荷兰经济学院和麻省理工学院的团队只需几年努力工作就能解决这个问题。然而，还有一个更为根本的难题，即便是最简单的模型也难以克服。资本问题不可避免地与不确定性、有限的预见能力以及对意外事件的反应紧密相关。必须承认，经济学在这一领域仅仅是浅尝辄止。没有对不确定性下行为的令人满意的解释，我们就无法拥有完整的资本理论。

Query_Text_en: Seen from this rather modest point of view , many of the heated controversies of both past and present seem to lose point . It does not really matter whether the rate of interest is a measure of the marginal productivity of time or the marginal productivity of capital , or the marginal productivity of any thing , since interest will clearly enter in different ways in production processes of quite different technological character . It does not really matter whether the period of production in processes involving fixed capital is finite or in-finite , or even whether it can be well defined at all , because the period of production is a concept designed to help analyze production involving predominantly circulating capital , and one would not expect it to be especially helpful in dealing with fixed capital . It does not really matter whether capital is a primary factor of production , nor is it especially important to ask how capital is to be measured . For there is no reason to suppose that any single object called capital can be defined to sum up in one number a whole range of facts about time lags , gestation periods , inventories of materials , goods in process , and finished commodities , old and new machines and buildings of varying durability , and more or less permanent improvements to land . Only someone who is naively identifying all the many aspects of capitalistic production with one of them , it does not matter which , would believe that the theory can be summed up by defining something called capital and calling the interest rate the marginal productivity of it .
Translation: 从这个相当谦逊的视角来看，许多过去和现在激烈的争论似乎都失去了意义。利率究竟是时间的边际生产力、资本的边际生产力，还是任何事物的边际生产力，其实并不重要，因为利率显然会以不同方式参与技术特征迥异的生产过程。对于涉及固定资本的生产过程，其生产周期是有限还是无限，甚至是否能够被明确定义，也并不重要，因为生产周期这一概念本身是为了分析以流动资本为主的生产过程而设计的，并不适用于处理固定资本问题。资本是否是生产的基本要素，以及资本应如何衡量，也并非特别重要。因为没有理由认为可以用一个被称为“资本”的单一对象来用一个数字概括时间滞后、孕育期、原材料库存、在制品和成品、新旧机器和建筑物的不同耐久性，以及土地的各种永久性改良等一系列事实。只有那些天真地将资本主义生产的诸多方面与其中某一个方面（无论是哪一个）等同起来的人，才会相信理论可以通过定义所谓的资本，并将利率称为其边际生产力来加以概括。

Query_Text_en: There is a highbrow answer to this question and a lowbrow one . The highbrow answer is that the theory of capital is after all just a part of the fundamentally microeconomic theory of the allocation of resources , necessary to allow for the fact that commodities can be transformed into other commodities over time . Just as the theory of resource allocation has as its dual a theory of competitive pricing , so the theory of capital has as its dual a theory of intertemporal pricing involving rentals , interest rates , present values and the like . In both cases , a complete price theory is also a theory of distribution among factors of production , if not among persons .
Translation: 对于这个问题，有高雅的回答，也有通俗的回答。高雅的回答是，资本理论归根结底只是资源配置这一微观经济理论的一个组成部分，其必要性在于考虑商品可以随着时间的推移转化为其他商品。正如资源配置理论有其对偶的竞争性定价理论，资本理论也有其对偶的跨期定价理论，涉及租金、利率、现值等内容。在这两种情况下，完整的价格理论同时也是生产要素之间（如果不是个人之间）分配的理论。

Query_Text_en: The lowbrow answer , I suppose , is that theory is supposed to help us understand real problems , and the real problems that can not be understood without capital-theoretic notions are those connected with saving and investment . Therefore the proper scope of capital theory is the elucidation of the causes and consequences of acts of saving and investment . Where the highbrow approach tends to be technical , dis-aggregated , and exact , the lowbrow view tends to be pecuniary , aggregative , and approximate .
Translation: 我认为，通俗的回答是，理论本应帮助我们理解现实问题，而那些离开资本理论概念就无法理解的现实问题，主要与储蓄和投资有关。因此，资本理论的恰当范畴应是阐明储蓄和投资行为的原因及其后果。高深的研究方法往往偏重技术性、细致分解和精确性，而通俗的观点则更侧重货币性、总体性和近似性。

Query_Text_en: A middlebrow like myself sees virtue in each of these ways of looking at capital theory . I am personally attracted by what I have described as the lowbrow view of the function of capital theory . But as so often happens , I think the high-brow view offers indispensable help in achieving the lowbrow objective . In particular , the suggestion that capital theory is an extension of ordinary resource allocation and price theory reminds one that modem microeconomics has two aspects which might be called the descriptive and the technocratic or the positive and the normative . Price theory began as an idealized description of how resources are allocated and in-come distributed in a competitive capitalist economy . But further analysis , as you know , uncovered something remark-able : if you try to answer not that descriptive question but the normative or technocratic one of how scarce resources should be allocated by a society anxious to avoid-waste , you rediscover the same theory in the guise of shadow prices or efficiency prices . This line of thought originated a long time ago , but culminates in the modern work on linear and non-linear programming and in the paradox that the theory of perfectly-competitive capitalism is in many respects the theory of a planned or socialist economy .
Translation: 像我这样具有中等品味的人，能够在这些关于资本理论的不同观点中看到各自的价值。就个人而言，我更倾向于我所描述的“低品味”资本理论功能观。但正如常常发生的那样，我认为“高品味”观点对于实现“低品味”目标提供了不可或缺的帮助。尤其是，将资本理论视为普通资源配置与价格理论的延伸，这一观点提醒我们，现代微观经济学具有两个方面，可以称之为描述性与技术性，或实证性与规范性。价格理论最初是对竞争性资本主义经济中资源配置和收入分配方式的理想化描述。但正如你所知，进一步的分析揭示了一个非同寻常的事实：如果你试图回答的不是描述性问题，而是规范性或技术性的问题，即一个希望避免浪费的社会应如何配置稀缺资源，你会以影子价格或效率价格的形式重新发现同样的理论。这一思路早已萌芽，但最终在现代的线性与非线性规划研究中达到高潮，并形成了这样一个悖论：完全竞争资本主义理论在许多方面实际上也是计划经济或社会主义经济理论。

Query_Text_en: Capital theory , too , has a technocratic and a descriptive side . I believe that the easiest and safest route to a simple but rigorous view of the subject is to begin technocratically . By asking planning questions , allocation questions , we can , as I hope to show , dodge many embarrassing questions of definition and their ideological overtones . The fundamental difficulty of uncertainty can not really be dodged ; and since it can not be faced , it must simply be ignored . If I am right in thinking that much empty controversy arises because the questions asked are pointless , then the planning point of view may be a useful one . A planning question , after all , is likely to have an answer . Of course , with this gain in clarity comes a certain risk . It may be claimed that a capital theory erected on planning grounds has no relevance to the actual behavior of any real capitalist economy . That argument has often been made , with considerable success , against static competitive price theory . Capital theory is unlikely to be immune to the same complaint . But if we fail in this way to explain the actual distribution of income between profits and wages , we may yet be able to answer the lowbrow question about the consequences , if not the causes , of saving and investment decisions .
Translation: 资本理论同样具有技术性和描述性两面。我认为，通往对该主题进行简明而严谨理解的最简便、最安全的途径，是从技术性角度入手。通过提出规划性问题、配置性问题，我们可以——正如我希望展示的那样——规避许多令人尴尬的定义问题及其意识形态色彩。根本性的“不确定性”难题实际上无法回避；既然无法正面应对，只能暂时搁置不论。如果我认为许多无谓的争论源于所提问题本身毫无意义这一判断是正确的，那么，采取规划视角或许是有益的。毕竟，规划性问题往往是可以得到答案的。当然，这种清晰性的获得也带来一定风险。有人可能会认为，建立在规划基础上的资本理论与任何现实资本主义经济体的实际行为毫无关联。这种观点曾被用来反对静态竞争价格理论，并取得了相当大的成功。资本理论也难以完全避免类似的质疑。但即便我们因此未能解释利润与工资之间的实际收入分配，我们或许仍能回答关于储蓄和投资决策后果（即使不是原因）这一“通俗”问题。

Query_Text_en: Thinking about saving and investment from this technocratic point of view has convinced me that the central concept in capital theory should be the rate of return on investment . In short , we really want a theory of interest rates , not a theory of capital . I do not believe that this shift of emphasis makes the theory of capital easy ; but I do believe that concentrating on the rate of return leads to clarity of though , while concentrating on time , or capital , or the marginal productivity of capital , or the capital-output ratio has led to confusion . It seems to me that almost any important planning question we wish to ask about the saving-investment process has an unambiguous if perhaps approximate answer in terms of rates of return , whereas the answers sometimes given in terms of marginal products of capital and capital-output ratios are sometimes right , sometimes wrong , and often misleading . I suppose that my point of view could be described as a modern amalgamation of Wicksell and Irving Fisher .
Translation: 从技术官僚的角度思考储蓄与投资，使我确信资本理论的核心概念应当是投资回报率。简言之，我们真正需要的是利率理论，而非资本理论。我并不认为这种重心的转移会让资本理论变得简单；但我相信，聚焦于回报率能够带来思想上的清晰，而关注时间、资本、资本的边际生产力或资本产出比则往往导致混乱。在我看来，几乎任何我们希望就储蓄—投资过程提出的重要规划问题，都可以用回报率给出明确（即便是近似）的答案，而用资本的边际产出和资本产出比给出的答案，有时正确，有时错误，且常常具有误导性。我想，我的观点可以被描述为对维克塞尔和欧文·费雪理论的现代融合。

Query_Text_en: I must emphasize that I am not now identifying the rate of return on investment with the rate of profit or the observed market rate of interest or any form of income receipt in a capitalist economy . That can perhaps sometimes be done , but it is in any case part of the descriptive theory . My technocratic notion of the rate of return on investment must be entirely independent of the institutional arrangements of the economy . I had better suggest such a definition in fairly general terms ; later I shall show how the general definition works in the context of particular models .
Translation: 我必须强调，我现在所说的投资回报率，并不等同于利润率、市场上观察到的利率，或资本主义经济中的任何形式的收入。这种等同有时或许可以做，但那属于描述性理论的范畴。我的技术性投资回报率概念，必须完全独立于经济的制度安排。我最好用较为一般的术语提出这样的定义；稍后我将展示这一通用定义在具体模型中的应用。

Query_Text_en: Imagine an economy which produces a single consumer good [ which may be a fixed-weight bundle of various elementary consumer goods ] according to any reasonably well - behaved technology . There may be any number of primary factors of production , from natural resource deposits to labor of different quality and skill characteristics . I assume that production makes use of physical capital goods which are themselves produced buildings , machines , inventories ; in addition , the production of the consumer good and some or all of the capital goods may involve delay periods of various lengths , fixed or variable . One could hardly ask for more freedom in describing the techniques of production . Now imagine any arbitrary planned allocation of resources in this economy for the current year . By an allocation of resources I mean a complete specification of productive activities for the period : how much of the consumer good is to be produced , with what resources , capital goods , and labor services ; how much of what kinds of capital goods are to be produced , and with what inputs . All I ask of this arbitrary allocation is that it be efficient in the usual sense that , with the labor , resources , and capital goods available , it would not be possible to produce a bundle of capital and consumer goods providing more of some useful things without providing less of others . Efficiency implies , among other things , that there is no non-structural unemployment of labor or other primary resources , or of productive capacity .
Translation:
设想有这样一个经济体，只生产一种消费品（该消费品可以是由多种基础消费品按固定比例组合而成），其生产过程采用任何合理规范的技术。生产所需的初级生产要素可以有多种，包括自然资源、不同质量和技能特征的劳动力等。我假定生产过程中会使用实物资本品，这些资本品本身也是生产出来的，如厂房、机器、库存等。此外，消费品和部分或全部资本品的生产过程中，可能会涉及不同长度的生产周期，这些周期可以是固定的，也可以是可变的。对于生产技术的描述，几乎没有比这更宽泛的设定了。

现在，设想在这个经济体中，对本年度资源进行任意一种计划性配置。所谓资源配置，是指对本期生产活动的全面安排：要生产多少消费品，使用哪些资源、资本品和劳务；要生产多少、哪种类型的资本品，以及所需的投入品。对这种任意配置，我唯一的要求是其必须在通常意义上是有效率的，即在现有的劳动力、资源和资本品条件下，不可能在不减少其他有用物品的前提下，生产出更多的某些资本品或消费品。效率意味着，除结构性原因外，不存在劳动力或其他初级资源、生产能力的非结构性失业。

Query_Text_en: The planning authority in this economy could , and should , at least contemplate neighboring efficient resource allocations which produce a little less of the consumer good , i.e. which involve a little more saving , than the planned one . Because all the allocations considered are efficient , those which produce less consumption must also produce more of at least some lands of capital goods . To be specific , consider all allocations which yield , say , h units less of current consumption than the planned allocation [ where h is a small number ] . Now the planning authority must think ahead . If it adopts the planned allocation for the current period , the society will be left with certain supplies of primary factors and stocks of capital goods in the next period , and thus with a collection of possible allocations for the next period . Let the planning authority decide which one it will in fact choose from the collection . Call Co the planned consumption for the current period and C1 the planned consumption for the next period . At the end of the next period the economy will possess certain productive capacities and potentials for periods 2 , 3 , and later .
Translation: 该经济体的规划机构可以，也应该，至少考虑邻近的高效资源配置，这些配置会比当前规划方案少生产一些消费品，即涉及更多的储蓄。由于所有被考虑的配置都是高效的，因此那些减少消费的配置必然会增加至少某些类型的资本品的产出。具体来说，假设所有配置都比规划方案少产出h单位的当前消费品（其中h为一个较小的数值）。此时，规划机构必须着眼于未来。如果它在当前时期采用规划方案，社会将在下一时期拥有一定数量的初级生产要素和资本品存量，从而形成一系列下一时期的可能配置。让规划机构决定从这些配置中实际选择哪一个。将当前时期的规划消费量记为C₀，下一时期的规划消费量记为C₁。在下一时期结束时，经济体将拥有一定的生产能力和未来第2期、第3期及更远时期的潜力。

Query_Text_en: Now return to those possible current allocations which yield C0 h in current consumption and which leave , presumably , generally more capacity available for the next period . For each of these alternative current allocations , select a next-period allocation which would send the economy on into period 2 with the same productive capacities and potentials as the planned current and next allocations [ or with equivalent capacities and potentials , in the sense that any stream of consumption producible by one stock of capital and resources is producible by the other ] . Suppose that such a next-period allocation yields next-period consumption of Ci + k. Presumably k will be positive , since the alternative allocation yields more current saving and there-fore more next-period capacity than the planned allocation ; in any case k can not be negative for all alternative allocations , unless the economy is already over-saturated with capital goods . Finally , among all the alternative current and next - period allocations allowing CQ h consumption in the current period and equivalent potentials for period 2 and later , find the one which yields the largest k , the largest gain in next-period consumption over the planned pair of allocations . Thus by sacrificing h units of consumption in the present , society can earn an extra consumption of k units next period and suffer no ill effects thereafter . In such a case I would of course define the one-period rate of return on investment as [ k h ] lh = klh 1 . This is perfectly natural usage . If by saving an extra $ 1.00 of consumption this year society can enjoy at most $ 1.10 of consumption next year without endangering its later prospects , then one would certainly want to say that society has earned 10 per cent on its investment .
Translation:
现在，让我们回到那些能够实现本期消费为C₀ - h，并且通常会为下一期留有更多产能的可能的当前资源配置。对于每一种这样的当前资源配置，选择一种下一期的资源配置，使得经济在进入第二期时，拥有与原计划的本期和下一期配置相同的生产能力和潜力（或者说，拥有等效的能力和潜力，即任何由一种资本和资源存量所能生产的消费流，也能由另一种存量生产）。假设这种下一期的资源配置能够带来下一期的消费为C₁ + k。可以预期，k 是正数，因为这种替代配置带来了更多的本期储蓄，因此也带来了比原计划更多的下一期产能；无论如何，除非经济已经被资本品过度饱和，否则对于所有的替代配置，k 不可能都是负数。

最后，在所有能够实现本期消费为C₀ - h，并且保证第二期及以后拥有等效潜力的本期和下一期资源配置中，找到那个能使k最大的配置，即能使下一期消费比原计划多出最多的配置。这样，通过在本期牺牲h单位的消费，社会可以在下一期获得额外k单位的消费，并且此后不会带来任何不良影响。在这种情况下，我当然会将投资的一期收益率定义为[k/h]，即k除以h。这是完全自然的表述。如果通过今年多储蓄1美元的消费，社会明年最多可以享受1.10美元的消费，并且不会影响其以后的发展前景，那么我们当然会说，社会在这项投资上获得了10%的收益率。

Query_Text_en: Before I go further , let me make two fairly obvious remarks . First , the technocratic planning authority could just as well contemplate an increase in current consumption which would have to be paid for by a decrease in next-period consumption , in order to leave more distant future prospects undamaged . In that case h and k would both be negative and the one-period rate of return could be calculated exactly as before . If the technology is very smooth , then the rates of return for increases and decreases in saving will be approximately the same , and will draw closer together as h gets smaller . But even in quite well-behaved technologies of the not-so-smooth linear-programming type , the upward and downward rates of return can differ even for very small h. If the technology exhibits constant returns to scale and enough diminishing returns , the rate of return for decreases in saving will exceed that for increases in saving , if they differ at all .
Translation: 在继续深入之前，我先提出两个显而易见的观点。首先，技术官僚式的计划机构同样可以考虑增加当前消费，这将必须以减少下一期消费为代价，以确保更远期的未来前景不受损害。在这种情况下，h 和 k 都为负数，而单期收益率的计算方法与之前完全相同。如果技术条件非常平滑，那么储蓄增加和减少所对应的收益率将大致相同，且随着 h 的减小，两者会越来越接近。但即使在相当规范、但并非完全平滑的线性规划类型技术中，上升和下降的收益率即使在 h 很小的情况下也可能不同。如果技术表现为规模报酬不变且报酬递减效应足够强，那么在两者存在差异时，减少储蓄所对应的收益率将高于增加储蓄的收益率。

Query_Text_en: Second , my restriction to a consumption bundle of un-changing composition is only an expository simplification . If there are many consumption goods , then the planned current allocation , since it is efficient , implies certain marginal rates of transformation among them . [ If the allocation is Pareto-optimal with respect to the preferences of citizens or technocrats then these rates of transformation will coincide with marginal rates of substitution in consumption ] . For small changes in saving , it is adequate to calculate the rate of return at the margin in terms of any one consumer good or subtractions and additions of small bundles of consumer goods of arbitrary composition . This is so for the same reason that , in static production theory , when costs are being minimized , marginal labor costs equal marginal material costs equal marginal equipment costs equal marginal costs no matter how a small increment in output is obtained . In non-smooth technologies the situation will not be so simple .
Translation: 其次，我对消费组合成分不变的限制仅仅是一种阐述上的简化。如果存在多种消费品，那么由于当前配置是有效率的，因此它隐含着这些消费品之间某些边际转化率。（如果该配置对于公民或技术官僚的偏好而言是帕累托最优的，那么这些转化率将与消费中的边际替代率一致。）对于储蓄的微小变动，只需用任意一种消费品，或用任意成分的小型消费品组合的增减，来计算边际回报率即可。这与静态生产理论中的道理相同：在成本最小化时，无论产出如何微小地增加，边际劳动成本、边际材料成本、边际设备成本以及边际总成本都是相等的。在非平滑技术条件下，情况则不会如此简单。

Query_Text_en: The concept discussed so far is clearly a one-period or short-run rate of return ; it is as if the economy could deposit consumption goods in a bank account and draw them out , with interest , at the end of the year . The rate of return , as I have defined it , is the rate of interest paid by the bank on one-year deposits only the bank is really the complete collection of capital-using production processes in the economy . [ In a technology with corners and jumps , the interest earned on an extra deposit may differ from the interest lost on an extra withdrawal , and the difference may not be small . There is nothing ambiguous in such a situation , but it is more complicated to describe . One should not slay the theoretical messenger for bringing the bad news that the world is complicated .
Translation: 到目前为止所讨论的概念显然是一种单周期或短期收益率；这就好比经济体能够将消费品存入银行账户，并在年末连本带息取出。我所定义的收益率，就是银行对一年期存款支付的利率——只不过这里的“银行”实际上是经济中所有使用资本的生产过程的总和。[在存在“拐点”和“跳跃”的技术条件下，额外存款所获得的利息可能与额外取款所损失的利息不同，而且这种差异可能并不小。这种情况下并不存在任何歧义，只是描述起来更为复杂。我们不应因为理论带来了世界复杂性的“坏消息”而责怪理论本身。

Query_Text_en: There is a case for saying that these one-period rates of return are the fundamental ones because , in a highly-developed and complex growing economy , saving-investment decisions come up for reconsideration every period and can easily be changed or even undone ; so that even a long and complicated investment program can probably be duplicated by a series of cleverly-chosen short-term programs . Nevertheless , the planning authority may , sometimes by choice , sometimes by technological necessity , compare the consumption stream yielded by the planned allocation with alternatives stretching over more than two periods . The choice of time profiles for enjoying the fruits of a current increment to saving is uncomfortably wide . For some of them it is easy to define a rate of return to the initial act of saving-investment . If the alternative is to save an extra h units of consumption now , hold consumption next period at the same level C as in the planned allocation , consume all that is possible in the period after C2 = C2-k under the constraint that C3 , ... must ever after be at their levels in the trial planned allocation , then the average rate of return per period on this two-year investment is defined by kjh = [ 1 + rt2 ] 2 . Quite similarly , if the authority should decide to save now , go back to planned consumption levels for n 1 periods , and then splurge everything in the nth period [ subject to the same guarantee about subsequent periods ] , and if Cn were the originally-planned wth period consumption and Cn the most that can be consumed under the alternative plans , then the average w-period rate of return must be the solution of [ CV C ] \/ [ C0 Q \/ ] = [ l + rtnf As usual , I am assuming C0 Co to be small .
Translation: 有理由说这些单周期的收益率是最基本的，因为在一个高度发达且复杂增长的经济体中，储蓄-投资决策每个周期都会被重新考虑，并且可以很容易地被改变甚至撤销；因此，即使是一个长期且复杂的投资计划，也很可能可以通过一系列巧妙选择的短期计划来复制。然而，规划当局有时出于选择，有时出于技术上的必要，会将计划分配所带来的消费流与跨越两个以上周期的其他方案进行比较。对于如何选择享受当前储蓄增量成果的时间分布，选择范围令人不安地宽泛。对于其中一些方案，很容易定义对初始储蓄-投资行为的收益率。如果备选方案是在现在多储蓄h单位的消费，下一周期将消费维持在与计划分配中相同的水平C，在之后的周期消费所有可能的量（即C2 = C2-k），但约束条件是C3及以后的消费必须始终保持在试验性计划分配中的水平，那么这项为期两年的投资的平均周期收益率可由kjh = [1 + rt2]^2来定义。类似地，如果当局决定现在储蓄，接下来的n-1个周期恢复到计划的消费水平，然后在第n周期将所有可用资源一次性消费（同样要求后续各期消费保持在原计划水平），如果Cn是原计划中的第n期消费，Cn也是在备选方案下可消费的最大值，那么平均w周期的收益率必须满足[CV C] / [C0 Q /] = [1 + rtnf]的解。像往常一样，我假定C0 Co都很小。

Query_Text_en: There is one other easy case in principle at least . The planning authority could choose to sacrifice an extra h units of consumption and then so arrange things as to add a constant amount to each periods previously planned consumption , in perpetuity . Thus we have Co = C0 h , Q = Q + p , C2 = C2 -- p , etc. . Ifp is the largest such perpetual increment to consumption that can be maintained , it is natural to describe p\/A as the average rate of return in perpetuity . I will work out such a calculation for a particular model later .
Translation: 原则上，至少还有另一种简单的情况。规划当局可以选择牺牲额外的 h 单位消费，然后安排使得在每一期原先计划的消费基础上，永久性地增加一个恒定的数额。于是我们有 C0 = C0 - h，C1 = C1 + p，C2 = C2 + p，等等。如果 p 是能够维持的这种永久性消费增量的最大值，那么将 p/A 描述为永久性的平均回报率是很自然的。稍后我会针对一个特定模型进行这样的计算。

Query_Text_en: More complicated time profiles are more difficult to summarize in a single rate of return per period . It is tempting to take an arbitrary stream of algebraic increments to the originally planned consumption stream , some positive , some negative , and find the rate of interest that equates its present value to the current saving making it possible ; this is in effect simply a marginal efficiency of investment or internal rate of return . It is , of course , open to the difficulty that if there are negative as well as positive changes in planned consumption , then there may be more than one marginal efficiency of investment for a single alternative consumption program . It is open to the much more serious objection that it often leads to incorrect decisions . The best procedure is to get along without internal rates . The short-run , technologically-defined rates of return are the basic material and all that is necessary can be constructed from them . They need not be averaged into some over-all figure .
Translation: 更为复杂的时间分布难以用单一的每期收益率来加以概括。人们往往倾向于对最初计划的消费流进行一系列代数增减，有正有负，然后寻找一个使其现值等于当前储蓄（即使该消费流成为可能）的利率；实际上，这只是投资的边际效率或内部收益率。然而，这种做法显然存在一个问题：如果计划消费中既有正向也有负向变动，那么对于某一备选消费方案，可能会出现不止一个投资边际效率。更为严重的是，这种方法往往会导致错误的决策。最好的做法是摒弃内部收益率的使用。短期、由技术条件决定的收益率才是基本依据，所有必要的分析都可以由此构建，无需将其平均为某个总体指标。

Query_Text_en: This difficulty with complicated multi-period consumption programs gets even deeper when one considers economies in which technological progress is occurring , , as I shall do in the next lecture . Even without technological change , the nature of the problem is illustrated by the fact that as I have defined it even the one-period rate of return on investment depends [ perhaps sensitively , perhaps not ] on the level of consumption for this period and the next period as they appear in the original plan . A fortiori , for longer periods the stream of returns from a marginal act of saving-investment now will depend on what had been planned for the future anyway . This dependence merely reflects the fact that I am considering small variations around some pre-existing situation , as is always done in static economics [ and that restriction is not strictly necessary except for shadow-price interpretations ] . But since time plays a role in my problem , I must specify the base situation , from which possible displacements occur , in full detail .
Translation: 在涉及技术进步的经济体中，复杂的多期消费方案所带来的困难将更加突出，这也是我将在下一讲中讨论的问题。即便没有技术变革，问题的本质也可以通过以下事实来说明：按照我的定义，即使是一期的投资回报率，也取决于本期和下一期在原始计划中设定的消费水平，这种依赖关系可能很敏感，也可能不敏感。更不用说在更长时期内，当前边际储蓄—投资行为所带来的回报流，必然会受到原本为未来所做计划的影响。这种依赖关系仅仅反映了我是在某一既定情境下，考察其周边的小幅变动，这也是静态经济学中一贯采用的方法（而且这种限制其实并非严格必要，仅在影子价格解释时才需要）。但由于时间在我的问题中起着作用，我必须对作为可能变动基础的初始情境进行详尽的说明。

Query_Text_en: This is a problem of execution , not of principle , and I do not think it either surprising or terribly important . In the first place , it clearly does not signify that the planning problem has no solution . The abstract technocrat or planner need never worry about helpful little constructs like the rate of return on investment . He need only consider all possible future time profiles for the economy emanating from the current state of affairs , eliminate te obviously inefficiente ons , o and choose the best [ the most preferred ] out of the ones remaining . There is no reason on earth to expect this procedure in full generality to reduce to the business of calculating a bunch of rates of return and a bunch of rates of time preference and comparing the two bunches . But the middle-brow economist may want to have some such routine because a simplified model yielding an approximate result may be good enough for him . [ As to the thin line between simplified and over-simplified models , I can do no better than quote the English philosopher J. L. Austin : ... we must at all costs avoid over-simplification , which one might be tempted to call the occupational disease of philosophers if it were not their occupation .
Translation: 这是一个执行层面的问题，而非原则性问题，我认为这既不令人惊讶，也并非特别重要。首先，这显然并不意味着规划问题无解。抽象的技术官僚或规划者根本无需为诸如投资回报率之类的有用小工具而烦恼。他只需考虑从当前状况出发，经济可能出现的所有未来时间路径，剔除那些明显低效的方案，然后从剩下的方案中选择最优（即最受偏好的）即可。完全没有理由认为，这一过程在一般情况下会简化为计算一堆投资回报率和一堆时间偏好率，然后将两者进行比较的事务。但中等水平的经济学家可能希望有这样一套程序，因为对于他们来说，一个能够得出近似结果的简化模型可能已经足够用了。至于简化模型与过度简化模型之间的微妙界限，我只能引用英国哲学家J.L.奥斯汀的话：“……我们无论如何都必须避免过度简化，如果不是因为这是哲学家的职业，过度简化几乎可以被称为哲学家的职业病。”

Query_Text_en: This is the role the special notion of the stationary state played in 19 th century capital theory . It provided a simple and convenient class of base situations from which one could easily calculate possible displacements : either from one stationary state to a neighboring one , or from a stationary state to a slight deviation and then back to the same stationary state . In the modem mood we are more likely to take as our base situations the class of states of balanced growth at the natural rate of growth , and go through the same routine of considering small displacements . My guess is that for most of the problems likely to confront the general economist some natural comparison will present itself . I have already mentioned the likelihood that in a complex modern economy the one-period return is likely to be specially important because decisions regenerate themselves fairly quickly . These two advantages taken together suggest to me that for many macroeconomic problems in capital theory it is enough to look at , say , the one-year rate h return on investment , thef rate of return in perpetuity , and perhaps a ten-year rate of return in between .
Translation: 这正是“静态状态”这一特殊概念在19世纪资本理论中所发挥的作用。它为分析提供了一类简单便捷的基准情形，人们可以据此轻松计算可能出现的偏离：无论是从一个静态状态到相邻的另一个静态状态，还是从静态状态发生轻微偏离后再回到原来的静态状态。在当代的分析思路中，我们更倾向于将“以自然增长率实现均衡增长的状态”作为基准情形，并采用类似的方法来考察小幅度的偏离。我认为，对于大多数经济学家可能面临的问题，自然会有一种合适的比较基准出现。我已经提到，在复杂的现代经济中，单期收益往往尤为重要，因为决策会相对较快地自我更新。这两方面的优势结合起来，使我认为，在资本理论的许多宏观经济问题中，只需考察例如一年期投资回报率、永久回报率，或许再加上一个十年期回报率，就已足够。

Query_Text_en: I have been suggesting that the rate of return on acts of saving and investment is a good organizing concept for middlebrow capital theory . One of the advantages of looking at capital theory this way is that one automatically dodges most or all of the real or imaginary problems that have beset this branch of economics for so long . In particular , to calculate the rate of return in my sense requires no measurement of the stock of capital . What is more , a careful person will see that the whole process can be described with-out even mentioning the word capital . If there are concrete capital goods , or inventories , or delay periods , these will all of course affect the rate at which bundles of current consumption goods can be transformed into bundles of future consumption goods . But unless it is a natural thing to do under the technological circumstances , there is nojwsRTBS identify or measure a stock of generalized caafiM . Jand ttw economy throws up market prices or if the profited jeffkftialysis yields some kind of efficiency prices , then there is no harm in adding up various value sums which may correspond to the market [ or other ] value of the stock of capital goods . But such value sums are not capital in the sense of some-thing that belongs in a production function and has a marginal product . Similarly , it may turn out in theory that the rate of return on investment is equal to the rate of interest , defined as the ratio of the value of certain flows of goods to the value of the stock of capital goods . But then again , it may not . In any case all of this begins to belong to the descriptive theory of capital . I am content with the point that the problem of measuring capital simply does not arise in my way of looking at the theory .
Translation: 我一直认为，储蓄和投资行为的回报率是中等层次资本理论的一个很好的组织概念。以这种方式审视资本理论的一个优势在于，可以自动避开长期困扰该经济学分支的大部分真实或虚构的问题。尤其是，按照我的理解计算回报率并不需要衡量资本存量。更进一步，细心的人会发现，整个过程甚至可以在不提及“资本”一词的情况下进行描述。如果存在具体的资本品、库存或延迟期，这些当然会影响当前消费品组合转化为未来消费品组合的速度。但除非在技术条件下这样做是自然的，否则没有必要识别或衡量广义资本存量。如果经济体系产生了市场价格，或者利润分析得出了某种效率价格，那么将各种价值总和相加——这些总和可能对应于资本品存量的市场（或其他）价值——也无妨。但这些价值总和并不是生产函数中具有边际产出的资本意义上的资本。同样，理论上投资回报率可能等于利率，即某些商品流的价值与资本品存量价值的比率，但也可能并非如此。无论如何，这些内容都属于资本的描述性理论范畴。对我而言，资本测量的问题在我的理论视角下根本不会出现，这一点就足够了。

Query_Text_en: It is also said sometimes , that neo-classical capital theory must rest on such obviously absurd assumptions as that capital goods are malleable in the sense that one kind of machine can be instantaneously and costlessly transformed into any other kind or that specific capital goods can be substituted smoothly for labor and other inputs in the production of homogeneous output . The idea is that mallea-bility is necessary in order that there be something called capital to calculate the marginal productivity of , and smooth substitutability is necessary in order to calculate the marginal productivity of it . I think you can see that both of these contentions are wrong . Extreme assumptions like malle-ability and smooth substitutability make neo-classical capital theory easier [ whether they give badly distorted conclusions is hard to say ] ; but they are not essential to it . To the extent that neo-classical capital theory can be built around the rate of return concept including the accompanying efficiency-price theory and the possible identification with market prices and interest rates it can accommodate fixity of form and pro-portions both .
Translation: 有时还会有人说，新古典资本理论必须建立在一些显然荒谬的假设之上，比如资本品具有可塑性，即某种机器可以被瞬间且无成本地转变为任何其他类型的机器，或者特定的资本品可以在生产同质产出的过程中顺畅地替代劳动力和其他投入。其观点认为，只有具备可塑性，才有“资本”这一概念，从而可以计算其边际生产力；而顺畅的可替代性则是计算其边际生产力的必要条件。我认为，这两种看法都是错误的。像可塑性和顺畅可替代性这样的极端假设，确实使新古典资本理论的分析变得更为简便（至于是否会导致严重的结论偏差则难以断言），但它们并非理论的本质要求。只要新古典资本理论能够围绕收益率概念展开，包括相关的效率—价格理论，以及与市场价格和利率的可能对应关系，那么它完全可以容纳资本形态和比例的固定性。

Query_Text_en: The kernel of useful truth in the John Bates Clark picture of capital as a kind of jelly that transforms itself over time is that indeed , over time , something like this does happen as capital goods wear out and are replaced by different capital goods . The rigorous counterpart of this process is this : when capital goods are highly specific there may be sudden jumps in one-period rates of return relating to the present and near future . But as one looks further and further into the future the substitution possibilities become smoother and smoother and rates of return narrow down .
Translation: 约翰·贝茨·克拉克关于资本如同一种随时间转化的“果冻”的描述，其中确实包含着有益的真理：随着时间推移，资本品会逐渐磨损并被不同的资本品所替代，这一过程确实发生。对此过程更为严谨的表述是：当资本品具有高度专属性时，与当前及近期相关的单期收益率可能会出现突变。但当我们将视野放得更长远，替代的可能性会变得越来越平滑，收益率的差异也会逐渐缩小。

Query_Text_en: These are negative advantages of thinking in terms of the rate of return . I think there are positive advantages too . For rational planning at the microeconomic level , whether within a business firm or a government agency concerned with particular investment projects , admittedly there is no substitute for detailed knowledge of technical and economic interrelations . But at a more macroeconomic stage there appears to be no substitute for summary statistics . It seems to me that the needs of high-order decision-making , about such things as the overall rate of consumption and the choice among broad areas of investment , are best served by in-formation cast in the form of rates of return . The only way one can make sense of the capital-output ratios or incremental capital-output ratios or other such numbers that occasionally crop up , is to suppose that they are meant as crude approximations to one or another of the social rates of return on investment . If that is so , there are many reasons to believe that they are very crude approximations indeed , and economists have a responsibility to do better . One only has to ask whether rational saving-investment decisions can be independent of the durability of the structures and equipment involved or of the complementary inputs of labor and materials required . In all cases when the answer is no that is , in all cases the rate of return is a useful indicator of the choices facing society , while capital-output ratios are not .
Translation: 这些是以收益率为思考方式所带来的负面优势。我认为也存在正面优势。对于微观经济层面的理性规划，无论是在企业内部还是在负责具体投资项目的政府机构，确实无法替代对技术和经济相互关系的详细了解。但在更宏观的阶段，似乎又无法替代汇总统计数据。在我看来，高层决策所需的信息——比如整体消费率以及在广泛投资领域之间的选择——最适合以收益率的形式呈现。人们只有假设资本产出比、增量资本产出比或其他类似数据是对某种社会投资收益率的粗略近似，才能理解这些偶尔出现的数字。如果真是如此，那么有很多理由相信这些近似非常粗糙，经济学家有责任做得更好。只需问一句：理性的储蓄与投资决策是否可以不考虑相关结构和设备的耐用性，或所需的劳动力和材料等互补投入？在所有答案为否的情况下，也就是说，在所有情况下，收益率都是社会面临选择的有用指标，而资本产出比则不是。

Query_Text_en: [ I should also add that a technocratic theory of real capital emphasizing the return on investment has the advantage of linking up with contemporary efforts to refine the descriptive theory of asset preferences and monetary macro-dynamics . In particular , James Tobins recent work turns on the key notion of the rate of return required to induce the public to hold willingly the volume of real capital in existence at the moment as well as the increments contributed by current saving . He is concerned with how this required rate depends on the volume of financial assets in the portfolios of the public and on the actions of the fiscal and monetary authorities . I am concerned with the rate of return the stock of real capital goods is able to provide and how it depends on changes in technology and the accumulation of past saving . The two parts of the theory fit together nicely .
Translation: 我还要补充一点，强调投资回报率的技术官僚式实物资本理论，有助于与当前关于资产偏好描述理论和货币宏观动态的深化研究相衔接。尤其是，詹姆斯·托宾的最新研究围绕一个关键概念展开，即为使公众愿意持有现有实物资本及由当前储蓄带来的新增资本，所需的回报率。他关注的是，这一必要回报率如何受公众资产组合中金融资产规模以及财政和货币当局行为的影响。而我关注的是，实物资本存量能够提供的回报率，以及它如何受技术变革和以往储蓄积累的影响。这两部分理论能够很好地结合起来。

Query_Text_en: I must now give some examples , not yet from different factual situations but from different models or theoretical situations , postponing discussion of technical progress until later .
Translation: 我现在必须举一些例子，这些例子不是来自不同的实际情况，而是来自不同的模型或理论情境，关于技术进步的讨论将留待以后再说。

Query_Text_en: The most familiar model is the one most often criticized . Consider an economy producing one all-purpose commodity which can be consumed or else used as a capital good and combined with labor in continuously variable proportions to produce more of itself . Suppose that a fixed fraction of the stock of the commodity evaporates or wears out each year , independent of age . [ This is a very important simplifying assumption . Without it , the stream of production possibilities implicit in the stock depends not only on its size but on its age distribution . Any variation in the rate of investment will disturb the age distribution and it may take a long time to restore it or a long computation to verify whether two slightly different stocks of capital actually convey equivalent production possibilities .
Translation: 最为人熟知的模型也是最常受到批评的模型。设想一个经济体只生产一种万能商品，该商品既可以被消费，也可以作为资本品与劳动以连续可变的比例结合，用于生产更多自身。假设每年该商品存量的一个固定比例会蒸发或磨损，与其年龄无关。[这是一个非常重要的简化假设。没有这个假设，存量所隐含的生产可能性流不仅取决于其规模，还取决于其年龄分布。任何投资率的变化都会扰乱年龄分布，恢复原状可能需要很长时间，或者需要耗时的计算来验证两个略有不同的资本存量是否实际上具有等效的生产可能性。]

Query_Text_en: For a second example I choose a highly simplified model in which the technology permits no direct subsitution between labor and capital . It seems to me that in real life the appropriate assumption is that something like fixed technical coefficients rule in the short run and a fairly wide range of substitutability rules in the long run . But my object now is simply to show by example that the rate of return on investment does not depend for its existence and meaning on the possibility of defining marginal productivities or having smoothly variable proportions between the factors of production . The model is due to David Worswick .
Translation: 作为第二个例子，我选择了一个高度简化的模型，在该模型中，技术不允许劳动与资本之间有任何直接的替代关系。在现实生活中，我认为较为恰当的假设是：在短期内，类似于固定技术系数的情况占主导，而在长期内，则存在相当大的替代弹性。但我现在的目的只是通过这个例子说明，投资回报率的存在及其意义，并不依赖于边际生产力的定义，或生产要素之间比例可以平滑变动的可能性。该模型由大卫·沃斯威克提出。

Query_Text_en: Consider an economy producing a single consumer good or bundle of consumer goods . There are two known techniques for producing the consumer good . One is a primitive handicraft method , according to which one man working for one year can produce b units of consumables . The second technique uses machines : it takes n men to operate one machine , and together they can produce nc units of consumables in a year . Machines in turn are produced by labor alone . [ This assumption greatly simplifies the algebraic calculations I must make without being in the least necessary to my argument ] . A crew of m men working for a year can produce one machine . I shall assume that a fraction d of all machines in existence disappear by depreciation at the end of the year , while the remaining [ 1 d ] survive into the next period .
Translation: 假设一个经济体只生产一种消费品或一组消费品。已知有两种生产消费品的技术。一种是原始的手工方法，根据该方法，一个人工作一年可以生产b单位的消费品。另一种技术则使用机器：需要n个人操作一台机器，他们一年可以共同生产nc单位的消费品。机器完全由人工制造。[这一假设极大简化了我必须进行的代数计算，但对我的论证并非必要。]一组m人工作一年可以制造一台机器。我假定，每年末所有现有机器中有一部分，即比例为d的机器因折旧而消失，其余的[1-d]则留存到下一期。

The technocrats dispose of L workers , LM of whom are engaged in making machines , Lc in using machines to manufacture consumer goods , and Ln in producing consumer goods by hand . Thus LM -- Lc-r Ln = L. Suppose for definiteness and simplicity that plans call for this division not to change . Let M be the stock of machines in existence . If this stock is to be maintained , the annual output of machines must be dM , and therefore LM = dmM . Since all M machines are used to produce consumer goods , we have that Le nM . Translation: 假设劳动力总供给保持不变。技术官员可以调配L名工人，其中LM从事机器制造，Lc利用机器生产消费品，Ln则以手工方式生产消费品。因此，LM + Lc + Ln = L。为明确和简化起见，假设计划要求这种分工保持不变。设M为现有机器存量。若要维持这一存量，每年必须生产dM台机器，因此LM = dmM。由于所有M台机器都用于生产消费品，我们有Lc = nM。最后，若C为消费品的年产量。

Query_Text_en: Now let the planning authority consider the sacrifice of some present consumption for future consumption . The natural , indeed the only sensible , way to bring this about is to transfer some labor from the hand production of consumer goods to the hand production of machines . The main function of the hand-production-of-consumables sector in this model is to provide a reservoir of labor that can be transferred to machine production . Suppose we contemplate transferring one worker . Then C will be reduced by b units , i.e. the act of saving consists of foregoing the b units of consumables that worker could have produced . The transferred worker will instead produce 1\/m machines . And so in the next period the stock of machines will be increased to M + [ 1\/m ] .
Translation: 现在让规划当局考虑为了未来的消费而牺牲一部分当前的消费。实现这一目标的自然方式，实际上也是唯一合理的方式，就是将一部分劳动力从手工生产消费品转移到手工生产机器上。在这个模型中，手工生产消费品部门的主要功能就是提供一个可以转移到机器生产部门的劳动力储备。假设我们考虑转移一名工人。那么，消费品的产量将减少b单位，也就是说，储蓄的行为就是放弃这名工人本可以生产的b单位消费品。被转移的工人将改为生产1/m台机器。因此，在下一个时期，机器的存量将增加到M + [1/m]。

Query_Text_en: The question is : how much extra consumption is now possible in the following period , with the understanding that at the end of the period the stock of machines must be what it would have been if this extra bit of saving had never occurred ? The answer is perfectly straightforward . The stock of machines will diminish by depreciation to . To restore it at the end of the period to its stationary level M requires production of machines , and therefore the work of men . On the other hand , to operate the M -- 1 m machines requires nM + njm men . The number of men left now to produce consumer goods by hand is . This exceeds the old number of men in this industry by , which may be positive or negative . In any case the total output of consumer goods in this second period exceeds what it would have been under the old plan by . Since the amount of consumption initially sacrificed is b , the rate of return is according to the formula I gave earlier .
Translation: 问题是：在下一个时期，能够实现多少额外的消费？前提是，在该时期结束时，机器存量必须与如果没有发生这部分额外储蓄时本应有的水平相同。答案非常直接。机器存量将因折旧减少至某一水平。为了在期末将其恢复到原有的稳定水平M，需要生产一定数量的机器，因此需要一定的人力劳动。另一方面，操作M - 1 m台机器需要nM + njm名工人。现在剩下的人可以手工生产消费品。这个人数比原来在该行业中的人数多出一部分，这个差额可能为正也可能为负。无论如何，在第二个时期，消费品的总产量比按照原计划本应有的产量多出一部分。由于最初牺牲的消费量为b，根据我之前给出的公式，收益率就是这样计算出来的。

Query_Text_en: In this case it is easy to calculate the rate of return in perpetuity , and I do so to illustrate that under stationary conditions the one-period and perpetual rates of return [ and all intermediate ones ] are the same . The story goes just as before except that to maintain the stock of machines at the new level M + l\/m requires that annual production of machines rise by d\/m , which requires the permanent addition of d men to the machine-building sector . The machine-using sector requires nlm new operatives from now on . They produce a flow of consumables higher by ncjm than it used to be . But against this must be written off the in output from the handworking sector that is permanently lost because some manpower must be permanently transferred to the replacing and operating of new machines . Thus for its initial sacrifice of b units of consumption , society realizes a perpetual flow of units of consumables . The rate of return is thus , just as it was before . .
Translation: 在这种情况下，计算永续回报率很容易，我这样做是为了说明在稳定条件下，单周期和永续的回报率（以及所有中间回报率）是相同的。情形与之前一样，只是为了将机器存量维持在新的水平 M + l/m，每年机器的产量需要增加 d/m，这就需要机器制造部门永久增加 d 名工人。机器使用部门从现在起需要 nlm 名新操作工。他们所生产的消费品流量比以前高出 ncjm。但与此同时，必须扣除手工部门因部分劳动力永久转移到新机器的更换和操作而永久损失的产出。因此，社会以最初牺牲 b 单位消费品为代价，实现了永续的消费品流入。回报率因此与之前一样。

Query_Text_en: In the first , wholly neo-classical , model the rate of return equals the marginal productivity of capital and it hardly seemes worthwhile to point out the connection with the theory of a market economy : in a perfect capital market the only possible equilibrium interest rate is one equal to the rate of return on investment . In this second model precisely the same thing is true : in competitive equilibrium , the rate of interest must equal the rate of return on investment . The nc units of consumer goods produced by one machine and n men must cover the wages of the n men , de-predation on the machine , and profit or interest on the value of the machine . Thus nc wn + wm [ d + r ] where now w is the wage in consumer goods , r is the unknown rate of interest , and wm is clearly the amount of capital value tied up in a machine . But the wage in consumables is fixed at b , because one worker can produce b units of consumables unassisted in the handicraft sector ; whatever the institutional character of the economy , the opportunity cost of adding one unit of labor to the machine-building-and-using sectors is clearly b units of consumer goods as long as anyone is employed in the handicraft sector . But then nc bn + bm [ d + r ] , which implies r nc\/bm d njm . Thus even here , with no marginal productivities defined , the only possible equilibrium interest rate is the rate of return on investment .
Translation: 在第一个完全新古典的模型中，收益率等于资本的边际生产力，这与市场经济理论的联系几乎无需赘述：在一个完善的资本市场上，唯一可能的均衡利率就是等于投资收益率的利率。在第二个模型中，情况也完全相同：在竞争性均衡下，利率必须等于投资收益率。一台机器和n个工人生产的nc单位消费品，必须覆盖n个工人的工资、机器的折旧以及机器价值上的利润或利息。因此，nc = wn + wm [d + r]，其中w是以消费品计的工资，r是未知的利率，wm显然是投入到一台机器上的资本价值。但消费品工资被固定在b，因为在手工业部门，一个工人单独可以生产b单位的消费品；无论经济的制度性质如何，只要还有人在手工业部门工作，将一个劳动力增加到机器制造和使用部门的机会成本显然就是b单位消费品。但这样一来，nc = bn + bm [d + r]，这意味着r = (nc - bn)/bm - d。由此可见，即使在这里没有定义边际生产力，唯一可能的均衡利率仍然是投资的收益率。

Query_Text_en: It is widely believed that politics and economics are separate and largely unconnected ; that individual freedom is a political problem and material welfare an economic problem ; and that any kind of political arrangements can be combined with any kind of economic arrangements .
Translation: 人们普遍认为，政治与经济是彼此独立且基本无关的；个人自由是政治问题，物质福利是经济问题；任何形式的政治体制都可以与任何形式的经济体制相结合。

Query_Text_en: The chief contemporary manifestation of this idea is the advocacy of `` democratic socialism '' by many who condemn out of hand the restrictions on individual freedom imposed by `` totalitarian socialism '' in Russia , and who are persuaded that it is possible for a country to adopt the essential features of Russian economic arrangements and yet to ensure individual freedom through political arrangements .
Translation: 这种观点在当代的主要表现是，许多人主张“民主社会主义”，他们全盘否定俄罗斯“极权社会主义”对个人自由的限制，并且相信一个国家可以采纳俄罗斯经济制度的基本特征，同时通过政治制度来保障个人自由。

Query_Text_en: The thesis of this chapter is that such a view is a delusion , that there is an intimate connection between economics and politics , that only certain combinations of political and economic arrangements are possible , and that in particular , a society which is socialist can not also be democratic , in the sense of guaranteeing individual freedom .
Translation: 本章的论点是，这种观点是一种错觉，经济与政治之间存在着密切联系，只有特定的政治与经济体制组合才是可能的，尤其是，一个社会主义社会无法同时实现民主，即无法保障个人自由。

Query_Text_en: Economic arrangements play a dual role in the promotion of a free society .
Translation: 经济体制在推动自由社会的进程中发挥着双重作用。

Query_Text_en: On the one hand , freedom in economic arrangements is itself a component of freedom broadly understood , so economic freedom is an end in itself .
Translation: 一方面，经济安排中的自由本身就是广义自由的一个组成部分，因此经济自由本身就是一种目的。

Query_Text_en: In the second place , economic freedom is also an indispensable means toward the achievement of political freedom .
Translation: 其次，经济自由也是实现政治自由不可或缺的手段。

Query_Text_en: The first of these roles of economic freedom needs special emphasis because intellectuals in particular have a strong bias against regarding this aspect of freedom as important .
Translation: 经济自由的第一个作用尤需特别强调，因为知识分子尤其倾向于低估这一自由的重要性。

Query_Text_en: They tend to express contempt for what they regard as material aspects of life , and to regard their own pursuit of allegedly higher values as on a different plane of significance and as deserving of special attention .
Translation: 他们往往对他们认为是物质层面的生活表现出蔑视，并将自己追求的所谓更高价值视为处于不同的重要层次，认为这种追求理应受到特别关注。

Query_Text_en: For most citizens of the country , however , if not for the intellectual , the direct importance of economic freedom is at least comparable in significance to the indirect importance of economic freedom as a means to political freedom .
Translation: 然而，对于该国的大多数公民来说，若非知识分子，经济自由的直接重要性至少与其作为实现政治自由手段的间接重要性同等重要。

Query_Text_en: The citizen of Great Britain , who after World War II was not permitted to spend his vacation in the United States because of exchange control , was being deprived of an essential freedom no less than the citizen of the United States , who was denied the opportunity to spend his vacation in Russia because of his political views .
Translation: 二战后，由于外汇管制，英国公民无法前往美国度假，这种对基本自由的剥夺，与美国公民因其政治观点而被禁止前往俄罗斯度假并无二致。

Query_Text_en: The one was ostensibly an economic limitation on freedom and the other a political limitation , yet there is no essential difference between the two .
Translation: 一个表面上是对自由的经济限制，另一个则是政治限制，但两者本质上并无区别。

Query_Text_en: The citizen of the United States who is compelled by law to devote something like 10 per cent of his income to the purchase of a particular kind of retirement contract , administered by the government , is being deprived of a corresponding part of his personal freedom .
Translation: 美国公民若被法律强制要求将其收入的约10%用于购买由政府管理的特定类型退休合同，就相当于被剥夺了相应部分的个人自由。

Query_Text_en: How strongly this deprivation may be felt and its closeness to the deprivation of religious freedom , which all would regard as `` civil '' or `` political '' rather than `` economic '' , were dramatized by an episode involving a group of farmers of the Amish sect .
Translation: 这种剥夺感的强烈程度，以及它与宗教自由被剥夺的相似性——后者被普遍认为是“公民”或“政治”权利，而非“经济”权利——在一起涉及阿米什教派农民的事件中得到了生动体现。

Query_Text_en: On grounds of principle , this group regarded compulsory federal old age programs as an infringement of their personal individual freedom and refused to pay taxes or accept benefits .
Translation: 基于原则，这个群体认为强制性的联邦老年项目侵犯了他们的个人自由，因此拒绝缴纳税款或接受福利。

Query_Text_en: As a result , some of their livestock were sold by auction in order to satisfy claims for social security levies .
Translation: 因此，他们的一些牲畜被拍卖，以满足社会保障征费的索赔要求。

Query_Text_en: True , the number of citizens who regard compulsory old age insurance as a deprivation of freedom may be few , but the believer in freedom has never counted noses .
Translation: 诚然，将强制性养老保险视为对自由剥夺的公民人数或许不多，但自由的信仰者从未以人数多少来衡量其信念。

Query_Text_en: A citizen of the United States who under the laws of various states is not free to follow the occupation of his own choosing unless he can get a license for it , is likewise being deprived of an essential part of his freedom .
Translation: 美国公民如果根据各州法律，不能自由选择自己想从事的职业，除非获得相关执照，那么他同样被剥夺了自由的重要部分。

Query_Text_en: So is the man who would like to exchange some of his goods with , say , a Swiss for a watch but is prevented from doing so by a quota .
Translation: 这就如同一个人想用自己的一些商品与瑞士人交换一块手表，但却因配额限制而无法实现。

Query_Text_en: So also is the Californian who was thrown into jail for selling Alka Seltzer at a price below that set by the manufacturer under so - called `` fair trade '' laws .
Translation: 加州一名因在“公平贸易”法下，以低于制造商规定价格销售阿司匹林泡腾片而被关进监狱的人，也是如此。

Query_Text_en: So also is the farmer who can not grow the amount of wheat he wants .
Translation: 同样，那些无法种植所需小麦数量的农民也是如此。

Query_Text_en: And so on .
Translation: 等等。

Query_Text_en: Clearly , economic freedom , in and of itself , is an extremely important part of total freedom .
Translation: 显然，经济自由本身就是整体自由中极为重要的组成部分。

Query_Text_en: Viewed as a means to the end of political freedom , economic arrangements are important because of their effect on the concentration or dispersion of power .
Translation: 经济制度被视为实现政治自由的手段，其重要性在于对权力集中或分散所产生的影响。

Query_Text_en: The kind of economic organization that provides economic freedom directly , namely , competitive capitalism , also promotes political freedom because it separates economic power from political power and in this way enables the one to offset the other .
Translation: 能够直接提供经济自由的经济组织形式——即竞争性资本主义——同样也促进了政治自由，因为它将经济权力与政治权力分离，从而使二者能够相互制衡。

Query_Text_en: Historical evidence speaks with a single voice on the relation between political freedom and a free market .
Translation: 历史证据一致表明，政治自由与自由市场之间存在密切关联。

Query_Text_en: I know of no example in time or place of a society that has been marked by a large measure of political freedom , and that has not also used something comparable to a free market to organize the bulk of economic activity .
Translation: 我从未见过任何一个在任何时代或地区拥有高度政治自由的社会，不同时也采用类似自由市场的机制来组织其大部分经济活动。

Query_Text_en: Because we live in a largely free society , we tend to forget how limited is the span of time and the part of the globe for which there has ever been anything like political freedom : the typical state of mankind is tyranny , servitude , and misery .
Translation: 由于我们生活在一个相对自由的社会中，往往会忽略政治自由在历史和地理上的局限——事实上，政治自由只在极少数的时间和地区存在过。人类的常态其实是专制、奴役和苦难。

Query_Text_en: The typical situation of human beings is: despotism, slavery and suffering.
Translation: 人类的典型处境是：专制、奴役与苦难。

Query_Text_en: The nineteenth century and early twentieth century in the Western world stand out as striking exceptions to the general trend of historical development .Political freedom in this instance clearly came along with the free market and the development of capitalist institutions .
Translation: 十九世纪及二十世纪初的西方世界，显著地成为历史发展总体趋势中的一个例外。在这一时期，政治自由明显与自由市场和资本主义制度的发展相伴而生。

Query_Text_en: History suggests only that capitalism is a necessary condition for political freedom .
Translation: 历史表明，资本主义只是实现政治自由的必要条件。

Query_Text_en: Clearly it is not a sufficient condition .
Translation: 显然，这不是一个充分条件。

Query_Text_en: Fascist Italy and Fascist Spain , Germany at various times in the last seventy years , Japan before World Wars I and II , tzarist Russia in the decades before World War I are all societies that can not conceivably be described as politically free .
Translation: 法西斯意大利、法西斯西班牙、过去七十年间的德国、第一次和第二次世界大战前的日本，以及第一次世界大战前几十年的沙皇俄国，这些社会都无法被认为是政治自由的。

Query_Text_en: Yet , in each , private enterprise was the dominant form of economic organization .
Translation: 然而，在每种情况下，私营企业都是主要的经济组织形式。

Query_Text_en: It is therefore clearly possible to have economic arrangements that are fundamentally capitalist and political arrangements that are not free .
Translation: 因此，完全可以出现经济体制本质上是资本主义，而政治体制却并非自由的情况。

Query_Text_en: Even in those societies , the citizenry had a good deal more freedom than citizens of a modern totalitarian state like Russia or Nazi Germany , in which economic totalitarianism is combined with political totalitarianism .
Translation: 即便在那些社会中，公民所享有的自由也远远多于现代极权国家如俄罗斯或纳粹德国的公民，在这些国家，经济极权主义与政治极权主义相结合。

Query_Text_en: Even in Russia under the Tzars , it was possible for some citizens , under some circumstances , to change their jobs without getting permission from political authority because capitalism and the existence of private property provided some check to the centralized power of the state .
Translation: 即使在沙皇统治下的俄罗斯，在某些情况下，一些公民也可以在未经政治权力许可的情况下更换工作，因为资本主义和私有制的存在对国家的中央集权起到了一定的制约作用。

Query_Text_en: The relation between political and economic freedom is complex and by no means unilateral .
Translation: 政治自由与经济自由之间的关系复杂，绝非单向。

Query_Text_en: In the early nineteenth century , Bentham and the Philosophical Radicals were inclined to regard political freedom as a means to economic freedom .
Translation: 19世纪初，边沁及哲学激进派倾向于将政治自由视为实现经济自由的手段。

Query_Text_en: They believed that the masses were being hampered by the restrictions that were being imposed upon them , and that if political reform gave the bulk of the people the vote , they would do what was good for them , which was to vote for laissez faire .
Translation: 他们认为，群众正受到强加于他们的各种限制的阻碍，如果政治改革赋予大多数人选举权，他们会做对自己有利的事情，也就是投票支持自由放任政策。

Query_Text_en: In retrospect , one can not say that they were wrong .
Translation: 事后看来，不能说他们是错的。

Query_Text_en: There was a large measure of political reform that was accompanied by economic reform in the direction of a great deal of laissez faire .
Translation: 在大规模政治改革的同时，经济改革也朝着高度自由放任的方向推进。

Query_Text_en: An enormous increase in the well-being of the masses followed this change in economic arrangements .
Translation: 经济体制变革之后，广大民众的福祉显著提升。

Query_Text_en: The triumph of Benthamite liberalism in nineteenth-century England was followed by a reaction toward increasing intervention by government in economic affairs .
Translation: 19世纪英国功利主义自由主义的胜利，随之而来的是政府在经济事务中日益加强干预的反动。

Query_Text_en: This tendency to collectivism was greatly accelerated , both in England and elsewhere , by the two World Wars .
Translation: 这种集体主义倾向在英国及其他国家，因两次世界大战而大大加速。

Query_Text_en: Welfare rather than freedom became the dominant note in democratic countries .
Translation: 在民主国家，福利而非自由成为主导主题。

Query_Text_en: Recognizing the implicit threat to individualism , the intellectual descendants of the Philosophical Radicals - Dicey , Mises , Hayek , and Simons , to mention only a few - feared that a continued movement toward centralized control of economic activity would prove The Road to Serfdom , as Hayek entitled his penetrating analysis of the process .
Translation: 意识到对个人主义的潜在威胁，哲学激进主义者的思想继承者——如戴西、米塞斯、哈耶克和西蒙斯，仅举几例——担心经济活动持续向中央集权控制的方向发展，最终会成为哈耶克在其深刻分析中所称的“通往奴役之路”。

Query_Text_en: Their emphasis was on economic freedom as a means toward political freedom .
Translation: 他们强调经济自由是实现政治自由的途径。

Query_Text_en: Events since the end of World War II display still a different relation between economic and political freedom .
Translation: 二战结束以来的诸多事件展现了经济自由与政治自由之间另一种关系。

Query_Text_en: At least in some countries , however , the result has not been the suppression of freedom , but the reversal of economic policy .
Translation: 然而，至少在某些国家，这一结果并非自由的压制，而是经济政策的转向。

Query_Text_en: England again provides the most striking example .
Translation: 英格兰再次成为最引人注目的例证。

Query_Text_en: The turning point was perhaps the '' control of engagements '' order which .
Translation: 转折点或许是那项“就业控制令”。

Query_Text_en: despite great misgivings , the Labor party found it necessary to impose in order to carry out its economic policy .
Translation: 尽管存在极大的顾虑，工党仍认为有必要实施相关措施，以推进其经济政策。

Query_Text_en: Fully enforced and carried through , the law would have involved centralized allocation of individuals to occupations .
Translation: 如果全面执行并贯彻该法律，将涉及对个人职业的集中分配。

Query_Text_en: This conflicted so sharply with personal liberty that it was enforced in a negligible number of cases , and then repealed after the law had been in effect for only a short period .
Translation: 这一规定与个人自由严重冲突，因此实际执行的案例极为罕见，并在实施仅仅一段时间后便被废除。

Query_Text_en: Its repeal ushered in a decided shift in economic policy , marked by reduced reliance on centralized `` plans '' and `` programs '' , by the dismantling of many controls , and by increased emphasis on the private market .
Translation: 该法案的废除带来了经济政策的明显转变，表现为对中央“计划”和“项目”的依赖减少，众多管控措施被取消，私人市场的作用得到进一步强调。

Query_Text_en: A similar shift in policy occurred in most other democratic countries .
Translation: 大多数其他民主国家也出现了类似的政策转变。

Query_Text_en: The proximate explanation of these shifts in policy is the limited success of central planning or its outright failure to achieve stated objectives .
Translation: 这些政策转变的直接原因是中央计划取得的成效有限，甚至未能实现既定目标。

Query_Text_en: However , this failure is itself to be attributed , at least in some measure , to the political implications of central planning and to an unwillingness to follow out its logic when doing so requires trampling rough-shod on treasured private rights .
Translation: 然而，这种失败本身，至少在某种程度上，应归因于中央计划的政治影响，以及在其逻辑要求必须粗暴践踏珍视的私人权利时，人们不愿意贯彻到底。

Query_Text_en: It may well be that the shift is only a temporary interruption in the collectivist trend of this century .
Translation: 这种转变很可能只是本世纪集体主义趋势中的一次暂时中断。

Query_Text_en: Even so , it illustrates the close relation between political freedom and economic arrangements .
Translation: 即便如此，这也体现了政治自由与经济体制之间的紧密关系。

Query_Text_en: Historical evidence by itself can never be convincing .
Translation: 历史证据本身永远无法令人信服。

Query_Text_en: Perhaps it was sheer coincidence that the expansion of freedom occurred at the same time as the development of capitalist and market institutions .
Translation: 也许自由的扩展与资本主义和市场制度的发展同时发生，仅仅是巧合。

Query_Text_en: Why should there be a connection ? What are the logical links between economic and political freedom ? In discussing these questions we shall consider first the market as a direct component of freedom , and then the indirect relation between market arrangements and political freedom .
Translation: 为什么两者之间应该存在联系？经济自由与政治自由之间有哪些逻辑关联？在讨论这些问题时，我们将首先把市场视为自由的直接组成部分，然后再探讨市场安排与政治自由之间的间接关系。

Query_Text_en: A by-product will be an outline of the ideal economic arrangements for a free society .
Translation: 作为附带成果，将形成一个关于自由社会理想经济体制的纲要。

Query_Text_en: As liberals , we take freedom of the individual , or perhaps the family , as our ultimate goal in judging social arrangements .
Translation: 作为自由主义者，我们将个人，或者家庭的自由，作为衡量社会制度的最终目标。

Query_Text_en: Freedom as a value in this sense has to do with the interrelations among people ; it has no meaning whatsoever to a Robinson Crusoe on an isolated island [ without his Man Friday ] .
Translation: 在这个意义上，自由作为一种价值，关乎人与人之间的相互关系；对于孤岛上的鲁滨逊（没有星期五陪伴），它毫无意义。

Query_Text_en: Robinson Crusoe on his island is subject to `` constraint , '' he has limited `` power , '' and he has only a limited number of alternatives , but there is no problem of freedom in the sense that is relevant to our discussion .
Translation: 鲁宾逊·克鲁索在他的岛上受到了“约束”，他的“能力”有限，选择也只有有限几种，但在我们讨论的意义上，并不存在自由的问题。

Query_Text_en: Similarly , in a society freedom has nothing to say about what an individual does with his freedom ; it is not an all-embracing ethic .
Translation: 同样，在社会中，自由并不涉及个人如何运用自己的自由；它并不是一种包容万象的伦理。

Query_Text_en: Indeed , a major aim of the liberal is to leave the ethical problem for the individual to wrestle with .
Translation: 事实上，自由主义者的一个主要目标，就是将道德问题留给个人自行解决。

Query_Text_en: The `` really '' important ethical problems are those that face an individual in a free society what he should do with his freedom .
Translation: “真正”重要的伦理问题，是一个人在自由社会中应如何运用自己的自由。

Query_Text_en: There are thus two sets of values that a liberal will emphasize the values that are relevant to relations among people , which is the context in which he assigns first priority to freedom ; and the values that are relevant to the individual in the exercise of his freedom , which is the realm of individual ethics and philosophy .
Translation: 因此，自由主义者会强调两类价值：一类是与人际关系相关的价值观，在这一领域他将自由置于首要位置；另一类是个人在行使自由时所涉及的价值观，这属于个人伦理和哲学的范畴。

Query_Text_en: The liberal conceives of men as imperfect beings .
Translation: 自由主义者认为人是有缺陷的存在。

Query_Text_en: He regards the problem of social organization to be as much a negative problem of preventing `` bad '' people from doing harm as of enabling `` good '' people to do good ; and , of course , `` bad '' and `` good '' people may be the same people , depending on who is judging them .
Translation: 他认为，社会组织的问题既是防止“坏人”作恶的消极问题，也是促使“好人”行善的积极问题；当然，“坏人”和“好人”可能是同一批人，这取决于评判他们的人是谁。

Query_Text_en: The basic problem of social organization is how to co-ordinate the economic activities of large numbers of people .
Translation: 社会组织的基本问题在于如何协调大量人员的经济活动。

Query_Text_en: Even in relatively backward societies , extensive division of labor and specialization of function is required to make effective use of available resources .
Translation: 即使在相对落后的社会中，要有效利用现有资源，也需要广泛的分工与职能专业化。

Query_Text_en: In advanced societies , the scale on which coordination is needed , to take full advantage of the opportunities offered by modern science and technology , is enormously greater .
Translation: 在发达社会中，要充分利用现代科学技术带来的机遇，所需协调的规模大大增加。

Query_Text_en: Literally millions of people are involved in providing one another with their daily bread , let alone with their yearly automobiles .
Translation: 仅仅是为了让彼此每天都有面包吃，就已经有数以百万计的人参与其中，更不用说每年为大家提供汽车了。

Query_Text_en: The challenge to the believer in liberty is to reconcile this widespread interdependence with individual freedom .
Translation: 自由信仰者所面临的挑战，是如何将这种广泛的相互依赖与个人自由相协调。

Query_Text_en: Fundamentally , there are only two ways of co-ordinating the economic activities of millions . One is central direction involving the use of coercion - the technique of the army and of the modern totalitarian state .
Translation: 从根本上说，协调数百万人的经济活动只有两种方式。一种是中央指挥，依靠强制手段——这是军队和现代极权国家所采用的方式。

Query_Text_en: The possibility of co-ordination through voluntary co-operation rests on the elementary - yet frequently denied - proposition that both parties to an economic transaction benefit from it , provided the transaction is bi-laterally voluntary and informed .
Translation: 通过自愿合作实现协调的可能性，建立在一个基本但常被否认的前提之上：只要经济交易是双方自愿且知情的，交易双方都能从中受益。

Query_Text_en: Exchange can therefore bring about co-ordination without coercion .
Translation: 因此，交换能够在无需强制的情况下实现协调。

Query_Text_en: A working model of a society organized through voluntary exchange is a free private enterprise exchange economy-what we have been calling competitive capitalism .
Translation: 一个通过自愿交换组织起来的社会的运作模式，就是自由私营企业交换经济——也就是我们所称的竞争性资本主义。

Query_Text_en: In its simplest form , such a society consists of a number of independent households - a collection of Robinson Crusoes , as it were . Each household uses the resources it controls to produce goods and services that it exchanges for goods and services produced by other households , on terms mutually acceptable to the two parties to the bargain .
Translation: 在最简单的形式下，这样的社会由若干个独立的家庭组成——可以说是一群“鲁滨逊漂流者”的集合。每个家庭利用其所掌控的资源生产商品和服务，并以双方都能接受的条件，与其他家庭交换彼此生产的商品和服务。

Query_Text_en: It is thereby enabled to satisfy its wants indirectly by producing goods and services for others , rather than directly by producing goods for its own immediate use .
Translation: 因此，它能够通过为他人生产商品和服务来间接满足自身需求，而不是直接生产供自己立即使用的商品。

Query_Text_en: The incentive for adopting this indirect route is , of course , the increased product made possible by division of labor and specialization of function .
Translation: 采用这种间接方式的动因，当然是通过劳动分工和职能专业化所带来的产品产量提升。

Query_Text_en: Since the household always has the alternative of producing directly for itself , it need not enter into any exchange unless it benefits from it .
Translation: 由于家庭始终可以选择自给自足，因此只有在交换能够带来利益时，才会参与交换。

Query_Text_en: Hence , no exchange will take place unless both parties do benefit from it .
Translation: 因此，只有双方都能从中获益，交换才会发生。

Query_Text_en: Co-operation is thereby achieved without coercion .
Translation: 由此实现了无需强制的合作。

Query_Text_en: Specialization of function and division of labor would not go far if the ultimate productive unit were the household .
Translation: 如果家庭是最终的生产单位，职能专门化和分工就难以深入发展。

Query_Text_en: In a modern society , we have gone much farther .
Translation: 在现代社会，我们已经走得更远了。

Query_Text_en: We have introduced enterprises which are intermediaries between individuals in their capacities as suppliers of service and as purchasers of goods .
Translation: 我们已经引入了企业作为中介，连接个人在作为服务提供者和商品购买者两种身份之间的关系。

Query_Text_en: And similarly , specialization of function and division of labor could not go very far if we had to continue to rely on the barter of product for product .
Translation: 同样，如果我们仍然必须依赖以物易物的方式进行产品交换，功能的专业化和劳动分工也难以得到充分发展。

Query_Text_en: In consequence , money has been introduced as a means of facilitating exchange , and of enabling the acts of purchase and of sale to be separated into two parts .
Translation: 因此，货币被引入作为促进交换的手段，使购买与销售行为能够分为两个独立的环节。

Query_Text_en: Despite the important role of enterprises and of money in our actual economy , and despite the numerous and complex problems they raise , the central characteristic of the market technique of achieving co-ordination is fully displayed in the simple exchange economy that contains neither enterprises nor money .
Translation: 尽管企业和货币在现实经济中扮演着重要角色，并且带来了诸多复杂问题，但市场机制实现协调的核心特征，在没有企业和货币的简单交换经济中已得到了充分体现。

Query_Text_en: As in that simple model , so in the complex enterprise and money-exchange economy , co-operation is strictly individual and voluntary provided : [ a ] that enterprises are private , so that the ultimate contracting parties are individuals and [ b ] that individuals arc effectively free to enter or not to enter into any particular exchange , so that every transaction is strictly voluntary .
Translation: 正如在那个简单模型中一样，在复杂的企业和货币交换经济中，只要满足以下条件，合作也是严格意义上的个人行为且完全自愿：[a] 企业是私有的，因此最终的合同双方是个人；[b] 个人有实际的自由选择权，可以决定是否参与任何特定的交换，因此每一笔交易都是严格自愿的。

Query_Text_en: It is far easier to state these provisos in general terms than to spell them out in detail , or to specify precisely the institutional arrangements most conducive to their maintenance .
Translation: 用一般性术语阐述这些限定条件要比详细说明它们，或准确界定最有利于其维持的制度安排容易得多。

Query_Text_en: Indeed , much of technical economic literature is concerned with precisely these questions .
Translation: 事实上，大量技术性经济文献正是围绕这些问题展开的。

Query_Text_en: The basic requisite is the maintenance of law and order to prevent physical coercion of one individual by another and to enforce contracts voluntarily entered into , thus giving substance to `` private '' .
Translation: 基本要求是维护法律和秩序，防止个人之间的身体强制，并保障自愿签订的合同得以执行，从而赋予“私人”以实质内容。

Query_Text_en: Aside from this , perhaps the most difficult problems arise from monopoly which inhibits effective freedom by denying individuals alternatives to the particular exchange and from `` neighborhood effects '' effects on third parties for which it is not feasible to charge or recompense them .
Translation: 除此之外，或许最为棘手的问题源于垄断，因为垄断通过剥夺个人选择其他交易的可能性，阻碍了有效的自由；以及“邻近效应”，即对第三方产生影响，而无法向他们收取费用或给予补偿。

Query_Text_en: These problems will be discussed in more detail in the following chapter .
Translation: 这些问题将在下一章中作更为详细的讨论。

Query_Text_en: So long as effective freedom of exchange is maintained , the central feature of the market organization of economic activity is that it prevents one person from interfering with another in respect of most of his activities .
Translation: 只要有效的自由交换得以维持，市场经济组织的核心特征就在于它能够防止个人在大多数活动中受到他人的干涉。

Query_Text_en: The consumer is protected from coercion by the seller because of the presence of other sellers with whom he can deal .
Translation: 由于存在其他可供选择的卖方，消费者免受卖方胁迫。

Query_Text_en: The seller is protected from coercion by the consumer because of other consumers to whom he can sell .
Translation: 由于卖方还可以将商品出售给其他消费者，因此不会受到单一消费者的胁迫。

Query_Text_en: The employee is protected from coercion by the employer because of other employers for whom he can work , and so on .
Translation: 由于员工可以为其他雇主工作，因此不会受到现有雇主的胁迫，依此类推。

Query_Text_en: And the market does this impersonally and without centralized authority .
Translation: 而市场则以非个人化的方式、无须中央权威进行运作。

Query_Text_en: Indeed , a major source of objection to a free economy is precisely that it does this task so well .
Translation: 事实上，人们反对自由经济的一个主要原因，恰恰在于它能够如此出色地完成这一任务。

Query_Text_en: It gives people what they want instead of what a particular group thinks they ought to want .
Translation: 它满足人们的真实需求，而不是某个特定群体认为他们应该需求的东西。

Query_Text_en: Underlying most arguments against the free market is a lack of belief in freedom itself .
Translation: 反对自由市场的多数观点，其根源在于对自由本身缺乏信心。

Query_Text_en: The existence of a free market does not of course eliminate the need for government .
Translation: 自由市场的存在当然并不意味着政府不再需要。

Query_Text_en: On the contrary , government is essential both as a forum for determining the `` rules of the game '' and as an umpire to interpret and enforce the rules decided on .
Translation: 相反，政府在确定“游戏规则”的过程中既是决策的平台，也是解释和执行已定规则的裁判，这两方面都至关重要。

Query_Text_en: What the market does is to reduce greatly the range of issues that must be decided through political means , and thereby to minimize the extent to which government need participate directly in the game .
Translation: 市场的作用在于大幅减少需要通过政治手段解决的问题，从而最大限度地降低政府直接参与这一过程的程度。

Query_Text_en: The characteristic feature of action through political channels is that it tends to require or enforce substantial conformity .
Translation: 通过政治途径采取行动的一个显著特征是，它往往要求或强制实现高度的一致性。

Query_Text_en: The great advantage of the market , on the other hand , is that it permits wide diversity .
Translation: 市场的最大优势在于它能够容纳广泛的多样性。

Query_Text_en: It is , in political terms , a system of proportional representation .
Translation: 从政治角度来看，这是一种比例代表制。

Query_Text_en: It is this feature of the market that we refer to when we say that the market provides economic freedom .
Translation: 我们所说的市场提供经济自由，指的正是市场的这一特性。

Query_Text_en: But this characteristic also has implications that go far beyond the narrowly economic .
Translation: 但这一特征的影响远不止于经济层面。

Query_Text_en: Political freedom means the absence of coercion of a man by his fellow men .
Translation: 政治自由意味着个人不受他人强制。

Query_Text_en: The fundamental threat to freedom is power to coerce , be it in the hands of a monarch , a dictator , an oligarchy , or a momentary majority .
Translation: 对自由的根本威胁在于强制权力，无论这种权力掌握在君主、独裁者、寡头集团，还是一时的多数人手中。

Query_Text_en: The preservation of freedom requires the elimination of such concentration of power to the fullest possible extent and the dispersal and distribution of whatever power can not be eliminated-a system of checks and balances .
Translation: 要维护自由，必须最大限度地消除权力的集中，并将无法消除的权力进行分散和分配，形成权力制衡的体系。

Query_Text_en: By removing the organization of economic activity from the control of political authority , the market eliminates this source of coercive power .
Translation: 通过将经济活动的组织从政治权力的控制中剥离出来，市场消除了这一强制性权力的来源。

Query_Text_en: It enables economic strength to be a check to political power rather than a reinforcement .
Translation: 它使经济实力成为对政治权力的制衡，而非助长政治权力。

Query_Text_en: Economic power can be widely dispersed .
Translation: 经济权力可以广泛分散。

Query_Text_en: There is no law of conservation which forces the growth of new centers of economic strength to be at the expense of existing centers .
Translation: 没有哪条守恒定律规定新的经济中心的崛起必须以现有中心的利益受损为代价。

Query_Text_en: Political power , on the other hand , is more difficult to decentralize .
Translation: 相比之下，政治权力则更难实现分权。

Query_Text_en: There can be numerous small independent governments .
Translation: 可以存在众多小型独立的政府。

Query_Text_en: But it is far more difficult to maintain numerous equipotent small centers of political power in a single large government than it is to have numerous centers of economic strength in a single large economy .
Translation: 在一个庞大的政府体系中，维持众多权力均衡的小型政治中心远比在一个庞大的经济体中维持众多经济实力中心要困难得多。

Query_Text_en: There can be many millionaires in one large economy .
Translation: 在一个大型经济体中，可以拥有许多百万富翁。

Query_Text_en: But can there be more than one really outstanding leader , one person on whom the energies and enthusiasms of his countrymen are centered ? If the central government gains power , it is likely to be at the expense of local governments .
Translation: 但是，真的可以有不止一位杰出的领导者吗？可以有不止一个人让全国人民的精力和热情都集中在他身上吗？如果中央政府获得了更多权力，这很可能是以地方政府的权力为代价的。

Query_Text_en: There seems to be something like a fixed total of political power to be distributed . Consequently , if economic power is joined to political power , concentration seems almost inevitable .
Translation: 政治权力似乎有一个固定的总量需要分配。因此，如果经济权力与政治权力结合，权力的集中几乎不可避免。

Query_Text_en: On the other hand , if economic power is kept in separate hands from political power , it can serve as a check and a counter to political power .
Translation: 另一方面，如果经济权力与政治权力分离，经济权力可以对政治权力形成制约和制衡。

Query_Text_en: The force of this abstract argument can perhaps best be demonstrated by example .
Translation: 这一抽象论点的说服力或许可以通过实例来最好地体现。

Query_Text_en: Let us consider first , a hypothetical example that may help to bring out the principles involved , and then some actual examples from recent experience that illustrate the way in which the market works to preserve political freedom .
Translation: 我们先来看一个假设性的例子，以帮助阐明相关原则，然后再结合近期的实际案例，说明市场如何发挥作用以维护政治自由。

Query_Text_en: One feature of a free society is surely the freedom of individuals to advocate and propagandize openly for a radical change in the structure of the society - so long as the advocacy is restricted to persuasion and does not include force or other forms of coercion .
Translation: 自由社会的一个重要特征，必然是个人可以公开倡导和宣传对社会结构进行根本性变革的自由——只要这种倡导仅限于说服，而不涉及使用暴力或其他形式的强制。

Query_Text_en: It is a mark of the political freedom of a capitalist society that men can openly advocate and work for socialism .
Translation: 资本主义社会的政治自由体现在，人们可以公开倡导并推动社会主义。
